title: The New Six Frigates
zh_title: 新六艘护卫舰
summary: 巴黎——一家英国公司藏在法国郊区会议中心的一个黑暗角落里，掌握着美国最新战舰的下一个设计方案。上周，2026 年欧洲海军陆战队巴布科克国际展台上的展示台上展示了​​ 31 型“箭头”号的模型。它是白宫设计的美国海军外国护卫舰竞赛的六个竞争者之一，目的是在美国掀起新一轮造船和投资浪潮。随着特朗普政府不断追求外国军舰设计和造船，几家欧洲国防公司在本两年期
content:
巴黎——一家英国公司藏在法国郊区会议中心的一个黑暗角落里，掌握着美国最新战舰的下一个设计方案。上周，2026 年欧洲海军陆战队巴布科克国际展台上的展示台上展示了​​ 31 型“箭头”号的模型。这是白宫设计的美国海军外国护卫舰竞赛的六个竞争者之一，目的是在美国掀起新一轮造船和投资浪潮。随着特朗普政府不断追求外国军舰设计和造船，在两年一度的会议上，几家欧洲防务公司急于讨论如果美国来敲门，他们可以在潜在的国际竞争中提出的选择。美国海军目前正在建造两艘护卫舰设计。一年前前海军部长约翰·费兰取消了该计划后，芬坎蒂尼马里内特海军陆战队仍在威斯康星州造船厂建造前两艘星座级护卫舰。与此同时，HII 的英格尔斯造船公司签订了一份长期合同，用于启动基于美国海岸警卫队国家安全巡逻舰的 FF(X) 护卫舰。据美国海军学院新闻了解，虽然美国海军几十年来一直未能成功推出护卫舰项目，但美国海军正在努力在未来几年内将外国设计用于新型舰艇。哈德逊研究所海军分析师布莱恩·克拉克表示，新护卫舰的工作要求已基本完成。
现在，海军优先考虑的是能够护航其他船只的护卫舰，而不是执行反潜战，这是现已取消的星座级计划的主要任务。克拉克表示，海军需要一个能够实施封锁并防御中层威胁的平台，就像美国中央司令部目前面临的中等威胁。 “一艘护卫舰可以防御我们所看到的来自伊朗的那种规模的威胁，”克拉克在欧洲海军之前告诉美国海军学院新闻。 “并不是真正的[反潜战]——更多的是执行这种海上控制、海上安全类型的任务。”为此，来自全球各地的六种设计已成为国际竞赛的潜在候选者，该竞赛将遵循唐纳德·特朗普总统在八月份的造船备忘录中所呼吁的设计。白宫文件呼吁海军推行所谓的“芬兰模式”，即在外国投资美国造船基础设施之前，可以在外国造船厂开始建造最多前两艘船体。白宫正在利用芬兰模式，在芬兰、德克萨斯州和路易斯安那州的造船厂建造两个独立的设计，以启动北极安全巡逻艇计划。白宫管理和预算办公室主任拉斯·沃特一直直言不讳地主张对小型水面作战舰艇和辅助舰艇使用相同的模型。
但国会抵制了这一努力，在众议院和参议院版本的《2027 财年国防授权法案》中都加入了草案，该法案将阻止海军购买外国建造的军舰。国会对购买海外辅助舰艇持更开放的态度。尽管遭到国会的抵制，八月的一份备忘录还是勾勒出了这场竞赛的蓝图——由国防部长皮特·赫格斯和代理海军部长曹洪制定。该计划将于周四向白宫提交。竞争者 Type 31 Babcock 图片 自 2023 年以来，Babcock 一直与美国领先者保持合作关系

【原文 English Original】
PARIS — Tucked in a dark corner of a convention center in the French suburbs, a British company could hold the next design for America’s newest warship. A model of the Type-31 Arrowhead sailed on a display table at the Babcock International booth at Euronaval 2026 last week. It was one of a half a dozen contenders for the U.S. Navy’s foreign frigate competition designed by the White House to jumpstart a new wave of shipbuilding and investment in the U.S. With the Trump administration’s ongoing pursuit of foreign warship design and shipbuilding, several European defense companies at the biennial conference were eager to discuss the options they could propose in a potential international competition should the U.S. come knocking at their doors. The U.S. Navy currently has two frigate designs under construction in the U.S. Fincantieri Marinette Marine is still building the first two Constellation-class frigates at its Wisconsin yard after former Navy Secretary John Phelan canceled the program one year ago . Meanwhile, HII’s Ingalls Shipbuilding has a long lead-time contract to start the FF(X) frigate that is based on the U.S. Coast Guard’s National Security Cutter. While a successful frigate program has eluded the U.S. Navy for decades, the service is working toward using a foreign design for a new class of ships in the next few years, USNI News understands. The working requirements for a new frigate are mostly done, according to Hudson Institute naval analyst Bryan Clark. Now the Navy is prioritizing frigates that can escort other ships instead of performing anti-submarine warfare, which was the main mission of the now-cancelled Constellation-class program. The service wants a platform that can enforce a blockade and protect against medium tiered threats like what the military is currently facing in U.S. Central Command, according to Clark. “A frigate could defend against the kind of scale of threat that we’re seeing from the Iranians,” Clark told USNI News ahead of Euronaval. “Not really [anti-submarine warfare] – more about doing this kind of sea control, maritime security type mission.” To that end, six designs from around the globe have emerged as potential candidates in an international competition that would adhere to the one President Donald Trump called for in an August shipbuilding memo. The White House document called on the Navy to pursue the so-called “Finland model,” in which construction could begin in a foreign shipyard for up to the first two hulls before a foreign investment in U.S. shipbuilding infrastructure. The White House is using the Finland model to jumpstart the Arctic Security Cutter program by building two separate designs in shipyards in Finland, Texas and Louisiana. White House Office of Management and Budget Director Russ Vought has been vocal about using the same model for small surface combatants and auxiliaries. But Congress has resisted the effort by including draft language in both the House and Senate versions of the Fiscal Year 2027 National Defense Authorization Act that would prevent the Navy from buying foreign-built warships. Congress is more open to buying auxiliaries overseas. Despite congressional resistance, an August memo outlined a blueprint for that competition – crafted by Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth and Acting Navy Secretary Hung Cao. The plan was due to the White House on Thursday. The Contenders Type 31 Babcock image Since 2023, Babcock has maintained a partnership with lead American shipbuilder HII as part of the AUKUS security pact. The British company also works with HII on the unmanned surface vessel Romulus, which the U.K.’s Royal Navy is purchasing. Sir Nick Hine, the chief executive of Babcock’s marine division, said he thinks the Type 31 frigate could fill the U.S. Navy’s need for a small surface combatant. That platform should be able to “perform anti‑submarine warfare, surface warfare and convoy escort duties,” according to the White House memo. The Type 31 frigate could function as a command vessel in a fleet that includes a mix of manned and unmanned ships, according to Hine. Babcock has already worked with Lockheed Martin, meaning the platform could integrate the AEGIS Combat System and the AN/SPY-7 radar. The design also features a Mark 41 launcher with 32 Vertical Launching System cells, but Hine says it could potentially take additional cells. “Navies are short of two things always, even yours, short of money and people,” Hine, making the case for the Type 31, told USNI News on the sidelines of Euronaval last week. “You need a cheaper frigate because the cost of some of these platforms is insane, and you need a platform that’s got less people in it because you don’t have enough people. The Type 31 was designed to be more adaptable, more affordable, more available, and it was designed to have less people in it,” he added. “It was designed for a crew of a complement of 100, not to exceed 100. It’s 6,000 tons, 140 meters in length, and therefore it was designed for North Atlantic operations, so it’s designed to operate in high sea states for long periods of time.” To field the platform in the U.S. fleet faster, the hull could be built abroad to the point where it’s ready to sail away while the combat system is integrated back in the U.S., Hine said. Another option is out of Spain’s Navantia, which is working on an export version of its Bonifaz-class F-110 anti-submarine warfare frigate. Navantia, which is partnered with Lockheed Martin for the F-110, plans to submit a bid should the U.S. Navy issue a request for proposals, Navantia commercial director Juan de la Cueva told USNI News during a wine and tapas-fueled reception on the convention center floor. F-110 frigate. Navantia image “All Navantia ships have a U.S. legacy because we came from a very long-standing relationship with the United States,” de la Cueva said. “We learned from Bath Iron Works, Gibbs & Cox how to build ships. So these ships pass … [Naval Sea Systems Command]” standards. De la Cueva noted the long relationship Navantia has maintained with major U.S. yards like General Dynamics Bath Iron Works and HII. The company has already provided the U.S. Navy with some information and is waiting to hear about the next steps in the competition. A U.S. variant could feature Lockheed Martin’s Aegis Combat System and the SPY-7 air and defense radar, de la Cueva said. In addition to the Brits and the Spanish, the Italians also have an option for the U.S. should it kick off an international competition. Italy’s Fincantieri, which has its own American subsidiary at Marinette Marine in Wisconsin, could propose the FREMM EVO. That platform is an updated version of the FREMM multi-mission frigate that the U.S. used as the parent design for the Constellation class. “I would call us untapped potential,” Fincantieri Marinette Marine chief executive officer George Moutafis told USNI News in September. The yard is still finishing the Royal Saudi Navy’s multi-mission surface combatant while building the first two Constellation-class frigates and preparing to build the Marine Corps’ Landing Ship Medium. “It’s an evolution of the original version, which is meant to say all the benefits are still there,” Moutafis said of the FREMM EVO. “The hard lines that work well for an [anti-submarine warfare] mission all is there, and they’ve been working on the areas that you would think would be the attractive ones – you know making it more lethal, making it ready to host energy-wise future growth for future missions, bringing in capabilities that have to do again with the ASW mission – and at the same time identifying the ways that it can integrate well with deploying, recovering and managing unmanned elements of across all domains.” The Wisconsin yard currently has about 2,200 employees and would need to hire about 500 over time should it receive a contract to build more frigates. Other possible designs could come out of Japan, South Korea and Turkey, USNI News previously reported . Following a discussion between Trump and Turkish leadership on the sidelines of July’s NATO summit, the Istanbul-class guided-missile frigate built by several Turkish shipyards entered the mix, two sources previously told USNI News. Fincantieri image Perhaps the nation most closely associated with the ongoing conversation about foreign shipbuilding is South Korea, which has pledged to invest $150 billion in the U.S. shipbuilding industry as part of a trade deal in the works with the Trump administration. The Chungnam-class guided-missile frigate, which several South Korean companies build, is one option under consideration, USNI News has learned. Meanwhile, the export version of Japan’s Mitsubishi Heavy Industries’ FFM Mogami-class guided-missile frigate is also on the table. While the Trump administration has repeatedly made its preference for an international competition known, the Navy has experienced setbacks when pursuing foreign designs. When altering the FREMM parent design for the Constellation-class program, Gibbs & Cox made so many changes to meet NAVSEA’s requirements that the commonality between the FREMM and the FFG(X) went from 85 percent to under 15 percent, USNI News reported in 2024 . “The thing that will prevent Constellation 2.0 is stop changing the requirement. If you set the requirement and leave it alone, and just let industry build it, whoever that is, that will stop Constellation 2.0,” Babcock’s Hine told USNI News. “Don’t even change the color of the curtains. Just build it,” he added. “It’s this sort of constant fiddling, and I know from being in the [U.K. Royal] Navy for most of my life, that we can’t help ourselves.”

title: 黃仁勳事件掀中共美人計疑雲 安全專家發警告
summary: 英偉達（Nvidia）執行長黃仁勳（Jensen Huang）婚外情事件牽出中共間諜疑雲。圖為黃仁勳於2026年5月14日在北京的檔案照。(Brendan Smialowski/ AFP via Getty Images) 【大紀元2026年11月20日訊】（英文大紀元記者Daniel Y. Teng報導／夏楚君編譯）澳洲聯邦警察（AFP）前特工、現任安全事務評論員保羅·約翰斯通（Paul Johnstone）警告說，中共情報人員可能通過精心策劃的「美人計」（Honey tr
content:
英偉達（Nvidia）執行長黃仁勳（Jensen Huang）婚外情事件牽出中共間諜疑雲。圖為黃仁勳於2026年5月14日在北京的檔案照。(Brendan Smialowski/ AFP via Getty Images)
【大紀元2026年11月20日訊】（英文大紀元記者Daniel Y. Teng報導／夏楚君編譯）澳洲聯邦警察（AFP）前特工、現任安全事務評論員保羅·約翰斯通（Paul Johnstone）警告說，中共情報人員可能通過精心策劃的「美人計」（Honey trap），利用目標人物的情感需求及個人弱點建立關係，藉此套取敏感情報，西方政商界高層尤其可能成為目標。
他的評論正值英偉達（Nvidia）執行長黃仁勳（Jensen Huang）承認與一名被媒體指控為中共間諜的女子有染。約翰斯通表示，他懷疑黃樂（Alice Huang）在科技、金融與媒體的工作，只是用來掩護身分。
事件令「美人計」再次成為國際關注焦點，也升高了外界對可能洩漏給中共的技術或情報的安全疑慮。英偉達是全球領先的先進電腦晶片開發商和生產商。
黃仁勳事件亦令人聯想到美國前國會議員埃里克·斯沃韋爾（Eric Swalwell）與疑似中共間諜方芳（Christine Fang）之間的交往，以及英國軍情五處（MI5）2025年發布的關於中共招募人員（尤其是年輕貌美的女性）將目標鎖定在國會工作人員的警告。
約翰斯通目前正在撰寫一本名為《紅色蜜罐》（Red Honey）的書，詳述他自己遭遇的多次誘騙企圖。
「仔細想想，如果它們真的安排一個27歲或30歲的年輕貌美女性來設下美人計，那肯定會引起警覺」，約翰斯通告訴《大紀元時報》。
「（黃仁勳）身邊的顧問可能會對他說：『嘿，想想後果吧。那是個年輕女人，而你是個年長的男人。』」約翰斯通說。
約翰斯通表示，黃樂的年齡更接近黃仁勳，這意味著她更容易與他建立個人聯繫。
「想想那位女士的年齡、外表、氣質和地位，這一切都經過精心策劃」，約翰斯通推測。
約翰斯通直言，孤獨感是美人計可能利用的其中一個弱點。他表示，向客戶提供安全建議時，經常會先問：「你在家中生活得快樂嗎？」因為這可能是整個問題的起點。
「總裁的工作非常孤獨。他們的生活非常孤獨，因為他們工作時間長，經常出差，家裡可能還有妻子和孩子」，約翰斯通說。
「也許他們的關係中缺乏親密感，也許他們的關係有些乏味。然後突然之間，一位非常漂亮、口齒伶俐、非常聰明的女性接近了這位男性」，他說。
約翰斯通表示，科技業是中共的主要目標之一，這位分析師懷疑「一定比例」的科技從業人員與北京國家安全部（MSS）有關聯。
「即使在澳洲，社區裡也有人曾經受過北京的訓練，並帶著特定目的來到這裡」，約翰斯通說。
「有時，這些線人，這些間諜，會在被激活之前長期處於休眠狀態。」
他表示，他們會等待合適的時機，與政界人士或高價值產業人士建立關係。
在美國，三名眾議院委員會主席已要求黃仁勳提供閉門簡報。

title: New US Chip Controls Squeeze Europe

content:
黄仁勋 Megaspeed 丑闻对欧洲意味着什么？乍一看，情况并不多：欧洲人将继续购买英伟达芯片。但仔细观察就会发现，连锁反应将对跨大西洋关系以及欧洲与北京日益紧张的关系产生影响。荷兰及其明星芯片制造商 ASML 看起来尤其容易受到影响。黄也许是华盛顿最有影响力的中国鸽派。他几乎单枪匹马地说服唐纳德·特朗普总统及其内阁采取宽松的方式执行拜登时代对英伟达芯片的出口管制，这激怒了两党鹰派。他的影响力减弱，再加上有关通过新加坡向中国非法走私芯片规模的新揭露，意味着鹰派再次得势。美国商务部已经采取行动，禁止中国人工智能公司使用海外数据中心。三项法案似乎将被纳入《国防授权法》，以进一步打击中国使用美国芯片。其中之一——MATCH法案——针对的是中国的芯片制造工具供应。荷兰公司 ASML 是这些工具的全球主要制造商。在美国制裁的威胁下，它将被迫遵守其美国竞争对手目前面临的相同限制。
包括荷兰王室在内的欧洲和荷兰外交官已经游说反对 MATCH 法案，该法案看起来不太可能成为法律——直到 Megaspeed 丑闻爆发。 实际上，该法案将禁止 ASML 向中国销售新的芯片制造机器（中国约占该公司年收入的五分之一），并禁止 ASML 履行为该国现有机器提供服务的合同义务。获取最新注册以定期接收带宽电子邮件并随时了解 CEPA 的工作情况。电子邮件提交 Δ document.getElementById( "ak_js_4" ).setAttribute( "value", ( new Date() ).getTime() ); gform.initializeOnLoaded( function() {jQuery('#gform_ajax_frame_9').on('load',function(){var content = jQuery(this).contents().find('*').html();var is_postback =contents.indexOf('GF_AJAX_POSTBACK') >= 0;if(!is_postback){return;}var form_content = jQuery(this).contents().find('#gform_wrapper_9');var is_confirmation = jQuery(this).contents().find('#gform_confirmation_wrapper_9').length > 0;var is_redirect =contents.indexOf('gformRedirect(){') >= 0;var is_form = form_content.length > 0 && is_redirect &&！

What does the Jensen Huang Megaspeed scandal mean for Europe? At first glance, not much: Europeans will keep buying Nvidia chips. But a closer look shows that the ripple effects will have consequences for transatlantic relations and for Europe’s increasingly tense relationship with Beijing. The Netherlands and its star chip machine manufacturer, ASML, look particularly vulnerable. Huang was perhaps Washington’s most influential China dove. He almost single-handedly persuaded President Donald Trump and his cabinet to take a lax approach to enforcing Biden-era export controls on Nvidia chips, to the fury of hawks on both sides of the aisle. His diminished influence, coupled with fresh revelations around the extent of illegal chip smuggling to China via Singapore, means that the hawks once again have the wind in their sails. The Department of Commerce has already moved to  block  Chinese AI companies from using overseas data centers. Three bills look  set  to be rolled into the National Defense Authorization Act that would further crack down on China’s use of US chips.  One of them — the MATCH Act — takes aim at China’s supply of chipmaking tools. Dutch company ASML is the major global manufacturer of these tools. It would be forced to comply with the same restrictions currently faced by its US competitors, under threat of US sanctions.  European and Dutch diplomats, including the Dutch Royal Family, have already  lobbied  against the MATCH Act, which looked unlikely to pass into law — until the Megaspeed scandal broke. In effect, the Act would ban ASML from selling new chipmaking machines to China, which accounts for around a  fifth  of the company’s annual revenue, and from fulfilling its contractual obligations to service existing machines already in the country.  Get the Latest Sign up to receive regular Bandwidth emails and stay informed about CEPA's work. Even if the MATCH Act passes, the White House will have discretion over how aggressively the legislation is applied. President Trump has tried to shield Nvidia and maintain good relations with Chinese President Xi Jinping. That gives Washington leeway to decline to enforce its toughest provisions — but still leaves ASML vulnerable to shifting political priorities or a future, more hawkish administration. If the US ultimately forces ASML to cut off servicing to Chinese companies, the Netherlands — and Europe — could find themselves exposed to Chinese retaliation. When Beijing  imposed  export controls on rare earths in 2025 in response to US trade actions, it ensured European companies were also caught in the crossfire. Beijing would likely not hesitate to make an example out of the Netherlands in order to discourage other countries from allying too closely with Washington. The MATCH Act is being discussed just as Europe itself is in the middle of executing a major hawkish turn on China, driven by the latter’s industrial overcapacities and supply chain dominance. Whereas the EU was unwilling to take a strong stance on China during Trump’s first term — when administration officials pressed European countries to remove Huawei telecoms equipment — and under former President Joseph Biden, the bloc is now developing powerful new trade instruments directed against Beijing. Despite this shift, Europe’s China policy remains fundamentally defensive. European capitals do not share Washington’s interest in undermining China’s AI sector. In fact, the EU benefits from Chinese competition to closed-source US frontier labs. Europe’s telecoms incumbents are resisting ripping out Huawei from their networks,  arguing  that the exclusion of Chinese suppliers would be  costly  and leave them dependent on expensive local vendors. US China hawks should think twice before trying to strong-arm Europe into mirroring US China policy. Such a move would likely backfire by galvanizing anti-US and pro-China figures in Europe. There is a deal to be done. For their part, EU countries need to follow through on the tough talk and deliver on China de-risking, with concrete measures such as improving coordination and closing gaps in EU and national licensing of chipmaking components. If Washington sees Europe acting of its own accord, it can formally take the threat of sanctions off the table. In the end, controls that allies adopt through their own volition are likely to prove more durable than those imposed on them by ultimatum. summary: TWZ 获得了有关海狼级潜艇康涅狄格号在 2021 年在南中国海与水下海山相撞后正在进行维修的新细节。海军一直在考虑大约三年的时间表来建造替换的船首声纳导流罩。最终，仅用了不到一年的时间就建成了。康涅狄格州的总体维修计划已被推迟，我们是第一个报告该船预计要到明年夏天才能恢复使用的人。编者注：这篇报道发表后，Janicki Industries 达成了
content:
TWZ 获得了有关海狼级潜艇康涅狄格号在 2021 年在南中国海与水下海山相撞后正在进行维修的新细节。海军一直在考虑大约三年的时间表来建造替换的船首声纳导流罩。最终，仅用了不到一年的时间就建成了。康涅狄格州的总体维修计划已被推迟，我们是第一个报告该船预计要到明年夏天才能恢复使用的人。编者注：这篇报道发表后，Janicki Industries 联系我们，要求在进行额外审查时删除圆顶的图像。出于礼貌，我们同意了，如果完全获得批准，我们将重新发布它。 Janicki Industries 今天告诉我们，该公司在大约 10 个月内生产出了新型船首声纳导流罩，并于 2024 年交付给海军。据其网站称，Janicki 拥有为美国核潜艇项目生产“声纳罩和精密加工硬件”的历史。它还支持各种备受瞩目的航空航天项目，包括 B-21 袭击者轰炸机和 F-35 联合攻击战斗机。根据一份经过大量编辑的海军事故报告，康涅狄格号的船头在五年前的碰撞事件发生后，最初至少在某种程度上仍然保持着连接状态。然而，当潜艇一瘸一拐地驶向关岛时，整个船首结构随后断裂。
随后，这艘船驶往加利福尼亚州圣地亚哥，然后前往华盛顿州的普吉特海湾海军造船厂和中间维护设施 (PSNS-IMF)，此后一直待在那里。 2023 年，在普吉特湾海军造船厂和中间维护设施中看到的康涅狄格号航空母舰，其船首圆顶明显缺失。美国海军“普吉特海湾海军造船厂和国际货币基金组织（中间维护设施）需要按照船的计划，在其后面没有生产线的情况下安装一个精密的替换圆顶，”贾尼基在撰写本文时还在其网站上表示。 “Janicki 比次佳选择快了 24 个月，因为工作所需的一切都集中在一个屋檐下：适合半球的 5 轴铣床、证明这一点的计量方法以及形成双曲板的 1,000 吨压力机。”本文顶部的部分图片和下面的完整图片显示了 Janicki 专有的五轴铣床在圆顶上工作的情况。海狼级潜艇艏声纳导流罩的尺寸和复杂性怎么强调都不为过。这些船上的船首声纳阵列直径为 24 英尺。圆顶本身的结构必须按照非常严格的规格建造，以使声纳系统正常工作。海狼级潜艇上的艏声纳阵列，其艏穹顶被拆除。公共领域 过去的五角大楼预算文件和国会拨款法案已经强调了更换康涅狄格州弓形声纳罩的预期成本和复杂性。
2021 年，立法者批准了 1000 万美元专门用于圆顶的资金，以及 4000 万美元用于其他“紧急维修”。全部维修费用仍不得而知，但预计将远高于 5000 万美元。 在 2024 年发布的 2025 财年预算提案中，海军还概述了购买额外船首圆顶的计划，以防其任何一艘“海狼”级潜艇再次遭受类似的严重事故。 “海狼级潜艇的保障战略不包括提供替换潜艇

【原文 English Original】
TWZ has obtained new details about the ongoing repairs to the Seawolf class submarine USS Connecticut following collision with an underwater seamount in the South China Sea in 2021. The Navy had been looking at a roughly three-year timeline for the construction of a replacement bow sonar dome. In the end, it took just under a year for it to be built. The overall schedule for repairs to Connecticut has suffered delays, and we were the first to report that the boat is now not expected to return to service until next summer. Editor’s note: After this story was published, Janicki Industries reached out to us to ask that the image of the dome be taken down while an additional review is conducted. Out of courtesy, we agreed, and we will repost it if and when it is fully approved. Janicki Industries produced the new bow sonar dome in approximately 10 months and delivered it to the Navy in 2024, the company told us today. Janicki has a history of producing “sonar domes and precision machined hardware” for U.S. nuclear submarine programs, according to its website . It has also supported various high-profile aerospace programs, including the B-21 Raider bomber and F-35 Joint Strike Fighter . Connecticut ’s bow had initially remained attached, at least to some degree, following the collision five years ago, according to a heavily redacted Navy report on the accident . However, the entire bow structure subsequently broke away as the submarine limped to Guam . The boat then sailed to San Diego, California , and then to the Puget Sound Naval Shipyard & Intermediate Maintenance Facility (PSNS-IMF) in Washington State, where it has been ever since. USS Connecticut seen at the Puget Sound Naval Shipyard & Intermediate Maintenance Facility in 2023 with its bow dome prominently missing. USN “Puget Sound Naval Shipyard & IMF [Intermediate Maintenance Facility] needed a precision replacement dome with no production line behind it, on the boat’s schedule,” Janicki also says on its website at the time of writing . “Janicki delivered it 24 months faster than the next-best option because everything the job needed sits under one roof: 5-axis mills that fit a hemisphere, the metrology to prove it, and the 1,000-ton press that forms double-curved plate.” The picture seen in part at the top of this story and in full below shows one of Janicki’s proprietary five-axis milling machines at work on the dome. The size and complexity of the bow sonar dome on Seawolf class submarines cannot be overstated. The bow sonar arrays on these boats is 24 feet in diameter. The structure of the dome itself has to be built to very exacting specifications for the sonar system to work properly. A look at the bow sonar array on a Seawolf class submarine with its bow dome removed. Public Domain Past Pentagon budget documents and appropriations bills from Congress had already highlighted the expected costs and complexities of replacing Connecticut ’s bow sonar dome. In 2021, lawmakers approved $10 million in funding specifically for the dome, as well as $40 million for other “emergent repairs.” The full repair bill is still unknown, but is expected to be far steeper than just $50 million. In its Fiscal Year 2025 budget proposal , released in 2024, the Navy also outlined plans to acquire an additional bow dome in case any of its Seawolf class submarines suffered another similarly severe mishap. “The Seawolf Class submarines sustainment strategy did not include the provisioning of replacement bow domes; therefore, no replacement bow domes for these in-service submarines are within the Navy’s inventory,” the budget documents explained. “This program would procure one Seawolf Class bow dome for use in the event replacement is required. Funds in FY25 are to purchase a bow dome which has a three plus year lead time.” Note here the mention of a lead time of at least three years, which is in line with Janicki’s statement that the “next-best option” would have taken two years more to do this work. As TWZ has highlighted in years of reporting now, repairs to Connecticut , in general, were always set to be challenging and costly due to the small size of the Seawolf class and the design being long out of production. The Navy originally planned to acquire 29 of these boats, but ultimately bought just three as a result of post-Cold War drawdowns. In addition, shrinking the program of record so severely caused the unit price of each one to rise substantially, just over $10 billion in 2025 dollars. At the time of writing, they are still the most costly attack submarines ever built. The last of the Seawolf class submarines, the highly secretive USS Jimmy Carter , which entered service in 2005, is also a heavily modified sub-type optimized for underwater espionage missions . USS Connecticut at sea in 2009. USN It is also worth noting that the U.S. Navy, as well as some of its foreign counterparts , have repaired similarly severe damage to submarines by cannibalizing entire sections from decommissioned boats in the same class. However, this is not an option given the size of the Seawolf class and the still very high demand for them operationally . The core design offers advanced capabilities that make even USS Seawolf and USS Connecticut especially well suited to a variety of specialized tasks . This is clearly why the Navy has continued to invest so much in returning Connecticut to the fleet. As mentioned, repairs to Connecticut are now not expected to be finished until sometime in the summer of next year. This is the latest in a succession of schedule slips in recent years. The original goal had been for the boat to be back in service by September 2025. “The Navy’s target completion date for the availability is the summer of 2027. PSNS & IMF is dedicated to executing this work with the highest standards of safety, technical accuracy, and craftsmanship to ensure the ship returns to the fleet ready to take its place at the tip of the spear in defense of our nation’s interests,” a Navy official told TWZ in September. “Current work consists of structural and systems restoration and required lifecycle maintenance.” Earlier in the year, the Navy also revealed that it is now planning on sending Connecticut into retirement in 2031. This means the submarine has just four more years of service ahead of it if the current repair schedule holds. The Navy does have plans to acquire a new class of nuclear attack submarines, currently referred to as SSN(X). In the past, the service has described those future boats as more of a direct successor to the Seawolf class than the versions of the Virginia class it is buying now. A picture of the first-in-class USS Seawolf . USN “The analytical conclusion was unequivocal: to dominate high-end peer threats in the middle of this century, a clean sheet design is required. The Virginia class is a fantastic, unmatched world-class warship, and it will remain the backbone of our attack fleet for decades,” Navy Rear Adm. Andrew Miller said at the Naval Submarine League’s main annual conference last week, per USNI News . “As adversary capabilities evolve, we require expanded payload capacity, greater electrical and hydrodynamic margins and unprecedented architectural flexibility that simply cannot be backfitted into an existing hull form.” Miller is currently the head of the Undersea Warfare Division with the Office of the Chief of Naval Operations. In terms of desired key capabilities for SSN(X), the Navy wants “first, higher flank speed and tactical control speed. Two, improved operational availability. Three, decisive lethality. Four, superior stealth and layered survivability, and finally organic robotic and autonomous systems hosting and command and control,” Miller added. “We are redefining the role of the submarine from a standalone hunter-killer to a capital mothership. By launching uncrewed systems directly from submarine torpedo tubes and integrating unmanned [robotic] vehicles into our battle plans, we dramatically expand the tactical reach of our manned fleet.” The first SSN(X) submarines are not expected to begin entering service until the mid-2040s, at the earliest. The Navy will continue acquiring Virginia class submarines in the interim. This includes stretched Block IV and V versions with Virginia Payload Modules (VPM) that will now be categorized as guided-missile types (SSGN). There will also be a one-of-a-kind seabed warfare version of the Virginia , which could well take over for the USS Jimmy Carter. A briefing slide from General Dynamics Electric Boat detailing existing and future planned subvariants of the Virginia class nuclear submarine. The Block VI and V types have now been reclassified as nuclear-powered guided missile submarines (SSGN) rather than nuclear-powered attack submarines (SSN). General Dynamics Electric Boat When it comes to USS Connecticut , if there are no further delays, the fully repaired submarine with its new bow sonar dome should be back in service by the middle of next year. Contact the author: joe@twz.com The post New Bow Sonar Dome For Heavily Damaged Submarine USS Connecticut Seen For The First Time (Updated) appeared first on TWZ .

Chinese v American Views on WAR with Taiwan
Posted Aug 14, 2026 by Martin Armstrong |
The Center for Strategic and International Studies conducted an extraordinary survey of 64 leading experts on China, Taiwan, and cross-Strait relations, including 28 former senior U.S. government officials, 23 former government policy and intelligence analysts, and 13 academics and think-tank experts. What their answers reveal is not that China is preparing to invade Taiwan tomorrow, as the neocons would like everyone to believe, but that Beijing remains willing to wait so long as nobody crosses the line of formal Taiwanese independence. Some 84% said Beijing is willing to wait for unification but will not accept the status quo permanently, while only 10% believed China seeks unification at the earliest opportunity. Not one of the 64 experts believed Beijing would ever accept an independent Taiwan.
This is precisely why Taiwan has become so dangerous. The West keeps portraying the conflict as if Xi Jinping wakes up every morning staring at a calendar trying to decide when to launch an amphibious invasion. Yet 83% of these experts said China did not plan to use significant kinetic force against Taiwan by 2027, and 80% said China’s enormous 2022 military exercises did not indicate Beijing had accelerated its timetable. Only 6% of respondents outside the former senior government group saw 2027 as a hard deadline, while not one former senior U.S. official did. The obsession with 2027 has nevertheless become extremely useful for the military establishment because every supposed deadline becomes another justification for weapons, deployments, bases, and spending.
The survey found that 44% believed Beijing has a hard deadline of 2049, the centennial of the People’s Republic, while 42% believed China could wait indefinitely provided unification remains possible. This is an important distinction because China thinks in terms of generations while Western politicians think in terms of the next election. Beijing does not need to invade Taiwan if economic, political, and military pressure can gradually change the situation in its favor. Only 20% of those surveyed believed China even possessed a coherent roadmap for peaceful unification, which tells us this is not some perfectly scripted invasion plan sitting in Xi’s desk drawer.
Where the numbers become alarming is not an unprovoked invasion but what happens when politicians begin crossing China’s red lines. More than three-quarters of the experts, 77%, believed China would invade within six months if Taiwan formally declared independence. Among former senior U.S. officials, that number was 79%. Even some of those who did not expect an immediate invasion believed Beijing would respond with a blockade or enormous military exercises. This is why politicians encouraging Taiwan toward formal independence are playing with the lives of 23 million people. They can deliver all the speeches they want about democracy from Washington, London, or Brussels, but they will not be the civilians sitting underneath the missiles if their political experiment goes wrong.
Not one expert believed an explicit American commitment to defend Taiwan would cause China to invade immediately, but 64% believed Beijing would respond strongly enough to provoke a U.S.-China or China-Taiwan crisis, while another 31% expected a more limited negative response. Only two of the 64 experts believed formally committing America to Taiwan’s defense would actually deter China from using force because Beijing already assumes that the United States will intervene anyway.
A direct invasion is not even the most likely path toward conflict. Only 8% of the experts described an amphibious invasion within ten years as likely, while 63% called it possible and 27% unlikely. Force short of invasion received much higher probabilities, with 52% saying deliberate escalation such as a blockade was likely or very likely. An accidental military incident was considered even more dangerous, with 34% saying a collision or accident around the Taiwan Strait was likely and another 22% calling it very likely. When warships and aircraft from opposing nuclear powers continually operate around the same small body of water, war does not require some grand master plan. It requires one mistake followed by politicians who refuse to back down.
A later CSIS survey of American and Taiwanese experts reinforces that point. Roughly 90% of U.S. experts and 62% of Taiwanese experts believed China already possessed the capability to impose a law-enforcement-led quarantine that substantially reduces trade into Taiwan. Around 80% of American experts and 60% of Taiwanese experts believed Beijing could execute a PLA blockade, while Taiwanese experts were considerably more skeptical that China could successfully carry out an invasion. If Beijing wanted to coerce Taiwan during the following five years, experts considered a quarantine the most likely option. If China decided it wanted immediate unification, however, approximately 80% regarded a highly kinetic joint blockade as likely or very likely.
This is where the economic consequences become enormous because Taiwan does not need to be invaded for the world economy to be thrown into chaos. A quarantine or blockade would immediately threaten shipping, insurance, semiconductor supply chains, electronics, automobiles, communications equipment, and virtually every modern industry dependent upon advanced chips. The later CSIS survey found most American and Taiwanese experts did not believe Taiwan could withstand a Chinese blockade for longer than three months without substantial U.S. intervention. Washington would then face the decision nobody wants to discuss honestly: accept China’s blockade or attempt to break it militarily and risk direct war between two nuclear powers.
Taiwan is also the world’s semiconductor pressure point. The island’s importance to advanced chip manufacturing means a serious blockade would not remain a regional event. Factories thousands of miles away could discover that a conflict they thought had nothing to do with them suddenly prevents them from obtaining critical components. Markets would begin repricing the risk immediately, shipping premiums would explode, companies would scramble for inventory, and governments would discover once again how fragile global supply chains have become. This is why capital will react long before politicians formally declare that a war has begun.
What I find particularly revealing in the later CSIS survey is the difference between American confidence and Taiwanese confidence in Washington. An astonishing 96% of American experts were completely or moderately confident that the United States would intervene militarily if China invaded Taiwan during the following five years. Taiwanese experts were less confident in American intervention and considerably less confident that U.S. allies would join the fight. It is always easier for people thousands of miles away to be certain about somebody else’s war.
This is precisely why Taiwan remains one of the critical geopolitical pressure points as we move toward 2029. The danger is not simply that China arbitrarily decides to invade. The greater danger is escalation, miscalculation, political promises that cannot be withdrawn, and Western policymakers convincing themselves that every additional provocation somehow produces deterrence. China has made its position on formal independence perfectly clear, and even the experts inside the Western foreign-policy establishment overwhelmingly acknowledge that Beijing would react with force if that line were crossed.
If Taiwan declares formal independence, 77% of the experts surveyed believed China would invade within six months. That is not a statistic policymakers should treat as another war-game scenario. It is a warning about what happens when politicians deliberately remove the ambiguity that has helped keep the peace.

香港隧道按时收费有效，官员建议保留收费中国劳工公告栏
星期五, 20 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港及中国劳工新闻（英文）
香港隧道按时间收费有效，官员建议保留收费
香港交通官员报告说，三条海底隧道和大榄隧道的计时收费有效缓解了交通拥堵。中九龙绕道九龙湾段将于12月6日通车。官员建议维持目前的通行费水平。
香港运输及物流局副秘书长于 11 月 20 日向立法会事务委员会表示，三条海底隧道和大榄隧道实行的计时收费已达到减少交通拥堵和改变驾驶习惯的目标。
政府于2023年12月对3条海底隧道实行计时收费，并于2025年5月31日接管大榄隧道，并同步实行计时收费，降低各类车辆的收费，以维持交通畅通，纾缓替代路线的压力。
副秘书长表示，最新的交通数据显示，这些措施在缓解拥堵、畅通过海交通、改变驾驶行为、促进交通分流等方面达到了预期效果和政策目标。目前的收费水平和分流措施是有效的，充分利用了隧道和替代路线的通行能力。
中九龙绕道的九龙湾段将于2026年12月6日通车。绕道的油麻地段已于2025年12月通车，已改善九龙区的整体交通状况，并缓解该区主要道路的挤塞情况。官员们预计，一旦整条绕道投入运营，将进一步加强九龙东西向的连通性。
鉴于现行措施的成效，政府建议暂时维持现有收费安排。官员们表示，他们将向委员会提交详细的幻灯片，并准备听取成员的意见。

Hong Kong tunnels' time-based tolls effective, officials recommend keeping fees | China Labour Bulletin Board
Friday, 20 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong tunnels' time-based tolls effective, officials recommend keeping fees
Hong Kong transport officials report that time-based tolls on three cross-harbour tunnels and the Tai Lam Tunnel have effectively eased congestion. The Middle Kowloon Bypass's Kowloon Bay section will open on 6 December. Officials recommend maintaining current toll levels.
Hong Kong's Deputy Secretary for Transport and Logistics told a Legislative Council panel on 20 November that time-based tolls introduced on three cross-harbour tunnels and the Tai Lam Tunnel have achieved their objectives of reducing congestion and changing driving habits.
The government launched time-based tolls on the three harbour tunnels in December 2023. It took over the Tai Lam Tunnel on 31 May 2025 and simultaneously implemented time-based charges, lowering fees for all vehicle types to maintain smooth traffic and relieve pressure on alternative routes.
According to the deputy secretary, the latest traffic data shows that the measures have produced the expected results and policy goals in easing congestion, smoothing cross-harbour traffic, altering driver behaviour and promoting traffic diversion. The current toll levels and diversion measures have been effective, making full use of the capacity of both the tunnels and alternative routes.
On the Middle Kowloon Bypass, the Kowloon Bay section will open on 6 December 2026. The Yau Ma Tei section of the bypass, which opened in December 2025, has already improved overall traffic conditions in the Kowloon district and eased congestion on major roads there. Officials expect that once the entire bypass is operational, it will further enhance east-west connectivity in Kowloon.
Given the effectiveness of the current measures, the government recommends temporarily maintaining the existing toll arrangements. Officials said they would present detailed slides to the committee and were ready to hear members' views.

香港教育局于11月20日宣布，2027学年酌情小学一年级(P1)学额结果将于11月23日星期一公布。共有32,104名儿童申请官立及资助小学的入学名额，其中18,148名儿童获酌情取录。
在提供的名额中，有 8,270 名儿童符合在学校有兄弟姐妹或父母在学校工作的资格。其余9,878名儿童按照积分制分配名额。
已开通P1电子平台账户的家长可于11月23日上午10点开始通过系统查询成绩。或者，他们可以在当天上午 9:00 至下午 5:00 之间前往所申请的学校，并携带纸质申请表的家长副本。
获得酌情学位的儿童的家长必须在 11 月 25 日星期三或 11 月 26 日星期四的办公时间内在学校完成注册。所需文件包括纸质申请表或电子平台电子记录的家长副本，以及指定数量的孩子照片。该局警告说，如果家长在没有事先与学校安排的情况下未能在这些日期注册，该名额将被视为放弃。
在小一收生制度下，酌情学额约占每所官立及资助学校总收生人数的50%，余下的50%则稍后在中央配位阶段分配。
教育局补充，没有获得酌情学位或只打算参与集中分配的申请人将于2027年1月中旬收到书面通知。他们必须于1月18日至24日期间通过电子平台提交学校偏好，或于1月23日至24日到指定的集中分配中心提交学校偏好。我们鼓励家长注册 iAM Smart+ 服务，以更方便地访问电子平台。 1月24日后收到的申请，须亲自到教育局学位分配办公室递交，安排将于2027年6月作出。教育局提醒所有家长，已获分配小一学位的孩子不能重新进入小一入学程序。

Hong Kong primary school allocation results out on 23 November | China Labour Bulletin Board
Friday, 20 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong primary school allocation results out on 23 November
Hong Kong's Education Bureau announced that 32,104 children applied for discretionary Primary 1 places, with 18,148 receiving offers. Results will be released on 23 November via an online platform or at schools. Parents must register by 26 November.
The Hong Kong Education Bureau announced on 20 November that results for discretionary Primary 1 (P1) school places for the 2027 academic year will be released on Monday, 23 November. A total of 32,104 children applied for places at government and aided primary schools, with 18,148 receiving discretionary offers.
Among those offered places, 8,270 children qualified under the category of having a sibling at the school or a parent employed there. The remaining 9,878 children were allocated places according to a points-based system.
Parents who have activated their P1 e-platform account can check results from 10:00 am on 23 November via the system. Alternatively, they may visit the school they applied to between 9:00 am and 5:00 pm on the same day, bringing the paper application form's parent copy.
Parents of children who received a discretionary place must complete registration at the school during office hours on either Wednesday, 25 November, or Thursday, 26 November. Required documents include the parent copy of the paper application form or the e-platform electronic record, along with a specified number of the child's photos. The bureau warned that if parents fail to register on those dates without prior arrangement with the school, the place will be considered forfeited.
Under the P1 admission system, discretionary places account for about 50 per cent of each government and aided school's total intake, with the remaining 50 per cent allocated later in the central allocation stage.
The Education Bureau added that applicants who did not receive a discretionary place, or who only intend to participate in the central allocation, will receive a written notice in mid-January 2027. They must submit school preferences between 18 and 24 January via the e-platform, or at designated central allocation centres on 23 or 24 January. Parents are encouraged to register for the iAM Smart+ service to access the e-platform more conveniently. Applications received after 24 January must be submitted in person at the bureau's School Places Allocation Office, with arrangements made in June 2027. The bureau reminded all parents that a child who has already been allocated a P1 place cannot re-enter the P1 admission process.

香港警告寒冷天气对老年人和慢性病患者的健康风险中国劳工公告栏
星期五, 20 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港及中国劳工新闻（英文）
香港警告寒冷天气对老年人和慢性病患者的健康风险
香港卫生部门敦促居民，尤其是老年人和患有慢性病的人，采取预防寒冷天气的措施。建议包括穿暖和的衣服、避免饮酒以及确保安全使用加热器。婴儿和户外工作者等弱势群体
香港特别行政区政府通过卫生防护中心于2026年11月20日发布健康提示，警告居民注意寒冷天气的风险，特别是对长者和患有长期疾病的人士。
该中心发言人表示，老年人的皮下脂肪普遍较少，体温调节能力减弱，身体对气温下降的反应较困难。高血压、糖尿病或甲状腺功能障碍等慢性疾病会进一步减慢新陈代谢并减少热量产生。患有呼吸系统或心血管疾病的人可能会因气温突然下降而病情恶化。
发言人建议公众，特别是老年人和慢性病患者，留意天气预报并穿着适当的防寒服装，包括帽子、围巾、手套和袜子。他们应该吃足够的食物以摄入足够的热量，进行适度的运动以促进循环和产热，并呆在温暖的环境中，避免在寒冷的早晚时间进行户外活动。还建议安全使用电加热器并保持室内适当通风。应避免饮酒，因为它会扩张血管，导致热量流失。任何感到不适的人都应立即就医。
对于婴儿和孕妇，发言人提醒家长，幼儿比成人散热更快。婴儿应穿轻便但足够的衣服，父母应确保安全的睡眠习惯：保持房间通风良好，让婴儿仰卧，头和脸不被遮盖，避免使用柔软的床上用品和枕头，并让婴儿单独睡在父母床边的婴儿床上。无烟环境至关重要。
户外工作人员应查看天气预报，穿着合适的衣服，并及时更换湿衣服。在寒冷天气警告期间，他们应采取预防措施，如果身体不适，应停止工作，寻求帮助和医疗护理。还建议公众接种季节性流感和 COVID-19 加强疫苗，因为包括流感和 COVID-19 在内的呼吸道病毒可能在冬季一起传播。有症状的人应佩戴外科口罩，避免去人群密集的地方，保持良好的卫生习惯。火锅食品的食品安全秘诀包括彻底煮熟、生熟分开以及在适当的温度下储存食材。
政府警告不要在通风不良的室内使用燃料燃烧设备，以防止一氧化碳中毒。市民如欲了解更多详情，可致电卫生署健康教育热线2833 0111或浏览卫生防护中心网页及Facebook专页。

Hong Kong warns of cold weather health risks for elderly and chronic patients
Hong Kong's health authorities urge residents, especially the elderly and those with chronic conditions, to take precautions against cold weather. Recommendations include wearing warm clothing, avoiding alcohol, and ensuring safe use of heaters. Vulnerable groups like infants and outdoor workers are
The Hong Kong Special Administrative Region Government, through its Centre for Health Protection, has issued a health advisory on 20 November 2026, warning residents about the risks of cold weather, particularly for the elderly and individuals with long-term illnesses.
A spokesperson for the centre stated that elderly people generally have less subcutaneous fat and diminished temperature regulation, making it harder for their bodies to respond to temperature drops. Chronic conditions such as hypertension, diabetes, or thyroid dysfunction can further slow metabolism and reduce heat production. Those with respiratory or cardiovascular diseases may see their conditions worsen due to sudden temperature drops.
The spokesperson advised the public, especially the elderly and chronically ill, to monitor weather forecasts and wear appropriate cold-weather clothing, including hats, scarves, gloves, and socks. They should eat enough food for adequate calorie intake, engage in moderate exercise to boost circulation and heat generation, and stay in warm environments, avoiding outdoor activities during colder morning and evening hours. Safe use of electric heaters and proper ventilation indoors are also recommended. Alcohol consumption should be avoided as it dilates blood vessels, leading to heat loss. Anyone feeling unwell should seek medical attention promptly.
For infants and pregnant women, the spokesperson reminded parents that young children lose heat faster than adults. Infants should wear lightweight but sufficient clothing, and parents should ensure safe sleeping practices: keep the room well-ventilated, place babies on their backs with heads and faces uncovered, avoid soft bedding and pillows, and allow babies to sleep alone in a cot next to the parents' bed. A smoke-free environment is essential.
Outdoor workers are urged to check weather reports, wear suitable clothing, and change wet clothes promptly. During a cold weather warning, they should take precautions and stop work if unwell, seeking help and medical care. The general public is also advised to get seasonal influenza and COVID-19 booster vaccinations, as respiratory viruses including influenza and COVID-19 may circulate together in winter. People with symptoms should wear surgical masks, avoid crowded places, and maintain good hygiene. Food safety tips for hotpot meals include thorough cooking, separating raw and cooked utensils, and storing ingredients at proper temperatures.
The government warns against using fuel-burning devices indoors without adequate ventilation to prevent carbon monoxide poisoning. For more information, residents can call the Department of Health's health education hotline at 2833 0111 or check the Centre for Health Protection's website and Facebook page.

香港拟斥资4.13亿港元设立楼宇维修支援局中国劳工公告栏
星期五, 20 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港及中国劳工新闻（英文）
香港拟斥资4.13亿港元设立楼宇维修支援局
香港计划拨款4.13亿港元成立楼宇维修支援及服务局。发展局表示，楼宇复修2.0计划将为楼龄30年或以上楼宇业主提供3.13亿港元资助，覆盖80%的楼宇。
根据发展局向立法会提交的一份文件，香港政府建议成立楼宇维修支援及服务局。该计划包括将现有的关怀计划余下约1.13亿港元转入新的支援服务，加上政府已预留的3亿港元，总额将达约4.13亿港元。
发展局表示，其中3.13亿港元将用于为需要支援的业主提供减费补贴。初步建议是将补贴重点放在建筑修复2.0计划所覆盖的建筑上，该计划覆盖了该市所有楼龄30年或以上的私人住宅和综合用途建筑的80%。
当局相信拟议的补贴安排将惠及绝大多数目标业主。对于其余20%的楼龄30年或以上且房价相对较高的建筑物，业主将被要求支付全额费用。政府将适时公布收费及补贴详情。
发展局表示，正为新局拟备委任及招聘人员所需的法定文件。预计下个月内完成公司注册程序并任命董事会。
该局还计划让第一批案件管理团队在下个月内开始工作。这些团队将联络约1,800个仍在招标计划下、尚未委任承包商的维修项目的业主，跟进后续安排。

Hong Kong plans HK$413 million building maintenance support bureau | China Labour Bulletin Board
Friday, 20 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong plans HK$413 million building maintenance support bureau
Hong Kong plans to establish a Building Maintenance Support and Services Bureau with HK$413 million in funding. The Development Bureau says HK$313 million will subsidise owners of buildings aged 30 years or more under the Building Rehabilitation 2.0 scheme, covering 80 per cent of such properties.
The Hong Kong government has proposed setting up a Building Maintenance Support and Services Bureau, according to a document submitted to the Legislative Council by the Development Bureau. The plan involves transferring the remaining balance of about HK$113 million from the existing Tender Care scheme into the new support service, which together with the HK$300 million already reserved by the government, will bring the total to about HK$413 million.
The Development Bureau said that of this amount, HK$313 million will be used to provide fee reduction subsidies for owners who need support. The initial proposal is to focus subsidies on buildings covered by the Building Rehabilitation 2.0 scheme, which covers 80 per cent of all private residential and composite-use buildings in the city that are 30 years old or older.
The authorities believe the proposed subsidy arrangement will benefit the vast majority of target owners. For the remaining 20 per cent of buildings aged 30 years or older with relatively high property prices, the owners will be required to pay the full fee. The government will announce fee and subsidy details in due course.
The Development Bureau noted that it is preparing the necessary statutory documents for the appointment and recruitment of staff for the new bureau. It expects to complete the company registration process and appoint the board of directors within the next month.
The bureau also aims to have its first batch of case management teams begin work within the next month. These teams will contact owners of about 1,800 maintenance projects that are still under the Tender Care scheme and have yet to appoint contractors, to follow up on subsequent arrangements.

content:
香港以数字方式发出土地税缴纳通知书中国劳工公告栏
星期五, 20 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港及中国劳工新闻（英文）
香港以数码方式发出土地税缴款通知书
香港地政总署已发出土地税缴纳通知书。付款人可以使用电子方式，包括自动借记卡、自动柜员机、电子支票、转数快或便利店。未缴税款必须由购房者在竣工时结清。
香港地政总署已发出土地税缴款通知书，提供多种缴款渠道。纳税人可透过电子方式缴付土地税，例如自动借记、银行自动提款机、电子支票或电子本票、转数快、缴费灵，或银行及缴费灵透过互联网提供的网上缴费服务。或者，付款人也可以亲临指定便利店以现金或易办事付款。进一步详情可浏览库务署网站（www.try.gov.hk）。
此外，付款人可将划线支票邮寄至香港深水埗邮政局邮政总局信箱28000号，或亲临任何一间邮政局付款。该部门建议确保足够的邮寄时间和邮资以确保正确投递；邮资不足的信件将不被接受。公众可致电香港邮政热线2921 2222或浏览其网站（www.hongkongpost.hk）查询各邮政局的地址及办公时间。
尚未收到付款通知的土地纳税人应联系地政总署的土地税及价格组。该组位于香港北角渣华道333号北角政府合署1楼，电话：2231 3033。
该部门提醒所有购房者让其律师确保已缴纳截至竣工之日的所有土地税。有关房产未缴土地税的信息，请致电 2231 3033 或发送电子邮件 [email protected] 查询账户余额。对于每项财产的账户余额的书面答复均需支付查询费。

Hong Kong issues land tax payment notices with digital options | China Labour Bulletin Board
Friday, 20 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong issues land tax payment notices with digital options
Hong Kong's Lands Department has issued land tax payment notices. Payers can use electronic methods including auto-debit, ATMs, e-cheques, FPS or convenience stores. Unpaid taxes must be cleared by property buyers at completion.
The Hong Kong Lands Department has issued land tax payment notices, offering multiple payment channels. Payers can settle their land tax through electronic methods such as auto-debit, bank automated teller machines (ATMs), electronic cheques or electronic cashier orders, the Faster Payment System (FPS), PPS, or online payment services provided by banks and PPS via the internet. Alternatively, payers may visit designated convenience stores in person to pay with cash or EPS. Further details are available on the Treasury Department's website (www.try.gov.hk).
In addition, payers can mail crossed cheques to GPO Box 28000, Sham Shui Po Post Office, Hong Kong, or make payment in person at any post office. The department advises ensuring sufficient mailing time and postage for correct delivery; letters with insufficient postage will not be accepted. For addresses and opening hours of post offices, the public can call the Hongkong Post hotline at 2921 2222 or visit its website (www.hongkongpost.hk).
Land taxpayers who have not received a payment notice should contact the Land Tax and Price Section of the Lands Department. The section is located at 1/F, North Point Government Offices, 333 Java Road, North Point, Hong Kong, and can be reached by phone at 2231 3033.
The department reminded all property buyers to have their solicitors ensure that all land tax up to the date of completion has been paid. For information on outstanding land tax on a property, call 2231 3033 or email [email protected] to inquire about account balances. A query fee applies for a written reply regarding the account balance for each property.

summary: 香港成为ICH监管成员，加速医疗中心计划 |中国劳工公告 星期五, 2026年11月20日 · 香港 香港和中国劳工英文新闻 香港成为 ICH 监管成员，加速医疗中心计划 香港成为人用药品注册技术要求国际协调会议 (ICH) 的第 20 个监管成员，时隔三年成为观察员。该市计划下个月成立药品医疗器械监管中心。香港成为国际互联网协会监管成员
content:
香港成为ICH监管成员，加速医疗中心计划 |中国劳工公告栏
星期五, 20 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港及中国劳工新闻（英文）
香港成为ICH监管成员 加速医疗中心计划
香港继成为观察员三年后，成为人用药品注册技术要求国际协调会议（ICH）的第20个监管成员。该市计划下个月成立药品医疗器械监管中心。
香港政府于2026年11月20日宣布，香港成为人用药品注册技术要求国际协调会议(ICH)的监管成员。该决定是在2026年11月17日于捷克共和国举行的ICH会议上作出的，香港药剂业及毒药管理局代表香港成为第20位监管成员。 ICH 的其他监管成员包括中国国家药品监督管理局以及来自欧洲、瑞士、英国和美国的监管机构。
卫生局局长卢仲茂教授表示，政府感谢国家支持香港发展成为国际医疗创新中心。他说，香港的加入体现了“一国、两种制度”原则的优势。香港于2023年10月31日成为ICH观察员，并在国家的支持下，在三年内满足成为正式成员的所有要求，远比政府根据国际经验估计的八至十年要快。
罗补充说，政府将按照香港特别行政区经济和社会发展第一个五年规划(2026-2030年)和国家“十五五”规划，推动生物医学临床研究，优化创新和急需药物的审评程序。政府将于下月成立药品医疗器械监管中心，建设独立药品审评能力并参与国际合作。
卫生署署长林伟强医生表示，加入ICH是香港药物审评和监管改革的一个重要里程碑，特别是对新中心而言。中心将按照ICH技术要求组建独立的专业审评团队，提高创新药审评效率，派出专家帮助起草和修订ICH指南。香港已是药品检验合作计划（PIC/S）的成员，并于2015年通过审核，并于2016年1月1日成为正式成员。
ICH协调全球药品注册技术要求，制定安全性、有效性和质量的国际标准，以保护公众健康。 PIC/S 引领国际药品开发，并实施严格的药品生产质量管理规范指南和药品检验质量管理体系。

Hong Kong becomes ICH regulatory member, accelerating medical hub plan | China Labour Bulletin Board
Friday, 20 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong becomes ICH regulatory member, accelerating medical hub plan
Hong Kong has become the 20th regulatory member of the International Conference on Harmonisation of Technical Requirements for Registration of Pharmaceuticals for Human Use (ICH), three years after becoming an observer. The city plans to set up a drug and medical device regulatory centre next month.
Hong Kong has become a regulatory member of the International Conference on Harmonisation of Technical Requirements for Registration of Pharmaceuticals for Human Use (ICH), the Hong Kong government announced on 20 November 2026. The decision was taken at an ICH meeting in the Czech Republic on 17 November 2026, with the Hong Kong Pharmacy and Poisons Board representing the city as the 20th regulatory member. Other ICH regulatory members include China's National Medical Products Administration and regulators from Europe, Switzerland, Britain and the United States.
Professor Lo Chung-mau, Secretary for Health, said the government thanked the nation for supporting Hong Kong's development into an international medical innovation hub. He said Hong Kong's membership demonstrated the advantages of the 'one country, two systems' principle. Hong Kong became an ICH observer on 31 October 2023 and, with national support, met all requirements to become a full member within three years, far quicker than the eight to ten years the government had estimated based on international experience.
Lo added that the government would follow the First Five-Year Plan for Economic and Social Development of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (2026-2030) and support the national 15th Five-Year Plan by boosting biomedical clinical research and optimising review procedures for innovative and urgently needed medicines. The government will set up a Drug and Medical Device Regulatory Centre next month to build independent drug review capacity and participate in international cooperation.
Dr Lam Wai-keung, Director of Health, said joining the ICH was a key milestone for Hong Kong's drug review and regulatory reform, especially for the new centre. The centre will build an independent professional review team following ICH technical requirements, improve review efficiency for innovative drugs, and send experts to help draft and revise ICH guidelines. Hong Kong is already a member of the Pharmaceutical Inspection Co-operation Scheme (PIC/S), having passed its audit in 2015 and become a full member on 1 January 2016.
The ICH coordinates global pharmaceutical registration technical requirements and sets international standards for safety, efficacy and quality to protect public health. The PIC/S leads international pharmaceutical development and implements strict good manufacturing practice guidelines and quality management systems for drug inspections.

content:
香港领导人表示，香港可以帮助提升建筑业的全球地位中国劳工公告栏
星期五, 20 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港及中国劳工新闻（英文）
香港领导人表示，香港可以帮助提升建筑业的全球地位
香港行政长官李家超表示，香港在将国家优势与国际机遇联系起来以及支持内地企业扩张方面具有优势，可以为中国加强建筑业全球地位的目标做出贡献。
行政长官李家超于11月20日表示，香港可以为“十五五”规划中制定的国家目标，即巩固和提高建造业的全球地位和竞争力作出贡献。他在国际基础设施项目领导力峰会上发表讲话时表示，该市将国家优势与国际机遇联系起来，并提供专业支持，将这些机遇转化为成功的项目。
李说，香港可以帮助内地建筑公司拓展业务，同时也支持国际合作伙伴在粤港澳大湾区、“一带一路”沿线市场以及其他地区寻找机遇。
李说，北方都市是香港第一个五年规划的核心项目，得到国家“十五五”规划的支持。该地区将占香港土地面积的三分之一，预计可容纳约250万人，约占香港总人口的三分之一。预计将创造50万个新就业岗位，贡献国内生产总值约13%。
李说，为了实现北方大都市的愿景，基础设施建设必须满足未来的需求，更注重质量而不是数量。他说，香港第一个五年计划提出利用智慧城市概念来规划交通、住房、绿化和公共设施，并补充说人工智能是关键驱动力。
李说，政府正在加速人工智能在各行业（特别是建筑业）的应用，以优化资源配置，提高生产率并提高成本效益。它还积极采用先进的工程技术和创新的施工方法和材料。

Hong Kong leader says city can help boost construction sector global standing | China Labour Bulletin Board
Friday, 20 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong leader says city can help boost construction sector global standing
Hong Kong Chief Executive John Lee said the city can contribute to China's goal of strengthening the global position of its construction industry, citing advantages in linking national strengths with international opportunities and supporting mainland firms' expansion.
Chief Executive John Lee said on 20 November that Hong Kong can contribute to the national goal, outlined in the 15th Five-Year Plan, of consolidating and enhancing the global standing and competitiveness of the construction industry. Speaking at the International Infrastructure Project Leadership Summit, he said the city links national strengths with international opportunities and provides professional support to turn those opportunities into successful projects.
Lee said Hong Kong can help mainland construction firms expand their business while also supporting international partners seeking opportunities in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, markets along the Belt and Road Initiative, and other regions.
The Northern Metropolis, a core project under Hong Kong's first five-year plan, has received support from the national 15th Five-Year Plan, Lee said. The area will cover one-third of Hong Kong's land area and is expected to accommodate about 2.5 million people, roughly one-third of the city's total population. It is projected to create 500,000 new jobs and contribute about 13 per cent of gross domestic product.
To realise the vision for the Northern Metropolis, Lee said infrastructure must be built to meet future demand, with greater emphasis on quality rather than quantity. Hong Kong's first five-year plan proposes using smart city concepts to plan transport, housing, greenery and public facilities, he said, adding that artificial intelligence is a key driver.
The government is accelerating the application of AI across industries, particularly construction, to optimise resource allocation, boost productivity and enhance cost-effectiveness, Lee said. It is also actively adopting advanced engineering techniques and innovative construction methods and materials.

summary: 香港欢迎中国发行20亿美元主权债券 |中国劳工布告栏 星期五, 2026 年 11 月 20 日·香港 香港和中国劳工英文新闻 香港欢迎中国发行 20 亿美元主权债券 香港财政司司长欢迎中国财政部在香港发行 20 亿美元主权债券，这是第七次此类发行。他概述了发展该市债券市场的计划，包括扩大发行、改善流动性和数字债券平台。 2026 年 11 月 20 日 10:35 香港时间 · 更新于 11 月 20 日 11:59 · 2 分钟阅读香港财政司司长
content:
香港欢迎中国发行20亿美元主权债券 |中国劳工公告栏
星期五, 20 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港及中国劳工新闻（英文）
香港欢迎中国发行20亿美元主权债券
香港财政司司长欢迎中国财政部在香港第七次发行20亿美元主权债券。他概述了发展该市债券市场的计划，包括扩大发行、改善流动性和数字债券平台。
2026 年 11 月 20 日 10:35 香港时间 · 更新于 11 月 20 日 11:59 · 阅读时间 2 分钟
香港财政司司长欢迎中国财政部于2026年11月20日在香港发行20亿美元主权债券。他在发行仪式上致辞时表示，这是财政部第七次在香港发行美元主权债券。
财政司司长指出，财政部多年来一直在香港发行债券，货币种类和种类不断扩大。人民币国债已连续18年在香港发行，累计发行规模超过5000亿元人民币。 2026年5月，财政部发行了首支人民币绿色主权债券，财政司司长表示，认购量超过发行量的十倍，显示出国际投资者的强劲需求。
这位官员表示，此次发行是中国更好利用国内外两个市场、两种资源、扩大高水平对外开放战略的关键一步。他表示，离岸主权债券发行为国际投资者提供了优质资产，有利于改善离岸人民币收益率曲线，提供定价基准。他指出，中国内地企业在海外发行的债券约有70%是在香港发行的。
财政司司长概述了扩大和深化香港债券市场的计划。香港政府计划在未来五年内每年发行约1500亿至2000亿港元的债券，为北领地开发等基础设施项目提供资金，并提供一系列货币和期限选择。他表示，政府还吸引了来自世界各地的发行人，并列举了印度尼西亚和哈萨克斯坦实体最近发行的“点心”债券。
财政司司长表示，为改善流动性，中国人民银行、香港金融管理局和证券及期货事务监察委员会于2026年7月宣布的措施正在落实中。其中包括计划建立的债券通电子交易平台以及探索集中式债券回购清算。自2026年11月上旬起，通过债券通持有的内地国债、政策性银行债券，以及财政部在境外发行的主权债券，均可作为香港交易所衍生品清算所的抵押品。
财政司司长还强调了建设下一代金融基础设施的努力，包括在数字平台上发行债券和促进债券代币化。他表示，自2023年以来，香港政府已发行四批代币化绿色债券，并将继续定期发行，以鼓励更广泛的参与。

Hong Kong welcomes China's USD 2bn sovereign bond issuance
Hong Kong's Financial Secretary welcomed the Chinese Ministry of Finance's USD 2 billion sovereign bond issuance in Hong Kong, the seventh such issuance. He outlined plans to develop the city's bond market, including expanded issuance, improved liquidity, and digital bond platforms.
20 Nov 2026 at 10:35 HKT · updated 20 Nov, 11:59 · 2 min read
Hong Kong's Financial Secretary welcomed the Chinese Ministry of Finance's issuance of USD 2 billion in sovereign bonds in the city on 20 November 2026. Speaking at the issuance ceremony, he said the event marked the seventh time the ministry had issued dollar-denominated sovereign bonds in Hong Kong.
The Financial Secretary noted that the ministry had been issuing bonds in Hong Kong for years, with an expanding range of currencies and types. Renminbi-denominated treasury bonds have been issued in Hong Kong for 18 consecutive years, with cumulative issuance exceeding RMB 500 billion. In May 2026, the ministry issued its first green sovereign bonds in renminbi, which the Financial Secretary said saw subscriptions exceeding ten times the issuance amount, demonstrating strong international investor demand.
The official described the issuance as a key step in China's strategy to better utilise domestic and international markets and resources to expand high-standard opening up. He said offshore sovereign bond issuance provided international investors with high-quality assets and helped improve the offshore renminbi yield curve, providing a pricing benchmark. He noted that about 70 per cent of bonds issued overseas by mainland Chinese companies are issued in Hong Kong.
The Financial Secretary outlined plans to broaden and deepen the city's bond market. The Hong Kong government plans to issue bonds worth about HKD 150 billion to HKD 200 billion annually over the next five years to fund infrastructure projects like the Northern Territories development and provide a range of currency and tenor options. He said the government was also attracting issuers from around the world, citing recent 'dim sum' bond issuances by entities from Indonesia and Kazakhstan.
To improve liquidity, the Financial Secretary said measures announced in July 2026 by the People's Bank of China, the Hong Kong Monetary Authority, and the Securities and Futures Commission were being implemented. These include a planned electronic trading platform by Bond Connect and exploration of centralised bond repurchase clearing. Since early November 2026, mainland treasury bonds and policy bank bonds held via Bond Connect, as well as sovereign bonds issued by the Ministry of Finance offshore, can be used as collateral on the Hong Kong Exchange's derivatives clearing house.
The Financial Secretary also highlighted efforts to build next-generation financial infrastructure, including issuing bonds on digital platforms and promoting bond tokenisation. He said the Hong Kong government had issued four batches of tokenised green bonds since 2023 and would continue to issue them regularly to encourage broader participation.

立法会下周讨论电价调整|中国劳工公告栏
星期五, 20 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港及中国劳工新闻（英文）
立法会下周讨论电费调整
香港两家电力公司将于下周二向立法会环境委员会提交年度电价检讨结果。中电 11 月份平均净电价为每千瓦时 148.6 分，自 1 月份以来上涨 5.7%，而港灯则为每千瓦时 183 分，上涨 12%。
香港两家电力公司将于下周二向立法会环境委员会提交年度电价检讨结果。这一进展是在立法会环境事务委员会发布最新议程之后进行的，其中包括两家电力公司代表将讨论他们的调查结果的会议。
香港的电价由两个主要部分组成：基本电价和燃料成本调整费。 11月份，中电的平均净电价为每千瓦时148.6分，较今年1月份上涨5.7%。与此同时，港灯11月净电价为每千瓦时183分，较1月上涨约12%。
港灯早前表示，国际石油及天然气价格持续波动，未来燃油调整收费水平将视乎全球燃油价格走势而定。该公司表示，将采取审慎的采购策略，尽量减少燃油价格波动对消费者的影响。
中电此前指出能源价格持续波动，并表示将密切监察市场发展，并采取多元化燃料策略，以维持合理的电价。
即将举行的立法会会议将为立法者提供一个平台，以审查拟议的调整及其对全市家庭和企业的影响。

Legislative Council to discuss power tariff adjustments next week | China Labour Bulletin Board
Friday, 20 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Legislative Council to discuss power tariff adjustments next week
Hong Kong's two power utilities will present their annual tariff review results to the Legislative Council environmental panel next Tuesday. CLP's November average net tariff was 148.6 cents per kWh, up 5.7 per cent since January, while HK Electric's was 183 cents, up 12 per cent.
Hong Kong's two power utilities will present their annual tariff review results to the Legislative Council environmental panel next Tuesday. The development follows the release of the LegCo Environmental Affairs Committee's latest agenda, which includes a session where representatives from both power companies will discuss their findings.
Electricity tariffs in Hong Kong consist of two main components: the basic tariff and the fuel cost adjustment charge. In November, CLP's average net tariff stood at 148.6 cents per kilowatt-hour, representing a 5.7 per cent increase from January this year. Meanwhile, HK Electric's November net tariff was 183 cents per kWh, up approximately 12 per cent from January.
HK Electric earlier stated that international oil and natural gas prices remain volatile, and the future level of fuel adjustment charges will depend on global fuel price trends. The company said it would adopt prudent procurement strategies to minimise the impact of fuel price fluctuations on consumers.
CLP previously noted that energy prices continue to be volatile, adding that it would monitor market developments closely and employ a diversified fuel strategy to help maintain reasonable electricity tariffs.
The upcoming LegCo session will provide a platform for lawmakers to scrutinise the proposed adjustments and their implications for households and businesses across the city.

summary: 中国、美国和俄罗斯总统周四在中国举行了前所未有的峰会，唐纳德·特朗普称这三人正在“创造历史”。 2026 年 11 月 19 日，在中国南部广东省深圳举行的亚太经合组织 (APEC) 峰会期间，中国国家主席习近平、美国总统唐纳德·特朗普和俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京抵达麒麟山庄举行三边会议。照片：Win McNamee/法新社。特朗普、习近平和普京在深圳麒麟山庄的闭门会晤结束后
content:
中国、美国和俄罗斯总统周四在中国举行了前所未有的峰会，唐纳德·特朗普称这三人正在“创造历史”。 2026 年 11 月 19 日，在中国南部广东省深圳举行的亚太经合组织 (APEC) 峰会期间，中国国家主席习近平、美国总统唐纳德·特朗普和俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京抵达麒麟山庄举行三边会议。照片：Win McNamee/法新社。特朗普、习近平和普京在深圳麒麟山庄的闭门会晤在1小时20分钟后结束。会议一开始，三人围坐在一张深色的大圆桌旁，围绕从核武器到乌克兰战争等重大话题发表了开场白，圆桌中央摆放着粉红色的插花。特朗普表示：“我很高兴这次访问也为我们提供了举行美国、俄罗斯和中国领导人首次三边会晤的机会。” “所以从这个意义上说，我认为在很多其他方面，我们确实在创造历史，”他补充道。分析人士预计，此次峰会的象征意义大于突破性进展，恰逢俄罗斯对乌克兰的攻势已接近五年大关，并引发了世界各地的恐慌和嘲笑。香港深水埗的一个摊位上展示着美国总统唐纳德·特朗普、中国国家主席习近平和俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京等人的面孔的磁铁。
照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP.Xi 告诉他的外长，这三个国家应该“共同维护世界和平与稳定”，而普京则表示，解决乌克兰战争具有共同利益。普京表示：“在解决地区冲突方面，我们两国有许多共同利益，当然也包括乌克兰冲突。”他补充说，他们“对维护国际和平与安全负有共同责任”。他表示，闭门讨论还将涉及粮食和能源安全——这两个领域都因伊朗和乌克兰的冲突而被颠覆。特朗普因与伊朗的战争而陷入困境，这场战争导致石油供应中断并推高了全球消费者价格，而崛起的中国正在寻求加强其在东亚的影响力。 “很高兴见到你” 麒麟别墅峰会引发了人们的担忧，担心这三位有权势的人想要将全球划分为势力范围，例如通过做出影响乌克兰而不是基辅或欧洲的决定。周四早些时候，特朗普和普京举行了自 2025 年 8 月以来的首次会面，这位 80 岁的美国总统称俄罗斯人为他的“朋友”，普京用英语回应：“很高兴见到你。”随后，特朗普和习近平今年第三次聚在一起进行一对一的讨论，美国领导人强调了他们“非常特殊的关系”。 2026 年 5 月 15 日，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普和中国国家主席习近平在北京中南海合影留念。

【原文 English Original】
The presidents of China, the United States and Russia held an unprecedented summit in China on Thursday, with Donald Trump saying the three men were “making history”. China’s President Xi Jinping, US President Donald Trump and Russia’s President Vladimir Putin arrive for a trilateral meeting at Kylin Villa on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) Summit in Shenzhen, in China’s southern Guangdong province, on November 19, 2026. Photo: Win McNamee/AFP. The meeting behind closed doors between Trump, Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin in Kylin Villa in Shenzhen ended after an hour and 20 minutes. At the start the three men made opening remarks touching on weighty topics from nuclear weapons to the war in Ukraine as they met around a large, dark round table with a pink flower arrangement at its centre. “I’m delighted that this trip has also given us the opportunity for this first ever trilateral meeting between the leaders of the United States, Russia and China,” Trump said. “So in that sense, and I think in lots of other ways, we are really making history,” he added. The summit, which analysts expect to be heavier in symbolism than breakthroughs, comes with Russia’s Ukraine offensive approaching the five-year mark, and has sparked both alarm and derision around the world. Magnets showing faces of US President Donald Trump, Chinese President Xi Jinping, and Russian President Vladimir Putin, alongside others, are displayed at a stall in Sham Shui Po, Hong Kong. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Xi told his counterparts that the three countries should “jointly safeguard world peace and stability”, while Putin said they had a shared interest to resolve the Ukraine war. “Our countries have many converging interests when it comes to resolving regional conflicts, including, of course, the conflict in Ukraine,” Putin said, adding they had a “shared responsibility for maintaining international peace and security”. He said the closed-door discussions would also touch on food and energy security — both of which have been upended by conflicts in Iran and Ukraine. Trump is bogged down by his war with Iran that has choked oil supplies and pushed up consumer prices worldwide, while an ascendant China is looking to strengthen its hand in East Asia. ‘Nice to meet you’ The Kylin Villa summit has stoked fears that the three powerful men want to divide the globe into spheres of influence, for example by making decisions impacting Ukraine over the heads of Kyiv or Europe. Earlier Thursday, Trump and Putin held a meeting — their first since August 2025 — with the 80-year-old US president calling the Russian his “friend”, who responded in English: “Nice to meet you.” Trump and Xi then came together — for the third time this year — for one-on-one discussions, with the US leader highlighting their “very special relationship”. US President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping pose for a photo at Zhongnanhai in Beijing on May 15, 2026. Photo: The White House, via Flickr. Putin, 74, and Xi, 73, held talks on Wednesday — their 50th meeting, the Chinese president said. Beijing, Washington and Moscow have given different accounts of the agenda for the three-way meeting on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) forum. Washington initially signalled that Ukraine was off the table, before Trump said the war would feature. Xi does not view the conflict as China’s problem to solve. Trump said in his meeting with Xi however that both China and the United States were “looking to both help with respect to the war with Russia and Ukraine”. China said before that the trio will hold “in-depth exchanges on safeguarding world peace and promoting strategic stability in major-power relations”. Ukraine President Volodymyr Zelensky (right) visits Bucha in April 2022, after the Russian invasion. Photo: Oleksandr Ratushniak. Critics warned that the optics from the meeting will be damaging for the US president — but a fillip to Xi and Putin. The meeting “gives Putin a platform to legitimise his war of aggression over Ukraine with seemingly little repercussions,” said Lyle Morris at the Asia Society Policy Institute. “Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin are playing Donald Trump like a cheap violin,” Senate Democratic leader Chuck Schumer said. Nuclear disarmament Washington had also flagged up the Iran war and nuclear disarmament as topics of discussion, after a US-Russia bilateral treaty on atomic weapons expired in February. Beijing has long maintained that the United States and Russia must reduce their giant nuclear arsenals before it agrees to talks on its smaller stockpile. China’s nuclear arsenal. Photo: CCTV screenshot. “As the world’s three largest nuclear powers by far, the United States, Russia and China are uniquely positioned to discuss how to reduce the number of nuclear weapons on Earth and also to lessen the risk that those weapons will ever be used,” Trump said. Airport welcome Thursday’s extraordinary meeting preceded equally unusual scenes as the leaders arrived in the southern Chinese city for the talks. Breaking with decades of diplomatic protocol, Xi received Trump at the airport, with the men briefly hugging before a red-carpet greeting complete with cheering children and an air force flyover. This reciprocated the airport greeting Trump gave Xi at Joint Base Andrews in September. “It’s a friendship relationship. It’s a respect relationship,” Trump told Fox News. Takaichi, on her first visit since angering Beijing a year ago with comments about Taiwan, met Putin — relations are also tense — on Wednesday, Tokyo said. Takaichi said Thursday she wanted a “constructive and stable relationship” with China, but Japanese media said she did not manage to get a one-to-one meeting with Xi in Shenzhen. Despite their differences, all the leaders — including Putin — posed for the APEC “family photo” on Thursday in special scarves.
