Managed money net long positions on Comex have fallen from more than 80,000 contracts six weeks ago to about 35,000, close to a 14-month low, according to Saxo. Hansen put the next chart supports at $5.63 and $5.32 a pound. The first of those, which is also where copper ended 2025, gave way later in the session. Record premium, falling price The rout comes with the physical market in China as tight as it has been in years. The Yangshan premium paid to import copper into the country jumped by about a fifth to a record $360 a tonne on Wednesday, Reuters reports, up from less than $100 in September. Shanghai Futures Exchange stocks dropped 18% last week to 27,642 tonnes, the lowest since December 2023, and the November contract expired on Monday at a premium of more than $2,000 a tonne to December, a squeeze that forced the exchange to intervene . Investors increasingly doubt the Trump administration will press ahead with tariffs on refined copper after this month’s midterm elections, and the spike in Chinese prices has created the commercial case for traders to ship metal out of the United States, where warehouses hold roughly 85% of the 1.09 million tonnes in exchange-monitored stocks. The assumption that those inventories would stay stranded unless tariffs were formally ruled out has been shaken, Bloomberg reports. Supply news ignored Chile’s copper commission Cochilco expects national output to fall 8.4% this year to 4.94 million tonnes, the lowest in 23 years , after production dropped 8.5% to 3.63 million tonnes in the first nine months. The country’s leaching operations are also exposed to sulphuric acid supply: imports hit a record 3.97 million tonnes last year, about half of consumption, and China supplied 37% of that before restricting exports in May. In Shanghai, where the industry has gathered for annual supply talks, China’s Nonferrous Metals Industry Association said concentrate-fed smelting capacity has nearly reached a ceiling and promised a monitoring mechanism to bring treatment charges back to sustainable levels. Spot charges sank to a record minus $247.20 a tonne on November 6, meaning smelters pay miners for the privilege of processing their concentrate. The 2026 benchmark was set at zero, and 21 of 35 industry participants polled by Reuters expect a negative number for 2027, with forecasts from minus $50 to minus $150. Snowdon argued that the more negative the benchmark, the healthier the market in the long run. Freeport Indonesia is meanwhile offering 2027 cathode from its Manyar smelter to Chinese buyers at a premium of $158 a tonne, Reuters reports, citing two sources. The MINING.COM TOP 50 ranking of the world’s most valuable miners had already lost $226 billion in October. The top 50 biggest mining companies in the world (With files from Reuters and Bloomberg)

title: Hong Kong police arrest five over illegal drone flights during Shenzhen APEC summit
zh_title: 香港警方在深圳APEC峰会期间逮捕五名非法无人机飞行者
summary: 在世界领导人齐聚邻近的中国城市深圳参加亚太经济合作组织峰会之际，香港警方因非法无人机操作逮捕了五人。 2026年11月17日至19日，香港警方在深圳举办亚太经合组织峰会期间逮捕了五名未经许可操作无人机的人。照片：警察。警方周四表示，两名年龄分别为 27 岁和 65 岁的男子分别在上水凤皇岭村和粉岭乐明街被捕，罪名是涉嫌在禁飞区操作无人机和非法飞行。
content:
在世界领导人齐聚邻近的中国城市深圳参加亚太经济合作组织峰会之际，香港警方因非法无人机操作逮捕了五人。 2026年11月17日至19日，香港警方在深圳举办亚太经合组织峰会期间逮捕了五名未经许可操作无人机的人。照片：警察。警方周四表示，两名年龄分别为 27 岁和 65 岁的男子分别在上水凤凰岭村和粉岭乐明街被捕，罪名是涉嫌在禁飞区内操作无人机以及违反飞机相关规定。警方在脸书上发帖称，周四午夜，另一名 20 岁男子因驾驶无人机在流浮山被捕。警方早些时候表示，周二，又有两名男子因操作无人机而分别在南生围和天水围被捕，分别为 40 岁和 67 岁。警方表示，警方在逮捕过程中缴获了无人机，并补充说刑事调查部门正在调查这些案件。香港警方于2026年11月17日至19日期间逮捕了五人，罪名是在深圳举行亚太经合组织峰会期间未经许可操作无人机。照片：警察。由于邻近的深圳主办亚太经合组织（APEC）峰会，香港当局在周五之前实施了为期四天的禁飞区，禁止未经授权的无人机飞越该市北部空域的大部分地区。
包括中国国家主席习近平、美国总统唐纳德·特朗普和俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京在内的世界领导人齐聚中国南方科技中心。习近平、特朗普和普京周四举行了历史性的三边会议。警方敦促居民在周四闭幕的亚太经合组织峰会期间操作无人机之前，先查看政府有关禁飞区的通知。根据《小型无人机令》，未经许可在飞行限制区内操作无人机即属犯罪，最高可被处以罚款 10 万港元及监禁两年。

【原文 English Original】
Hong Kong police have arrested five people over illegal drone operations as world leaders gather in the neighbouring Chinese city of Shenzhen for the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit. Hong Kong police arrested five people between November 17 and 19, 2026, for operating drones without a permit as Shenzhen holds the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit. Photo: Police. Police said on Thursday that two men, aged 27 and 65, were arrested in Sheung Shui’s Fung Wong Leng Estate and Fanling’s Lok Ming Street, respectively, for allegedly operating drones within restricted flight areas and violating aircraft-related rules. Another man, aged 20, was arrested in Lau Fau Shan at midnight on Thursday for flying a drone, police said in a Facebook post. Two more men, aged 40 and 67, were apprehended in Nam Sang Wai and Tin Shui Wai, respectively, on Tuesday over operating drones, police said earlier. Officers seized the drones during the arrests, police said, adding that the cases were being investigated by criminal investigation units. Hong Kong police have arrested five people between November 17 and 19, 2026, for operating drones without a permit as Shenzhen holds the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit. Photo: Police. Hong Kong authorities have imposed a four-day restricted flying zone through Friday as neighbouring Shenzhen hosts the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit, banning unauthorised drone flights across much of the city’s northern airspace. World leaders, including Chinese President Xi Jinping, US President Donald Trump, and Russian President Vladimir Putin, have gathered in the southern Chinese tech hub. Xi, Trump and Putin held a historic trilateral meeting on Thursday. Police urged residents to check for government notices regarding the restricted flying zone before operating drones during the APEC summit, which closed on Thursday. Under the Small Unmanned Aircraft Order, operating a drone without permission within a restricted flying zone is an offence carrying a maximum penalty of a HK$100,000 fine and two years’ imprisonment.

title: Japan Pledges Drones, Coastal Defense Radar in Latest Philippine Defense Package
zh_title: 日本承诺在菲律宾最新的国防计划中提供无人机和海防雷达
source: 美国海军学院工作人员（大量国会报告每周2-3次）
summary: BRP Jose Rizal 与两艘日本海上自卫队舰艇进行演习。菲律宾海军照片 日本将在东京最新的防御计划中向菲律宾军方转让无人机和海岸防御雷达系统，以增强马尼拉的军队。日本驻菲律宾大使北川胜郎和菲律宾外交部长特蕾莎·拉扎罗周一签署了一项协议，涵盖通过官方安全援助计划提供价值高达 2700 万美元的防务转移。此次援助标志着首次通过
content:
BRP Jose Rizal 与两艘日本海上自卫队舰艇进行演习。菲律宾海军照片 日本将在东京最新的防御计划中向菲律宾军方转让无人机和海岸防御雷达系统，以增强马尼拉的军队。日本驻菲律宾大使北川胜郎和菲律宾外交部长特蕾莎·拉扎罗周一签署了一项协议，涵盖通过官方安全援助计划提供价值高达 2700 万美元的防务转移。据日本外务省周一发布的新闻稿称，此次援助标志着首次通过专用海岸雷达系统向菲律宾转移国防设备。该雷达将由菲律宾海军操作，菲律宾海军是日本类似监视系统的先前接收者。上个月在马尼拉举行的日本自卫队成立 72 周年招待会上，日本公司展示了各种打算出售或转让给菲律宾军方的海岸监视系统。这些雷达包括能够跟踪 24 海里外船只的短程系统，以及能够感知 140 海里外海上目标的功能更强大的多用途雷达。除了海域意识援助外，菲律宾空军还将接收型号和数量不详的无人机。 2025年夏天，东京通过OSA向马来西亚转让了14架Aerobo Wing AS-VT02A无人机，价值高达270万美元。
此次移交是马尼拉和东京之间的首次无人移交。此前，日本将TC-90涡轮螺旋桨飞机移交给菲律宾海军航空联队用于海上巡逻。日本大使馆的新闻稿称：“该项目对于进一步促进日本和菲律宾之间的安全合作、加强日本重要海上通道的安全以及维护和加强地区和平与稳定具有重要意义。”近年来，由于对南中国海和吕宋海峡的共同担忧，东京与马尼拉寻求更密切的防务关系。自 2010 年代以来一些最重要的进展包括承诺为菲律宾海岸警卫队提供 17 艘巡逻舰，以及日本自卫队作战部队抵达东南亚群岛进行演习。今年，日本军队与美国、菲律宾和加拿大军队一起演习，保卫吕宋岛北部的海滩。东京首次全面实战演习以在击沉演习中发射反舰导弹而达到高潮。新的国防装备转让指南也为前日本自卫队装备出售或转让给菲律宾军方开辟了新的机会。目前正在讨论将即将退役的阿巴库巴级护卫舰转移给菲律宾海军。

【原文 English Original】
BRP Jose Rizal conducts exercises with two Japan Maritime Self-Defense ships. Philippine Navy photo Japan will transfer unmanned aerial vehicles and a coastal defense radar system to the Philippine military in Tokyo’s latest defense package to bolster Manila’s forces. Japanese Ambassador to the Philippines Katsuro Kitagawa and Philippine Secretary of Foreign Affairs Theresa Lazaro signed an agreement on Monday covering the defense transfer worth up to $27 million via the Official Security Assistance program. The assistance marks the first transfer of defense equipment to the Philippines via a dedicated coastal radar system, as classified by a Japanese Ministry of Foreign Affairs news release published on Monday. This radar will be operated by the Philippine Navy, which has been the previous recipient of similar surveillance systems from Japan. At the 72nd Japan Self-Defense Force anniversary reception in Manila last month, Japanese firms showcased a variety of coastal watch systems intended for sale or transfer to the Philippine military. These ranged from short-range systems capable of tracking vessels out to 24 nautical miles to more capable multirole radars that can sense maritime targets 140 nautical miles away. Alongside the maritime domain awareness assistance, the Philippine Air Force will receive an unspecified variant and quantity of UAVs. In the summer of 2025, Tokyo transferred 14 Aerobo Wing AS-VT02A UAVs worth up to $2.7 million to Malaysia through OSA. The latest transfer is the first instance of unmanned transfers between Manila and Tokyo. Previously, Japan handed over TC-90 turboprops to the Philippine Naval Air Wing for maritime patrols. “This project is of great importance in further promoting security cooperation between Japan and the Philippines, enhancing security of important sea lanes for Japan, and contributing to maintaining and strengthening regional peace and stability,” reads the Japanese Embassy release. In recent years, Tokyo has pursued closer defense relations with Manila amid mutual concerns over the South China Sea and Luzon Strait. Some of the most significant developments since the 2010s include the commitment of 17 patrol ships for the Philippine Coast Guard and the arrival of Japan Self-Defense Force combat troops for drills across the Southeast Asian archipelago. This year, Japanese troops drilled alongside American, Philippine and Canadian forces to defend a beach in Northern Luzon. Tokyo’s full-scale combat exercise debut culminated with the launch of anti-ship missiles at a sinking exercise. New defense equipment transfer guidelines are also opening up new opportunities for ex-JSDF equipment to be sold or transferred to the Philippine military. Discussions are ongoing to transfer soon-to-be retired Abakumba-class destroyer escorts to the Philippine Navy.

title: Spartan puts $683 million price tag on Victorio moly, tungsten mine in New Mexico
zh_title: Spartan 对新墨西哥州 Victorio 钼钨矿标价 6.83 亿美元
source: MINING.COM 全球矿业（稀土/关键矿产）
summary: Spartan Metals（多伦多证券交易所代码：W；美国场外交易代码：SPRMF）估计，在新墨西哥州维多里奥建造一座地下钨钼矿将耗资 6.83 亿美元，并建有一座工厂，将钨精矿转化为切削工具和其他工业产品的原料。根据周四发布的初步经济评估，该项目位于州首府圣达菲西南约 440 公里处，将运营 24 年。该研究估计，按 8% 的贴现率和 31% 的内部收益率计算，税后净现值 (NPV) 为 21.4 亿美元。该项目还需要20.3亿美元
content:
Spartan Metals（多伦多证券交易所代码：W；美国场外交易代码：SPRMF）估计，在新墨西哥州维多里奥建造一座地下钨钼矿将耗资 6.83 亿美元，并建有一座工厂，将钨精矿转化为切削工具和其他工业产品的原料。根据周四发布的初步经济评估，该项目位于州首府圣达菲西南约 440 公里处，将运营 24 年。该研究估计，按 8% 的贴现率和 31% 的内部收益率计算，税后净现值 (NPV) 为 21.4 亿美元。该项目还需要 20.3 亿美元的支出来维持整个生命周期的运营。斯巴达首席执行官布雷特·马什（Brett Marsh）在新闻稿中表示：“这两种金属都对这些经济做出了贡献，因此任何一种金属的持续价格上涨都可以对潜在的项目经济产生有意义的影响。” “维多利亚可能成为美国工业和国防客户持久的国内钨和钼来源。”根据美国地质调查局的数据，美国上一次商业开采钨是在 2015 年。 S&P Global 的数据显示，中国约占全球精炼仲钨酸铵产能的 85%，仲钨酸铵是 Victorio 生产的中间产品。据 Fastmarkets 周四报道，尽管一些买家对价格上涨犹豫不决，但中国的出口管制仍导致供应紧张。周四，Spartan 股价在多伦多收于每股 26 美分不变，该公司估值约为 1,540 万加元（1,070 万美元）。
价格敏感性 该研究假设每 10 公斤三氧化钨为 1,350 美元，每磅钼为 20 美元。在测试的最低价格下，三氧化钨每 10 公斤 750 美元，钼每磅 15 美元，税后 NPV 降至 3.92 亿美元，回报率降至 14%。维多利亚会使用块崩落法，这是一种利用重力破碎岩石的地下方法。该研究预计每年可回收仲钨酸铵中约 4,100 吨三氧化钨，以及精矿中约 865 万磅钼。推断资源量占预定植物饲料的 39%。 8 月份的资源估算显示，测得和指示资源量为 7670 万吨，三氧化钨品位为 0.1%，钼品位为 0.09%，分别含有 1.655 亿磅和 1.479 亿磅。另外推断品位为 0.09% 三氧化钨和 0.06% 钼的产量为 9,240 万吨，分别为 1.876 亿磅和 1.3 亿磅。下一步 斯巴达计划将维多利亚推进到预可行性阶段。该研究建议投入 1,320 万美元的工作，包括钻探、冶金测试以及供水和尾矿研究。斯巴达对多尼根资源公司的核心索赔拥有选择权。行使该权利需要现金支付、1400万美元的勘探支出以及根据3月份协议在2034年之前进行可行性研究。其他钨项目正在北美其他地区推进。
加拿大联邦政府周一有条件批准了 Fireweed Metals（多伦多证券交易所代码：FWZ；美国场外交易代码：FWEDF）最多 1,400 万加元的融资，以帮助推进其 Mactung 钨项目做出建设决定。

【原文 English Original】
Spartan Metals (TSXV: W; US-OTC: SPRMF) estimates it would cost $683 million to build an underground tungsten and molybdenum mine at Victorio in New Mexico, with a plant to turn tungsten concentrate into a feedstock for cutting tools and other industrial products. The project, about 440 km southwest of state capital Santa Fe, would operate for 24 years, according to a preliminary economic assessment released Thursday. The study estimates an after-tax net present value (NPV) of $2.14 billion, at an 8% discount rate, and a 31% internal rate of return. The project requires another $2.03 billion in spending to sustain the operation over its life. “Both metals contribute to those economics, so continued price appreciation for either metal can make a meaningful difference to the underlying project economics,” Spartan CEO Brett Marsh said in the release. “Victorio could become a lasting domestic source of tungsten and molybdenum for U.S. industrial and defense customers.” The United States last mined tungsten commercially in 2015, according to the U.S. Geological Survey. China accounts for about 85% of global capacity to refine ammonium paratungstate, the intermediate product Victorio would make, according to S&P Global. China’s export controls are keeping supply tight even as some buyers balk at elevated prices, Fastmarkets reported Thursday. Spartan shares closed unchanged at C26¢ apiece on Thursday in Toronto, valuing the company at about C$15.4 million ($10.7 million). Price sensitivity The study assumes $1,350 per 10 kg of tungsten trioxide and $20 per lb. of molybdenum. At the lowest prices tested, $750 per 10 kg for tungsten trioxide and $15 per lb. for molybdenum, the after-tax NPV falls to $392 million and the return to 14%. Victorio would use block caving, an underground method that uses gravity to break the rock. The study projects annual recovery of about 4,100 tonnes of tungsten trioxide contained in ammonium paratungstate and 8.65 million lb. of molybdenum in concentrate. Inferred resources account for 39% of scheduled plant feed. An August resource estimate puts measured and indicated resources at 76.7 million tonnes grading 0.1% tungsten trioxide and 0.09% molybdenum, containing 165.5 million lb. and 147.9 million lb., respectively. Another 92.4 million inferred tonnes grade 0.09% tungsten trioxide and 0.06% molybdenum, for 187.6 million lb. and 130 million lb., respectively. Next steps Spartan plans to advance Victorio to prefeasibility. The study recommends $13.2 million of work, including drilling, metallurgical testing and studies of water supply and tailings. Spartan has an option on the core claims from Donegan Resources. Exercising it requires cash payments, $14 million in exploration spending and a feasibility study by 2034 under a March agreement. Other tungsten projects are advancing elsewhere in North America. Canada’s federal government on Monday conditionally approved up to C$14 million in financing for Fireweed Metals (TSX: FWZ; US-OTC: FWEDF) to help advance its Mactung tungsten project toward a construction decision.

title: MicroQuanta, Zhejiang University achieve world-record efficiency of 23.9% for 19.48 cm² perovskite solar module
zh_title: 浙江大学微广达19.48 cm²钙钛矿太阳能电池组件效率达到23.9%，创下世界纪录
summary: 由中国钙钛矿太阳能电池制造商微广半导体科学家领导的研究团队，在19.48平方厘米的钙钛矿微型组件上实现了23.9%的稳态效率认证，创下了新的世界纪录。研究人员表示，这一结果是通过在真空处理之前冷却湿钙钛矿前体薄膜来减缓结晶速度并减少与从电池扩大到模块相关的填充因子损失而实现的。 “我们的结果的特别之处在于，世界纪录是在模块级别实现的，而不是在小型实验室单元中实现的，”相应的
content:
由中国钙钛矿太阳能电池制造商微广半导体科学家领导的研究团队，在19.48平方厘米的钙钛矿微型组件上实现了23.9%的稳态效率认证，创下了新的世界纪录。研究人员表示，这一结果是通过在真空处理之前冷却湿钙钛矿前体薄膜来减缓结晶速度并减少与从电池扩大到模块相关的填充因子损失而实现的。 “我们的结果的特别之处在于，世界纪录是在模块级别实现的，而不是在小型实验室单元中实现的，”通讯作者东辰兰告诉光伏杂志。 “太阳能电池在放大成模块时通常会降低效率。”该结果得到了中国福建省计量院国家光伏产业计量测试中心（NPVM）的认证。 Lan 表示，该团队确定了这些损失的主要原因，并展示了一种减轻损失的方法，同时帮助模块长期保持其性能。他说：“这解决了使下一代太阳能技术更接近实际应用的关键挑战。”研究人员首先将实验室规模的钙钛矿太阳能电池与之前研究中在匹配的加工条件下制造的微型模块进行了比较。
他们使用沙普利值分析（对所有可能的替代顺序中每个参数的贡献进行平均）来量化开路电压、短路电流密度和填充因子对测量的效率损失的贡献。在考虑了激光划片产生的非活动区域的电流损失后，他们发现填充因子是导致从电池到模块效率下降的最大因素。有或没有前驱体冷却的电池性能为了减少这种损失，该团队将钙钛矿前驱体旋涂到带有两个空穴传输层（HTL）的氧化铟锡（ITO）涂层玻璃上。涂覆后，他们立即将湿膜冷却15秒至0-10℃，在约5秒内将其转移到真空室中，真空闪蒸两分钟，然后在110℃下退火30分钟。然后，他们应用表面钝化层并沉积电子传输层（ETL）和银（Ag）电极。成膜过程中的测量表明，冷却减缓了中间相向钙钛矿的转化，产生晶粒更大、更均匀的薄膜。研究人员使用槽模涂层制造了一个 19.48 cm2 的钙钛矿微型模块，该模块由通过激光划片串联的八个子电池组成。该器件构建在涂有氧化铟锡 (ITO)、氧化镍 (NiOₓ) 和称为 3PATAT-C3 的自组装单分子层的玻璃基板上。
它采用甲脒铯碘化铅 (FA₀.₉₅Cs₀.₀₅PbI₃) 吸收剂和二碘化乙二胺 (EDAI2) 表面钝化层、富勒烯 (C₆₀) 电子传输层、浴铜灵 (BCP) 缓冲层和银 (Ag) 电极。根据团队的测量，该微型模块经认证的稳态效率为 23.9%，填充因子为 83.3%，据作者报道，这是钙钛矿模块中最高的。它还具有 97% 的几何填充因子，这意味着 97% 的孔径面积具有光活性。在开路连续一太阳照明下的单独老化测试中，采用冷却步骤制造的模块中，由于填充因子下降而导致的效率损失不到三分之一

【原文 English Original】
A research team led by scientists from Chinese perovskite solar cell manufacturer MicroQuanta Semiconductor has achieved a certified steady-state efficiency of 23.9% for a 19.48 cm² perovskite mini-module, setting a new world record. The researchers said the result was enabled by cooling the wet perovskite precursor film before vacuum treatment to slow crystallization and reduce the fill factor losses associated with scaling up from cells to modules. “What makes our result special is that the world record is achieved at the module level, rather than in a small laboratory cell,” corresponding author Dongchen Lan told pv magazine . “Solar cells often lose efficiency when scaled up into modules.” The result was certified by the National PV Industry Measurement and Testing Center (NPVM) of China’s Fujian Metrology Institute . Lan said the team identified a major cause of these losses and demonstrated a way to mitigate them while helping modules maintain their performance over time. “This addresses a key challenge in bringing next-generation solar technologies closer to practical use,” he said. The researchers first compared laboratory-scale perovskite solar cells with mini-modules fabricated under matched processing conditions in previous studies. They used Shapley value analysis, which averages the contribution of each parameter across all possible orders of substitution, to quantify the contributions of open-circuit voltage, short-circuit current density, and fill factor to the measured efficiency loss. After accounting for current losses in inactive areas created by laser scribing, they found that fill factor was the largest contributor to the efficiency drop from cells to modules. Cell performance with and without precursor cooling To reduce that loss, the team spin-coated a perovskite precursor onto indium tin oxide (ITO)-coated glass carrying two hole-transport layers (HTLs). Immediately after coating, they cooled the wet film for 15 seconds to 0-10 C, transferred it to a vacuum chamber within about five seconds, and vacuum-flashed it for two minutes before annealing it at 110 C for 30 minutes. They then applied a surface passivation layer and deposited the electron-transport layers (ETLs) and silver (Ag) electrode. Measurements during film formation showed that cooling slowed the conversion of an intermediate phase into perovskite, yielding films with larger, more uniform grains. The researchers used slot-die coating to fabricate a 19.48 cm² perovskite mini-module consisting of eight subcells connected in series through laser scribing. The device was built on a glass substrate coated with indium tin oxide (ITO), nickel oxide (NiOₓ), and a self-assembled monolayer known as 3PATAT-C3. It featured a formamidinium-cesium lead iodide (FA₀.₉₅Cs₀.₀₅PbI₃) absorber with an ethylenediammonium diiodide (EDAI₂) surface passivation layer, a fullerene (C₆₀) electron transport layer, a bathocuproine (BCP) buffer layer, and a silver (Ag) electrode. According to the team’s measurements, the mini-module achieved a certified steady-state efficiency of 23.9% and a fill factor of 83.3%, which the authors reported as the highest for a perovskite module. It also had a geometric fill factor of 97%, meaning 97% of its aperture area was photoactive. In separate aging tests under continuous one-sun illumination at open-circuit, the efficiency loss attributable to declining fill factor was less than one-third as large in modules made with the cooling step as in control modules. “The resulting fill factor advantage is retained across device scales and during operation, revealing a shared parameter-level pattern between scale-up loss and operational decay,” the group concluded. “Hence, preserving fill factor offers a unifying optimization target for developing efficient, stable and scalable perovskite photovoltaics.” The cell was described in the study “ Retarding efficiency loss upon scaling in perovskite photovoltaics as fill factor becomes the bottleneck ,” published in nature communications. Researchers from China’s MicroQuanta Semiconductor , Zhejiang University, China Three Gorges Renewable , Zhejiang Provincial Key Laboratory of Optoelectronic Functional Materials and Devices , and the Australian Centre for Advanced Photovoltaics . In January 2025, MicroQuanta achieved a certified efficiency of 21.86% for an 810 cm² perovskite solar module. The company has also been developing a gigawatt-scale perovskite production line in Quzhou, Zhejiang province, with plans to manufacture large-area modules measuring 2.88 m² and targeting 20% efficiency and a 25-year lifespan. More recently, MicroQuanta introduced a perovskite-silicon tandem module for building-integrated photovoltaics (BIPV) at The smarter E Europe 2026 in Munich, Germany. The four-terminal MQ-α² series features a reported efficiency of 26% and power outputs ranging from 65 W to 165 W. The modules are available in customizable colors and finishes. The post MicroQuanta, Zhejiang University achieve world-record efficiency of 23.9% for 19.48 cm² perovskite solar module appeared first on pv magazine Global .

title: District official proposes ride-hail pickup zone at Kai Tak to curb illegal cross-border rides
zh_title: 地区官员提议在启德设立网约车接送区以遏制非法跨境乘车
summary: 在中国游客非法乘车返回大陆后，一名区级官员建议在该市旗舰体育场外设立专门的有牌照车辆接送区。香港启德体育公园。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。周五，韩国男团BIGBANG在启德体育场演出时，中国内地游客选择无牌出租汽车越过边境回家，九龙城区议员张敬勋周二就香港电台的一档节目提出了这一建议。然而，由于车辆绕道，游客很难上车
content:
在中国游客非法乘车返回大陆后，一名区级官员建议在该市旗舰体育场外设立专门的有牌照车辆接送区。香港启德体育公园。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。周五，韩国男团BIGBANG在启德体育场演出时，中国内地游客选择无牌出租汽车越过边境回家，九龙城区议员张敬勋周二就香港电台的一档节目提出了这一建议。然而，游客们很难上车，因为车辆绕道避开音乐会场地周围设立的警察检查站。出租汽车甚至在附近的住宅区启恩苑外的环岛接载乘客，音乐会观众挤满了住宅区的入口。张周二表示，为拥有在该市提供服务的许可的网约车设立专门的接送区域，将抑制游客雇用无证乘车服务。新制度“一旦他们意识到必须走得更远才能登机，他们就会失去雇用他们的动力，”张说。由于没有专门的监管，优步等叫车服务多年来一直在合法的灰色地带运营。今年 8 月，香港开始接受网约车司机和平台的申请，首批 10,000 个许可证允许他们合法运营。
张表示，新制度实施后，游客可乘坐香港牌照的出租车到口岸，然后转乘内地出租车。 跨境网约车被称为“白牌”车辆，在香港是非法的。警察局长周乔恩上周表示，警方逮捕了 12 名涉嫌提供非法跨境服务的司机，其中包括在 BIGBANG 演唱会期间提供服务的司机。张表示，警方的行动将帮助内地司机了解他们的行为是违法的，同时帮助游客为未来的行程做好准备。他补充说，体育场附近的停车场或其他空地可以用作叫车接送站。

【原文 English Original】
A district-level official has suggested setting up a dedicated ride-hail pickup area for licensed vehicles outside the city’s flagship stadium after Chinese tourists hired illicit rides back to the mainland. Hong Kong’s Kai Tak Sports Park. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Kowloon City District Councillor Cheung King-fan made the suggestion on an RTHK programme on Tuesday after mainland Chinese tourists opted for unlicensed hire cars back home across the border on Friday, when South Korean boyband BIGBANG performed at Kai Tak Stadium. The tourists struggled to board, however, as the vehicles took detours to avoid police checkpoints set up around the concert venue. Hire cars even picked up passengers at the roundabout outside Kai Yan Court, a nearby housing estate, with concertgoers crowding out the entrance to the housing block. Cheung said on Tuesday that setting up a dedicated pickup area for ride-hail vehicles with permits to provide services in the city would disincentivise tourists from hiring unlicensed rides. New regime “Once they realise they have to walk further away to board, they will lose the incentive to hire them,” Cheung said. With no dedicated regulation, ride-hail services such as Uber have operated in a legal grey area for years. Hong Kong began accepting applications for ride-hail drivers and platforms this August for an initial pool of 10,000 permits allowing them to operate legally. Cheung said that once the new regime took effect, tourists would be able to take Hong Kong-licensed hire cars to boundary control points and then transfer to mainland hire vehicles. Cross-border ride-hail cars, known as “white licence” vehicles, are illegal in Hong Kong. Police chief Joe Chow said last week that the force had arrested 12 drivers suspected of providing illegal cross-border services, including at the BIGBANG concert. Cheung said the police operation would help mainland drivers understand that their actions were illegal while helping tourists prepare for their trips in the future. He added that a parking lot or other empty sites near the stadium could be used as a ride-hail pickup stand.

title: USNI News Fleet and Marine Tracker: Nov. 16, 2026

summary: USNI 新闻 图片 这些是根据海军和公开数据，截至 2026 年 11 月 16 日，美国海军在世界各地部署的航母打击群和两栖战备群的大致位置。如果 CSG 或 ARG 正在进行分类操作，图表会反映主力舰的位置。正在部署的总战斗力 286（USS 228、USNS 58） 102（USS 71、USNS 31）（46 FDNF、56 轮换） 87（64 部署，23 本地）在日本 航空支援设备技术员飞行员塞巴斯蒂安·鲁伊斯（Sebastian Ruiz）在美国级损坏控制演习中操作消防水龙带

title: Hong Kong stocks slide nearly 400 points as tech shares tumble 4 per cent
zh_title: 科技股跌4% 港股跌近400点
summary: 科技股跌4% 港股跌近400点中国劳工公告牌，星期五，2026 年 11 月 20 日·香港 香港和中国劳工英文新闻 香港股市下跌近 400 点，科技股暴跌 4% 香港股市周五早盘大幅下跌，恒生指数在区域性抛售中下跌 383 点。恒生科技指数下跌 3.9%。继华尔街股市下跌超过 2% 后，亚洲股市迎来 2020 年 3 月以来最糟糕的一周。港股周五早盘暴跌近400点
content:
科技股跌4% 港股跌近400点中国劳工公告栏
星期五, 20 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港及中国劳工新闻（英文）
科技股跌4% 港股跌近400点
港股周五早盘大幅下跌，恒生指数在区域性抛售中下跌 383 点。恒生科技指数下跌 3.9%。继华尔街股市下跌超过 2% 后，亚洲股市迎来 2020 年 3 月以来最糟糕的一周。
据《标准报》和路透社报道，由于 Anthropic 的上市未能恢复投资者对人工智能交易的信心，以及美元在避险资金流的推动下延续涨势，港股周五早盘暴跌近 400 点。
恒生指数下跌 383 点，跌幅 1.7%，至 22,458 点。恒生科技指数下跌 3.9%，至 3,506 点左右。
香港股市下跌之际，亚洲股市正迎来2020年以来最糟糕的一周。摩根士丹利资本国际(MSCI)最广泛的亚太股市指数下跌2.5%，有望连续六天下跌。该指数本周已下跌 7%，为 2020 年 3 月以来最差表现。
日本日经指数下跌 4.1%，预计每周下跌 6.8%，而韩国综合股价指数下跌 4.7%，预计本周下跌 7.5%。亚洲股市的走势是在美国标准普尔 500 指数和纳斯达克综合指数下跌超过 2% 后发生的。

Hong Kong stocks slide nearly 400 points as tech shares tumble 4 per cent | China Labour Bulletin Board
Friday, 20 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong stocks slide nearly 400 points as tech shares tumble 4 per cent
Hong Kong stocks fell sharply in early Friday trading, with the Hang Seng Index dropping 383 points amid a regional sell-off. The Hang Seng Tech Index lost 3.9 per cent. Asian shares headed for their worst week since March 2020, following losses of over 2 per cent on Wall Street.
Hong Kong stocks plunged nearly 400 points in early trading on Friday, as Anthropic's market debut failed to restore investor confidence in artificial-intelligence trades and the US dollar extended a rally on safe-haven flows, according to a report by The Standard and Reuters.
The benchmark Hang Seng Index slumped 383 points, or 1.7 per cent, to 22,458 points. The Hang Seng Tech Index fell by 3.9 per cent to around 3,506 points.
The losses in Hong Kong came as Asian shares headed for their worst week since 2020. MSCI's broadest index of Asia-Pacific shares lost 2.5 per cent, poised for a six-day losing streak. The gauge has now declined 7 per cent this week, its worst performance since March 2020.
Japan's Nikkei tumbled 4.1 per cent and was headed for a 6.8 per cent weekly drop, while South Korea's KOSPI fell 4.7 per cent and was set to end the week 7.5 per cent lower. The moves in Asia followed losses of more than 2 per cent for the S&P 500 and the Nasdaq Composite in the United States.

title: Government tech debt is a national security risk
zh_title: 政府技术债务是国家安全风险
summary: 8 月，美国联邦调查局宣布发现并阻止了另一起由中国政府发起的针对美国关键基础设施的网络攻击，这是一系列攻击中的最新一起，其中包括 2025 年 PlugX 恶意软件事件、2024 年 Flax Typhoon 黑客事件和 2023 年 Volt Typhoon 行动。这些攻击的严重性和频率应该引起警惕，因为它们显示了美国的对手寻找我们敏感系统中任何可能的弱点进行利用的模式，并且在许多情况下共同合作来这样做。这些攻击通常针对联邦政府
content:
8 月，美国联邦调查局宣布发现并阻止了另一起由中国政府发起的针对美国关键基础设施的网络攻击，这是一系列攻击中的最新一起，其中包括 2025 年 PlugX 恶意软件事件、2024 年 Flax Typhoon 黑客事件和 2023 年 Volt Typhoon 行动。这些攻击的严重性和频率应该引起警惕，因为它们显示了美国的对手寻找我们敏感系统中任何可能的弱点进行利用的模式，并且在许多情况下共同合作来这样做。这些攻击通常针对联邦政府自己的网络，而且往往很成功。即将上任的众议院和参议院网络领导人需要快速评估和解决此漏洞。数学并不在政府一边。网络对手只需正确一次，而防御者必须在每个系统、程序和供应商中都是正确的。不幸的是，联邦政府承包和管理关键系统的方式使其网络防御者的工作变得更加困难。联邦系统往往是在数十年的时间里拼凑而成的，往往具有不可预测的预算、不断变化的任务和采购规则，这些规则有利于增量修复而不是真正的现代化。过时的技术通常很容易识别。这个问题更危险的方面是联邦管理工作的复杂性，确保解决这一挑战将是困难的。
在管理和预算办公室以及总务管理局的指导下，联邦机构通常同时运行三到四代系统——遗留数据库位于云环境下，托管服务提供商和内部团队各自接触不同的层，通常没有共享的连接图。安全性通常是在任务发生变化、平台扩展和新的合规性要求出现之后才添加的。根据 R Street Institute 2025 年的报告，联邦信息技术支出每年超过 1000 亿美元，其中多达 80% 专门用于运营和维护现有系统。政府每年花费 800 亿美元只是为了保护旧系统的安全，而对手则投资新技术和工艺来渗透它们。对手现在可以访问代理人工智能系统来自动化其侦察工作，加速对已知漏洞的利用，并在补丁周期完成之前遍历供应链。联邦网络和防御的分散使得外国对手更容易渗透系统，并带来重大的战略风险。联邦政府可能不具备在与中国或俄罗斯发生危机或突发事件时继续运作的网络弹性。
国会开始关注，但由于网络投资不像新型战斗机或导弹系统那么有形，而且分散在每个议院的数十个授权和拨款小组委员会中，因此它往往处于次要地位。国会应该将联邦技术现代化视为一项安全需要，就像对待传统国防部武器采购一样紧迫。各机构需要采购途径，以便在无需多年采购周期的情况下采用可信的安全技术。供应商合同应足够清晰地定义责任，以便在发生违规行为后，可以在数小时内而不是短时间内确定责任方

【原文 English Original】
In August, the Federal Bureau of Investigation announced that it detected and disrupted another Chinese state-sponsored cyberattack targeting U.S. critical infrastructure — the latest in a series that includes the 2025 PlugX malware incident, the 2024 Flax Typhoon hack and the 2023 Volt Typhoon operation. The severity and frequency of these attacks should raise alarms because they show a pattern of America’s adversaries looking for any possible weakness in our sensitive systems to exploit, and in many cases cooperating together to do so. These attacks are often aimed at the federal government’s own networks, and they are all too often successful. The incoming House and Senate cyber leaders will need to assess and address this vulnerability fast. The math isn’t on the government’s side. Cyber adversaries only have to be right once, whereas defenders must be right across every system, program and vendor. Unfortunately, the very way that the federal government contracts and manages critical systems makes the job of its cyber defenders much more difficult. Federal systems are often cobbled together over decades, often with unpredictable budgets, shifting missions and procurement rules that favor incremental fixes over true modernization. The outdated technology is often easy to identify. The more dangerous aspect of the problem is the complexity embedded in federal management efforts, ensuring that addressing the challenge will be hard. Under the guidance of the Office of Management and Budget and the General Services Administration, federal agencies routinely run three or four generations of systems simultaneously — legacy databases sitting beneath cloud environments, with managed service providers and internal teams each touching different layers, often without a shared map of what connects what. Security is often added later, after missions have changed, the platforms expanded, and new compliance requirements emerged. Federal information technology spending exceeds $100 billion annually, according to a 2025 R Street Institute report , with as much as 80 percent dedicated to operating and maintaining existing systems. The government spends this $80 billion a year simply to keep old systems secure while adversaries invest in new technologies and techniques to infiltrate them. Adversaries now have access to agentic AI systems to automate their reconnaissance efforts, accelerate exploitation of known vulnerabilities and move through supply chains before a patch cycle completes. The fragmentation of federal networks and defenses makes it easier for foreign adversaries to penetrate systems, and it poses a significant strategic risk. The federal government may not have the network resilience to continue to operate in a crisis or contingency with China or Russia. Congress is starting to pay attention, but because cyber investment is less tangible than a new fighter jet or missile system and is spread across dozens of authorization and appropriation subcommittees in each chamber, it often takes a back seat. Congress should treat federal technology modernization as a security imperative with the same urgency it has applied to traditional Defense Department weapons acquisition. Agencies need procurement pathways that allow trusted security technologies to be adopted without multiyear acquisition cycles. Vendor contracts should define accountability clearly enough that, after a breach, the party responsible can be identified in hours rather than weeks. Platform duplication should also be reduced where it expands the attack surface without adding operational capability. Weapons acquisition reform is focusing on delivering capabilities to warfighters faster and at lower cost. Federal cybersecurity infrastructure acquisition should be held to the same standard. Faster modernization would make government harder to penetrate and quicker to recover. Government tech debt is a strategic vulnerability, and our adversaries are already exploiting it. The post Government tech debt is a national security risk appeared first on CyberScoop .

title: Hong Kong environmental authorities vow smoking crackdown at Shek Kwu Chau waste plant following fire probe
zh_title: 香港环保部门誓言在石鼓洲废物处理厂进行火灾调查后严厉打击吸烟行为
summary: 调查人员发现吸烟或焊接工作是上个月该地点发生火灾的罪魁祸首后，香港环保部门发誓要严厉打击石鼓洲人工岛上一座废物管理设施的吸烟行为。 2026 年 10 月 26 日，香港石鼓洲人工岛上的 I·PARK1 垃圾焚烧厂冒出黑烟。照片：goblin_under，来自 Threads。消防处（FSD）周二表示，已完成对火灾的调查，火灾迫使香港第一座废物处理厂暂时关闭。
content:
调查人员发现吸烟或焊接工作是上个月该地点发生火灾的罪魁祸首后，香港环保部门发誓要严厉打击石鼓洲人工岛上一座废物管理设施的吸烟行为。 2026 年 10 月 26 日，香港石鼓洲人工岛上的 I·PARK1 垃圾焚烧厂冒出黑烟。照片：goblin_under，来自 Threads。消防处周二表示，已完成对10月26日香港首个垃圾焚烧炉的火灾调查，并疏散I·PARK1设施中近千人。调查人员在现场收集证据并听取相关人士的陈述后，“排除了电气故障、纵火和化学物质自燃等起火原因，怀疑与焊接有关”工作或吸烟，”FSD 说。环境保护署（环保署）回应称，已指示该设施的承建商立即检讨和加强防火措施，并全面实施禁烟令。 2026 年 10 月 26 日，香港石鼓洲人工岛上的 I·PARK1 垃圾焚烧厂冒出黑烟。照片：edward.chung_，来自 Threads。
环保署表示，自今年一月起，承建商已实施一系列控烟措施，包括要求工人在前往人工岛前在码头存放香烟和打火机，以及进行定期和突击巡查。工人在工地发现吸烟，会立即被勒令离开。上述调查结果是在对宏福苑火灾进行全面调查后发现，现场吸烟也是该住宅区经常出现的问题。去年发生导致168人死亡的大火时，该住宅区正在进行翻修。

【原文 English Original】
Hong Kong environmental authorities have vowed to crack down on smoking at a waste-management facility on an artificial island off Shek Kwu Chau, after investigators found that smoking or welding work was to blame for the blaze that broke out at the site last month. Black smoke rises from I·PARK1, a waste incineration plant on an artificial island off Shek Kwu Chau in Hong Kong on October 26, 2026. Photo: goblin_under, via Threads. The Fire Services Department (FSD) said on Tuesday it had completed its investigation into the fire, which forced the temporary shutdown of Hong Kong’s first waste-to-energy incinerator and the evacuation of close to 1,000 people from the I·PARK1 facility on October 26. After collecting evidence from the scene and taking statements from relevant parties, investigators “ruled out electrical faults, arson, and spontaneous combustion of chemical substances as the cause of the fire, which is instead suspected of being related to welding works or smoking,” the FSD said. In response , the Environmental Protection Department (EPD) said it had instructed the facility’s contractor to immediately review and strengthen its fire hazard mitigation measures and to enforce a comprehensive smoking ban. Black smoke rises from I·PARK1, a waste incineration plant on an artificial island off Shek Kwu Chau in Hong Kong on October 26, 2026. Photo: edward.chung_, via Threads. Since January this year, the EPD said, the contractor had implemented a series of smoking control measures, such as requiring workers to store cigarettes and lighters at the pier before transiting to the artificial island and conducting regular and surprise inspections. Workers found smoking on the construction site were immediately ordered to leave, the department said. The findings come after a comprehensive investigation into the Wang Fuk Court fire found that on-site smoking was also a recurring issue at the housing estate, which was undergoing renovations when the inferno that killed 168 people broke out last year.

title: USS Theodore Roosevelt Now in the Middle East, Lincoln’s Last Escorts Finally Home
zh_title: 西奥多·罗斯福号航空母舰现已抵达中东，林肯最后的护航终于回家
summary: 2026 年 11 月 15 日，西奥多·罗斯福号航空母舰 (CVN-71) 穿越印度洋。作为计划部署的一部分，该航母目前正在美国中央司令部责任区执行任务。美国海军照片 美国第三艘航空母舰及其护航舰现在位于中东。西奥多·罗斯福号航空母舰 (CVN-71) 于周日加入美国第五舰队。随着美国和伊朗之间的紧张局势持续存在，西奥多·罗斯福号航母打击群的到来使美国在中东地区出现了三个航母打击群。周末，胡塞武装继续占领巴布埃尔附近地区。
content:
2026 年 11 月 15 日，西奥多·罗斯福号航空母舰 (CVN-71) 穿越印度洋。作为计划部署的一部分，该航母目前正在美国中央司令部责任区执行任务。美国海军照片 美国第三艘航空母舰及其护航舰现在位于中东。西奥多·罗斯福号航空母舰 (CVN-71) 于周日加入美国第五舰队。随着美国和伊朗之间的紧张局势持续存在，西奥多·罗斯福号航母打击群的到来使美国在中东地区出现了三个航母打击群。周末，胡塞武装继续对曼德海峡（连接亚丁湾与红海的战略要道）周围地区提出主权要求，而伊朗军队则声称他们周五袭击了位于巴林的美国雷达。美国中央司令部否认了社交媒体网站 X 上发布的有关伊斯兰革命卫队在巴林发射两架单向无人机并被击落的说法。 2026 年 11 月 16 日，美国水兵在尼米兹级航空母舰西奥多·罗斯福号 (CVN-71) 的飞行甲板上使用分配给第 8 直升机海上作战中队 (HSC) 的 MH-60S 海鹰进行飞行作业。西奥多·罗斯福号被部署到美国第五舰队作战区域，以支持中东的海上安全与稳定。美国海军照片 西奥多·罗斯福预计将接替 8 月底抵达中东的乔治·华盛顿号航空母舰 (CVN-73)。
虽然 GW 最终接替了亚伯拉罕·林肯号航空母舰 (CVN-72)，但在安倍回国之前，这两艘航母都与乔治·H·W·布什号航空母舰 (CVN-77) 一起在中东执行任务大约一个月。目前尚不清楚 GW 将在 TR 抵达后在该地区停留多久。布什、GW和TR在中东的存在是以美国航母在印太地区的存在为代价的。安倍在部署 321 天后启程回国，而其两艘护航舰——迈克尔·墨菲号 (DDG-112) 和斯普鲁恩斯号 (DDG-111)——则留在了后方。迈克尔·墨菲 (Michael Murphy) 在服役 346 天后于周四返回家中，而斯普鲁恩斯 (Spruance) 在服役 357 天后于周六返回家中。斯普鲁恩斯的部署时间比安倍多了 36 天，创下了驱逐舰部署的记录。阿利·伯克级导弹驱逐舰斯普鲁恩斯号 (DDG-111) 于 2026 年 11 月 13 日返回圣地亚哥海军基地母港，结束了在美国第 3、第 7 和第 5 舰队作战区域为期 12 个月的战斗部署。美国海军照片 对于驱逐舰来说，长达近一年的部署是罕见的，它们通常会部署六到七个月。然而，海军警告水手和家属，随着海上服务试图满足政府的需求，部署将持续近一年。斯普鲁恩斯于 2025 年 11 月 21 日从加利福尼亚州圣地亚哥海军基地部署。
据海军发布的宣布该驱逐舰回归的消息称，该驱逐舰在第三、第五和第七舰队中服役，在整个部署过程中航行了超过 88,000 海里。 2026 年 11 月 13 日，海军水手和亲人欢迎阿利·伯克级导弹驱逐舰斯普鲁恩斯号 (DDG-111) 返回其母港圣地亚哥海军基地，结束了在美国第三、第七和第五舰队行动区为期 12 个月的战斗部署。美国海军照片 斯普鲁恩斯号在部署期间参与了史诗狂怒行动，在此期间，作为持续海上封锁的一部分，驱逐舰禁用了货船 M/V Touska。虽然新闻稿称该舰发射了战斧导弹，但没有详细说明

【原文 English Original】
USS Theodore Roosevelt (CVN-71) transits the Indian Ocean, Nov. 15, 2026. The aircraft carrier is currently operating in the U.S. Central Command area of responsibility as part of a scheduled deployment. US Navy photo A third U.S. aircraft carrier and its escorts are now in the Middle East. USS Theodore Roosevelt (CVN-71) chopped into U.S. 5th Fleet on Sunday. The arrival of the Theodore Roosevelt Carrier Strike Group makes three U.S. carrier strike groups in the Middle East, as tensions persist between the U.S. and Iran. Over the weekend, the Houthis continued to claim areas around the Bab el-Mandeb – the strategic chokepoint that connects the Gulf of Aden to the Red Sea – while Iranian forces claim they attacked a U.S. radar in Bahrain on Friday. U.S. Central Command denied the claim posting on social media site X that the Islamic Revolutionary Guards Corps launched two one-way drones at Bahrain, which were shot down. U.S. sailors conduct flight operations with an MH-60S Sea Hawk assigned to Helicopter Sea Combat Squadron (HSC) 8 on the flight deck of Nimitz-class aircraft carrier USS Theodore Roosevelt (CVN-71), Nov. 16, 2026. Theodore Roosevelt is deployed to the U.S. 5th Fleet area of operations to support maritime security and stability in the Middle East. US Navy photo Theodore Roosevelt is expected to relieve USS George Washington (CVN-73), which arrived in the Middle East toward the end of August . While GW ultimately relieved USS Abraham Lincoln (CVN-72), the two carriers both operated in the Middle East, along with USS George H.W. Bush (CVN-77), for about a month before Abe headed home. It is unclear how long GW will stay in the area with TR’s arrival. Bush , GW and TR’s presence in the Middle East comes at the cost of the U.S. carrier presence in the Indo-Pacific region. While Abe headed home after 321 days on deployment, two of its escorts – USS Michael Murphy (DDG-112) and USS Spruance (DDG-111) – stayed behind. Michael Murphy returned home Thursday after 346 days deployed, while Spruance returned home on Saturday after 357 days deployed. Spruance’s deployment came in at 36 days more than Abe and set a record for destroyer deployments. Arleigh Burke-class guided-missile destroyer USS Spruance (DDG-111) returns to its home port of Naval Base San Diego, Nov. 13, 2026, concluding a 12-month combat deployment across the U.S. 3rd, 7th, and 5th fleet areas of operations. US Navy photo Nearly year-long deployments are rare for destroyers, which usually go out for six to seven months. However, the Navy has warned sailors and families to expect deployments that approach a year as the sea service attempts to keep up the needs of the administration. Spruance deployed on Nov. 21, 2025, from Naval Base San Diego, Calif. The destroyer operated in the 3rd, 5th and 7th fleets, traveling more than 88,000 nautical miles throughout its deployments, according to a Navy release announcing the destroyer’s return. U.S. Navy sailors and loved ones welcome Arleigh Burke-class guided-missile destroyer USS Spruance (DDG-111) as it returns to its home port of Naval Base San Diego, Nov. 13, 2026, concluding a 12-month combat deployment across the U.S. 3rd, 7th, and 5th fleet areas of operations. US Navy photo While deployed, Spruance was part of Operation Epic Fury, during which the destroyer disabled cargo vessel M/V Touska as part of the ongoing maritime blockade. While the release said the ship launched Tomahawk missiles, it did not go into details about the Iranian military targets. The destroyer did take out 12 drones and four anti-ship cruise missiles while in the Middle East, according to the Navy release. The “Raptors” of HSM-71 embarked on Spruance and flew 190 sorties during the deployment, reads the release. Spruance received the Presidential Unit Citation and Combat Action Ribbon following its role in Operation Epic Fury. The destroyer has been busy over the past two years. Before its most recent deployment, the ship was part of U.S. Northern Command’s southern border operations, leaving San Diego in March 2025. Prior to that, Spruance spent five months in the Middle East as part of the U.S. response to Houthi attacks on commercial shipping, coming home on Dec. 19, 2024.

title: Silicon Valley is Suffering From Model Collapse
zh_title: 硅谷正遭受模式崩溃之苦
summary: 对于居住在北加州以外的任何人来说，来自硅谷的许多信息感觉就像是从另一个星球发送的。上周，许多业界顶尖人士在为英伟达前首席执行官黄仁勋的事件辩护时，进行了奥运会级别的心理体操：他们认为，我们必须原谅他与两名员工和一名所谓的中国间谍的调情，这不仅因为黄仁勋对人工智能投资支撑的美国经济绝对必要，而且因为我们正在与中国进行地缘政治超级情报竞赛。然后本周，人类
content:
对于居住在北加州以外的任何人来说，来自硅谷的许多信息感觉就像是从另一个星球发送的。上周，许多业界顶尖人士在为英伟达前首席执行官黄仁勋的事件辩护时，进行了奥运会级别的心理体操：他们认为，我们必须原谅他与两名员工和一名所谓的中国间谍的调情，这不仅因为黄仁勋对人工智能投资支撑的美国经济绝对必要，而且因为我们正在与中国进行地缘政治超级情报竞赛。然后，本周，最直言不讳地关注人工智能存在风险的公司 Anthropic 上市，试图筹集 900 亿美元，以便加快其警告我们的相同系统的建设。我们如何解释这种不合逻辑的行为模式？也许这是标准的贪婪：股东们可以从英伟达和 Anthropic 的股票中赚到难以估量的钱，而最终，现金统治了我周围的一切。但许多 Anthropic 员工似乎对钱不感兴趣。也许这就是群体思维。也许这是一种宗教层面的信仰，相信人类已经迎来了超级智能，未来的丰富性。或者也许是对创始人的崇拜和救世主般的伟大感——坚信只有那些在旧金山首先看到未来的人才能帮助保护我们免受疾病、中国人或我们自己的祸害。
[阅读：] 价值 5.7 万亿美元的面孔 但是，看看 X 上的人工智能厄运、Anthropic 首次公开募股的准备，以及黄仁勋辞职的影响，我认为有一个更好的框架来理解我们所看到的一切。逻辑的退化、难以理解的决策以及与流行观点的奇怪脱离，都指向了人工智能行业所谓的模型崩溃的动态。该术语描述了一种数字近亲繁殖，理论上，当人工智能模型训练合成人工智能输出时，就会发生这种情况。人工智能领域最有影响力的人物现在听起来好像他们在湾区和 X 的孤立世界里苦苦挣扎，正在遭受他们自己版本的这种现象的困扰。模型崩溃并不是一个完美的类比。人工智能公司在训练语言模型时实际上煞费苦心地过滤掉人工智能的废话。但人类呢？没那么多。你可能会称之为循环推理，但总体结论是一样的：塑造我们未来的企业领导人似乎陷入了自己的世界。最近，热门人工智能博客上的一篇文章很好地体现了这种精神，将人工智能公司的员工与服用微量致幻剂的人进行了比较。这篇文章指出，这些人看起来似乎“处于长期轻微改变的精神状态”。这篇文章表明，也许这种心态让他们比我们这些局外人“更清楚地看到一些关于人工智能模型及其进展和能力的事情”。当然，缺点是某种形式的醉酒。
这是一个有用的框架，通过它可以看到湾区正在发生的很多事情。但也有一个复合效应：每一天，每一天，这种文化都在与自己对话，它的参与者接受关于世界和他们正在建设的信息的递归循环的培训。这种信息泡沫是自我强化的，常常不合逻辑，而且令人疏远。硅谷关于人工智能递归自我改进的讨论提供了这种退化的循环推理的最佳例子。 RSI 是指人工智能模型在不发生任何变化的情况下自我改进的概念

【原文 English Original】
For anyone living outside Northern California, a lot of the messages coming out of Silicon Valley feel like they’ve been sent from another planet. Last week, many of the industry’s top minds engaged in Olympic-level mental gymnastics as they defended the former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s affairs: We must excuse his dalliances with two employees and an alleged Chinese spy, they argued, not just because Huang is absolutely necessary to the American economy, which is being propped up by AI investment, but because we are in a geopolitical superintelligence race with China. Then this week, Anthropic, the company most vocally obsessed with the existential risk of AI, went public in an effort to raise $90 billion so that it could speed up construction of the very same systems it’s warning us about. How do we explain this pattern of illogical behavior? Maybe it’s standard avarice: Shareholders stand to make unfathomable amounts of money from Nvidia and Anthropic stock, and, ultimately, cash rules everything around me. But many Anthropic employees seem uninterested in the money. Maybe it’s groupthink. Maybe it’s a religious-level belief in the abundance of a future in which humans have ushered in superintelligence. Or maybe it’s the cult of the founder and a messianic sense of grandeur—the conviction that only those who see the future first in San Francisco can help protect us from the scourge of disease, from the Chinese, or from ourselves. [ Read: ] A $5.7 trillion face-plant But watching the AI doomerism on X, the lead-up to Anthropic’s IPO, and the fallout from Huang’s resignation, I think there’s a better framework for understanding what we’re seeing. The degradation of logic, the inscrutable decision making, and the bizarre detachment from popular opinion all point to a dynamic that the AI industry calls model collapse. The term describes a type of digital inbreeding that can theoretically occur when AI models train off synthetic AI output. The most influential figures in AI now sound as if they, having marinated in the insular worlds of the Bay Area and X, are suffering from their own version of the phenomenon. Model collapse isn’t a perfect analogy. AI companies actually take pains to filter out AI slop when training their language models. But humans? Not so much. You might call it circular reasoning, but the overall takeaway is the same: The corporate leaders shaping our future seem stuck in their own world. A recent post on a popular AI blog captures this spirit well, comparing AI-company employees to people who are microdosing psychedelics. These individuals appear as if they are “in a chronically mildly altered state of mind,” the post argues. Maybe, the post suggests, this state of mind allows them to “see some things more clearly” about AI models and their progress and capabilities than those of us on the outside. The downside, of course, is some form of inebriation. This is a helpful framework through which to view a lot of what’s coming out of the Bay Area. But there’s also a compounding effect: All day, every day, this culture talks with itself, its participants training on a recursive loop of information about the world and what they are building. This information bubble is self-reinforcing, frequently illogical, and also alienating. The Silicon Valley discourse about recursive self improvement in AI offers the best example of this degraded, circular reasoning. RSI refers to the concept of AI models improving themselves without human intervention or supervision, which would improve AI capabilities exponentially, accelerating discoveries in different fields and increasing the likelihood that models show signs of superintelligence and become far better than humans at any task they pursue. The downside of RSI, according to individuals including the Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei, is that models “could outrun our ability to understand and control these systems.” Humans would be flying blind and thus would likely rely more heavily on AI systems to interpret what is happening inside other AI systems. This is already happening to varying degrees when AI companies train and test new models, but RSI would speed it up to the point that humans would have fully relinquished control. This prospect seems to terrify many of the people who are closest to the technology. “There is not yet a viable scientific plan to solve risks from recursively self-improving AI. Please look up!” Anna Wang, an alignment researcher at Anthropic, wrote this fall. Yet companies keep racing toward RSI out of fear that someone less principled will get there first. Anthropic argues that pushing forward with an eye toward AI safety will create a virtuous cycle of innovation—a “race to the top.” But you could just as easily argue that these companies are plowing ahead to justify and pay for hundreds of billions of dollars in infrastructure investments. Or that they are so deeply locked in competition with other AI companies and open models in China that they’re behaving irrationally. This September, Amodei wrote an essay arguing for a multilateral slowdown of AI development, a process he dubbed “pacing the frontier.” Ten days later, Anthropic released its newest model. Roughly a month later, in its IPO filing, the company confessed that its call to pace the frontier “does not describe our own model development or release timelines.” Sometimes, you can see the model collapse happening at an individual level—and it looks like naked hypocrisy. In September, an Anthropic researcher named Jacob Coxon quit the company in order to argue that AI companies might kill us all. He offered a heartfelt and convincing case in favor of taking the risk of human extinction seriously. But then, when asked in an interview that surfaced this week whether he would donate his OpenAI shares, he seemed to laugh off the suggestion that doing so would make any difference. “I like the money, bro,” he told the audience. He has since agreed to donate his equity. Sigal Samuel, a writer who covers AI at Vox , has argued that at least some of this dynamic can be explained by a Silicon Valley culture steeped in effective altruism and rationalism. In this sphere, it’s not uncommon for adherents to justify huge risks using counterintuitive and dispassionate rationale. Some see this as a sophisticated form of argumentation, one that can eschew conventional morality (by risking rogue-AI swarm hacks or worse) for a greater purpose (achieving a technological utopia). Samuel argues that the hyperrational thinking deployed by these leaders is overly clever. “Commonsense morality is actually often commonsense for a reason,” she told me recently. “And that’s because it tracks intuitions. Usually, reasoning like ‘If you don’t want a doom machine, don’t build a doom machine’ tends to be good reasoning.” Some who have quit the AI companies in protest describe the internal cultures as nonsensical, even schizophrenic, in nature. David Robinson, who wrote OpenAI’s transparency reports as a safety lead, argued in this publication that the company, which speaks obsessively about safety, approached AI development “with unimpeded optimism about being able to solve problems as they arise,” leading it to adopt a trial-and-error approach that is no longer responsible, given the power of its models. Relentless optimism is a necessary component of technological achievement but, as Robinson suggests, it can veer into hubris. And so the Gordian knot grows ever tighter: Founders argue that humanity must accept enormous trade-offs for the benefit of a technological revolution. In exchange for curing cancer, one must be willing to risk the many-sided threat of gradual disempowerment, in the form of either mass job loss or a world where much of the cognitive work is performed by machines . Many of the people grinding away to usher in this future seem to lack humility or be unable to articulate whether the society they’re building toward is one that’s worth living in at all. At some point, their plainly stated claims can end up sounding, frankly, insane. Recently on X, an AI enthusiast argued that one possible positive end state for humans in an AI utopia would be that “we become the happy dogs” living in a world that “does not belong to them.” Musk has said that we might end up like a “pet Labrador if we’re lucky.” He has also argued that it is “unlikely” that humans will be in control in 10 years time. It all signals a certain irrational confidence in where the future is headed, and a disregard for how off-putting it all sounds. To prevent model collapse, AI companies don’t just add more data to training sets; they add higher-quality information from a diverse array of sources. The dynamic, according to some research , is not an evenly distributed phenomenon, meaning that it appears in specific areas of a model where there are weak points in the training data. A natural fix is to identify the blind spots or shallow areas and bolster them with better data. If Silicon Valley followed this example, perhaps what they would find is an enormous political blind spot. A June survey of Americans by the Pew Research Center showed that just 9 percent of respondents were more excited than concerned about AI, while 52 percent were more concerned than excited. In an exit poll from the recent midterm elections, 56 percent of voters responded that AI and data centers were a “crucial or major factor” in how they had voted. A recent survey of 1,000 young Americans suggested that few of them trust tech CEOs to act responsibly with AI. Yet many voices in Silicon Valley seem either disconnected from this reality or spiteful of it, accusing anti–data center voters of destroying America’s path to prosperity. As the fallout from the Nvidia scandal shows, Silicon Valley’s disconnect goes beyond just the general public; the venture capitalists arguing for Huang’s reinstatement seem to miss or simply not care about the bipartisan anger in Washington over Huang’s clearly reckless behavior. In an industry that has thoroughly embraced civilizational risk, the notion of the replaceable founder seems to be the true existential threat to the tech elite. Tech executives are failing at politics for the same reason they’re struggling among regular Americans: They’ve been so monomaniacally focused on winning the AI race that they’ve ignored everything else, including the need to build consensus or even a baseline of enthusiasm for their plans. That may be why the midterm shift away from MAGA took them by surprise. Maybe it’s because they believe that nobody, outside of the AI companies, is qualified or intelligent enough to judge their work, making them both perpetually unaccountable and correct in every argument. Perhaps it is because they believe that the technology is so self-evidently powerful that a public consensus is irrelevant. That could prove to be true, but in the interim, their rhetoric comes off as incomprehensible, frequently condescending, and too often frantic. At some point, the behaviors that signal a model collapse can also resemble those of a gambler on a bender. One day’s ecstasy over abundant superintelligence turns into the next day’s dire warnings about the future. Half of Silicon Valley appears to be arguing that AI progress is unstoppable—that human loss of control (or life ) within the next year seems inevitable; the other half seems to suggest that the entire fate of both AI progress and the economy hinges on one man in a leather jacket who sells chips. Regardless, the only way out is through, so you go harder and faster—anything to increase your odds. The AI industry, after all, is built on a historic bet: of marshaling as much human knowledge and capital as possible to conjure an alien intelligence greater than our own. Everything we’ve seen from Silicon Valley’s leaders in recent months—the legitimate safety fears, the people willing to cast all morality aside to defend Huang—is the result of this bet. The model-collapse behavior is its own form of recursive self-destruction: AI companies are building the very thing they fear; safety obsessives are alienating themselves from the public who could help them tackle an extraordinary collective-action problem. This is what happens when the bet becomes so big—when the industry is so full of financial, geopolitical, and existential risk—that it creates its own warped logic. It transforms human innovation from a worthy ambition to an inexorable force and, finally, into something akin to a hostage situation. To stop now, Silcon Valley’s leaders argue, would mean losing not merely the future, but also the present. We’re committed to whatever happens next; nothing is more important than driving forward, and no price is too steep. This is the lie the gambler tells himself. But how can we accept the premise when the logic behind it is degraded? I don’t doubt the power or even the potential of what many in Silicon Valley are building. But this is an industry that is asking for an unprecedented level of trust—trust it has neither earned nor seems all that interested in cultivating. At least for now, humans still have a right to self-determination and are under no obligation to submit to an ideology that might remove our agency without our consent. No vision of the future, no matter how well capitalized it is, is inevitable. Silicon Valley must widen the aperture. Its leaders must broaden the conversation around what this future might look like, what we will value, and how to keep it human.

title: Hong Kong private hospital apologises after doctor mistakenly removed patient’s ovaries during operation
zh_title: 香港私家医院因医生手术时错误摘除患者卵巢致歉
summary: 一名医生在手术期间错误地切除了一名女性的卵巢，一家私立医院向患者及其家人道歉。香港中文大学医学中心。照片：水浪/谷歌地图。香港中文大学（中大）医院行政总裁钟健丽周三在记者会上表示，涉事医生是一位经验丰富的合约妇产科医生。郑说，医生承认这起事件是由于手术当天与郑通电话时的失误造成的。医院没有透露这名患者的姓名
content:
一名医生在手术期间错误地切除了一名女性的卵巢，一家私立医院向患者及其家人道歉。香港中文大学医学中心。照片：水浪/谷歌地图。香港中文大学（中大）医院行政总裁钟健丽周三在记者会上表示，涉事医生是一位经验丰富的合约妇产科医生。郑说，医生承认这起事件是由于手术当天与郑通电话时的失误造成的。该医院没有透露该医生的姓名或任何纪律处分的细节，但表示将根据其人力资源政策实施纪律处分。首席执行官向患者、她的家人和公众致歉。他补充说，患者情况稳定，将获得免费的后续预约。卫生部周二在医疗哨点事件定期更新中表示，一名 45 岁女性患者的双侧卵巢在 9 月中旬被错误地、无意中切除。卫生部。资料图片：香港政府一站通。该患者被安排在一家私立医院接受腹腔镜子宫切除术和双侧输卵管切除术——切除全部或部分子宫，并切除双侧输卵管。
中大医院周二发布新闻稿称，手术前，手术同意书及原手术方案均明确注明保留双侧卵巢。声明称，“手术标本提取后，在对标本进行例行验证时，护士发现双侧卵巢被包括在内”。 “护士立即将这一差异通知了医生，因为这偏离了原来保留卵巢的手术计划。” “认知盲点” 医院的中文版声明因称医生在手术过程中存在“认知盲点”，因此“未能执行原定的保留卵巢手术方案”而招致批评。网上，有人留言称医院只是玩文字游戏，掩盖医疗事故。香港中文大学医院是一家新私立医院，于 2021 年开业。照片：Wai Ki Wong/Google 地图。钟周三表示，英文声明之后的中文声明翻译得很差。英国声明称，这名医生“情境意识暂时崩溃”。 “简单来说，涉案医生当时注意力不集中，”钟用粤语说。该私立医院表示，在9月12日发生医疗事故后，立即向患者及其家人“坦白”透露了情况，并表示诚挚的歉意。
它还在24小时内向卫生部通报了这一事件，并成立了根本原因分析小组进行全面调查。

【原文 English Original】
A private hospital has apologised to a patient and her family after a doctor mistakenly removed a woman’s ovaries during an operation. CUHK Medical Centre. Photo: 水浪/Google Maps. Chung Kin-lai, chief executive officer of the Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK) Medical Centre, said during a press conference on Wednesday that the doctor involved is an experienced contract obstetrician and gynaecologist resident. The doctor admitted the incident was due to mistakes during a phone call with Chung on the day the operation was conducted, Chung said. The hospital did not disclose the name of the doctor or details of any disciplinary action, but said it would impose disciplinary actions in accordance with its human resources policies. The CEO sent apologies to the patient, her family and to the public. He added that the patient is in stable condition and will be provided free follow-up appointments. The Department of Health said on Tuesday in its regular update of medical sentinel events that a 45-year-old female patient’s bilateral ovaries were mistakenly and inadvertently removed in mid-September. The Department of Health. File photo: GovHK. The patient was scheduled for laparoscopic hysterectomy and bilateral salpingectomy surgery – the removal of all or part of the uterus, and the removal of both fallopian tubes – in a private hospital. The CUHK Medical Centre said in a press release on Tuesday that prior to the operation, both the surgical consent form and the original surgical plan clearly specified the preservation of both ovaries. “After the surgical specimens were extracted, during the routine verification of the specimens, a nurse discovered that the bilateral ovaries were included,” the statement read. “The nurse immediately notified the doctor of this discrepancy, as it deviated from the original surgical plan to preserve the ovaries.” ‘Cognitive blindspot’ The hospital’s Chinese version of the statement draw criticism over its description that the doctor had “a cognitive blindspot” during the operation and therefore “failed to carry out the original surgical plan of preserving the ovaries.” Online, people left comments saying that the hospital was just playing with words to gloss over medical malpractice. CUHK Medical Centre, a new private hospital opened in 2021. Photo: Wai Ki Wong/Google Maps. Chung said on Wednesday that the Chinese statement, which followed the English one, was poorly translated. The English statement said the doctor had a “temporary collapse of his situational awareness.” “Put simply, the doctor involved had a lapse in concentration at the time,” Chung said in Cantonese. The private hospital said it “candidly disclosed” the situation to the patient and her family and offered sincere apologies immediately after the malpractice took place on September 12. It also informed the Department of Health about the incident within 24 hours and established a Root Cause Analysis Panel to conduct a comprehensive investigation.

title: Launch Preview: Ariane 6 to launch Amazon satellites, Falcon 9 to launch government missions
zh_title: 发射预览：阿丽亚娜 6 号将发射亚马逊卫星，猎鹰 9 号将发射政府任务
summary: 经过一周繁忙的发射活动，本周全球发射清单预计将进行六次发射，其中包括范登堡发射的 3 次 SpaceX 猎鹰 9 号发射任务、中国的两次发射任务以及南美洲的阿丽亚娜 6 号发射任务。 SpaceX 将为美国太空部队和国家侦察办公室发射有效载荷，而本周的中国任务和阿丽亚娜 6 号任务中至少有一次将发射一批互联网卫星。长征2D |有效载荷未知 11 月 18 日星期三，中国将发射长征 2D (CZ-2D) 火箭，预计将从 9 号发射场 (LC
content:
经过一周繁忙的发射活动，本周全球发射清单预计将进行六次发射，其中包括范登堡发射的 3 次 SpaceX 猎鹰 9 号发射任务、中国的两次发射任务以及南美洲的阿丽亚娜 6 号发射任务。 SpaceX 将为美国太空部队和国家侦察办公室发射有效载荷，而本周的中国任务和阿丽亚娜 6 号任务中至少有一次将发射一批互联网卫星。长征2D |有效载荷未知，将于 11 月 18 日星期三从中国发射，长征 2D (CZ-2D) 预计将于世界标准时间 22:50 从太原卫星发射中心的 9 号发射场 (LC-9) 发射。官方警告通知表明发射轨迹是向南的，但有效载荷及其预定轨道的详细信息要等到发射后才会发布。两级、40.77 米高的 CZ-2D 由上海航天技术研究院 (SAST) 制造。 2D 版本不需要额外的捆绑式助推器。此次飞行将是长征2D的第108次飞行，也是今年的第七次。猎鹰 9 号 | USSF-317 (R-6) SpaceX 将于 11 月 18 日星期三进行本周两次发射中的第一次发射，发射时间为四小时，发射窗口于太平洋标准时间晚上 7:00（世界标准时间周四 03:00）开始。
USSF-317 任务是美国太空军 (USSF) 本周的唯一任务，将从加利福尼亚州范登堡太空部队基地 (VSFB) 的东 4 号航天发射场 (SLC-4E) 发射，向东南飞行，将其机密有效载荷送入低地球轨道 (LEO)。所有系统看起来都很好，天气也有利于升空。猎鹰 9 号发射的 USSF-627 任务即将开始从加利福尼亚州发射推进剂 → https://t.co/IdlZbviZZl pic.twitter.com/fKxyN4DIui — SpaceX (@SpaceX) 2026 年 11 月 12 日助推器 B1100 将支持此次任务，这是自近一年前 11 月 23 日首次支持星链集团 11-30 以来的第十一次飞行， 2025 年。除了 NROL-105 和 USSF-385 之外，助推器之前的八次飞行支持了星链任务。 SpaceX 的西海岸无人机飞船 Of Course I Still Love You 将在 B1100 升空后约 8 分钟着陆时驻扎在地面。猎鹰 9 号是一枚直径 3.9 米、高 70 米的两级火箭。九台 Merlin 1D 发动机为第一级助推器提供动力，而第二级则使用一台真空优化的 Merlin 发动机。猎鹰 9 号和猎鹰重型火箭是第一批实现定期重复使用的轨道火箭，其中一枚猎鹰助推器已飞行 37 次。飞行后，两个有效载荷整流罩也被回收并重复使用。长征8A | SatNet LEO Group 本周第二次中国发射计划于 11 月 11 日星期五举行。
世界标准时间 20 日 11:00，在中国文昌航天发射场的商业 LC-1 发射台上发射。长征 8A (CZ-8A) 将携带 9 颗通信卫星进入近地轨道，这些卫星由 SatNet 拥有并由中国卫星网络集团运营。 CZ-8A火箭有两个直径3.35米的级，总高度为50.54 m。第一级由两个捆绑式液体燃料助推器辅助。此次飞行将标志着 CZ-8A 的第 13 次飞行，也是 2026 年的第七次飞行。 NROL-136 SpaceX 本周的第二次猎鹰 9 号任务定于 11 月 21 日星期六太平洋标准时间凌晨 4:30（世界标准时间 12:30）发射，同样是从加州 VSFB 的 SLC-4E 发射。 NROL-136 任务将携带未知数量的有效载荷进入近地轨道，供国家侦察办公室 (NRO) 的增殖建筑星座使用，该星座由 Space 建造

【原文 English Original】
Following a week of busy launch activity, the worldwide launch manifest is set to see six launches this week, with three SpaceX Falcon 9 missions from Vandenberg, two Chinese missions, and an Ariane 6 mission from South America. SpaceX will launch payloads for the United States Space Force and the National Reconnaissance Office, while at least one of this week’s Chinese missions and the Ariane 6 will launch a batch of internet satellites. Chang Zheng 2D | Unknown Payload Wednesday, Nov. 18, will see a launch from China, with a Chang Zheng 2D (CZ-2D) expected to launch from Launch Complex 9 (LC-9) at the Taiyuan Satellite Launch Center at 22:50 UTC. Official warning notices indicate a southerly launch trajectory, but details of the payload and its intended orbit will not be released until after launch. The two-stage, 40.77-m-tall CZ-2D is manufactured by the Shanghai Academy of Spaceflight Technology (SAST). The 2D variant requires no additional strap-on boosters. This flight will mark the 108th CZ-2D to fly, the seventh of this year. Falcon 9 | USSF-317 (R-6) SpaceX’s first of two launches this week comes on Wednesday, Nov. 18, at the start of a four-hour launch window that opens at 7:00 PM PST (03:00 UTC on Thursday). The only mission for the United States Space Force (USSF) this week, the USSF-317 mission will launch from Space Launch Complex 4 East (SLC-4E) at Vandenberg Space Force Base (VSFB) in California, flying southeast to place its classified payload into low-Earth orbit (LEO). All systems are looking good, and weather is favorable for liftoff. Propellant load is about to begin for Falcon 9’s launch of the USSF-627 mission from California → https://t.co/IdlZbviZZl pic.twitter.com/fKxyN4DIui — SpaceX (@SpaceX) November 12, 2026 Booster B1100 will support this mission, marking its eleventh flight since first supporting Starlink Group 11-30 nearly a year ago on Nov. 23, 2025. Eight of the booster’s previous flights supported Starlink missions, in addition to flying NROL-105 and USSF-385. SpaceX’s west coast droneship, Of Course I Still Love You, will be stationed downrange for B1100’s landing approximately eight minutes after liftoff. Falcon 9 is a 3.9-m-diameter, 70-m-tall two-stage rocket. Nine Merlin 1D engines power the first-stage booster, while the second stage uses a single vacuum-optimized Merlin engine. Falcon 9 and Falcon Heavy were the first orbital rockets to achieve regular re-use, with one Falcon booster having flown 37 flights. The two payload fairings are also recovered and reused after flight. Chang Zheng 8A | SatNet LEO Group The second Chinese launch of the week is scheduled for Friday, Nov. 20, at 11:00 UTC from the Commercial LC-1 pad at the Wenchang Space Launch Site in China. A Chang Zheng 8A (CZ-8A) will carry nine communications satellites into LEO, with the satellites owned by SatNet and operated by the China Satellite Network Group. The CZ-8A rocket features two 3.35-m-diameter stages, with a total height of 50.54 m. The first stage is assisted by two strap-on liquid-fuelled boosters. This flight will mark the 13th overall CZ-8A flight, the seventh of 2026. Falcon 9 | NROL-136 SpaceX’s second Falcon 9 mission of the week is scheduled to launch on Saturday, Nov. 21, at 4:30 AM PST (12:30 UTC), again from SLC-4E at VSFB in California. The NROL-136 mission will carry an unknown number of payloads into LEO for the National Reconnaissance Office’s (NRO) Proliferated Architecture constellation, built by SpaceX and Northrop Grumman. The booster supporting this mission will be B1097, flying for the 14th time. This booster first flew on Sept. 3, 2025, and has previously flown eight Starlink missions, as well as NROL-172, Transporter 17, Sentinel-6B, Twilight (Pandora & Others), and USSF-259. Following stage separation, B1097 will conduct a return-to-launch-site landing at Landing Zone 4 (LZ-4), located directly next to SLC-4E. Ariane 64 | Amazon Leo (LE-04) Amazon is continuing to put together its constellation of Leo satellites and will add another 36 on Monday, Nov. 23, at 10:12 UTC aboard an Ariane 64. The rocket will launch from Ensemble de Lancement Ariane 4 (ELA-4) at the Guiana Space Centre in French Guiana, with the launch window lasting five hours and 27 minutes. Ariane 64 will follow a northeastern trajectory, delivering 22,000 kg of Leo satellites into LEO. Ariane 64 is a 62-m-tall, 5.4-m-diameter, expendable two-stage rocket built by the ArianeGroup on behalf of the European Space Agency. Both stages are powered by liquid hydrogen and oxygen-fuelled engines. The 64 variant of the basic Ariane 6 utilizes four P129 strap-on solid rocket boosters to provide additional lift-off thrust. This will be the fifth Ariane 6 mission of 2026. Watch the full replay of #VA269 . Relive Ariane 6's successful mission carrying 36 Amazon Leo satellites into orbit. First flight with P160C boosters Heaviest Ariane payload ever #LaunchingAmbitions #Ariane6 #VA269 @Amazonleo @ArianeGroup @esa @CNES @EuropeSpacePort pic.twitter.com/YLxW60wAo1 — Arianespace (@Arianespace) June 17, 2026 Falcon 9 | USSF-266 (TH-3) Closing out the week, a Falcon 9 launch is currently scheduled for Monday, Nov. 23, at 8:04 AM PST (16:04 UTC) — the third this week from SLC-4E at VSFB. The classified USSF-266 mission has a four-hour launch window extending to 12:04 PM PST (20:04 UTC). Falcon 9 will fly due south, indicating a polar orbit for the payload. While the payload is classified, the launch trajectory and other factors suggest that this may be an additional batch of satellites for the USSF’s Space-Based Airborne Moving Target Indicator (SB-AMTI) program. These are based on the SpaceX Starshield satellite bus. The Falcon 9 booster supporting this flight will be B1081, making its 29th flight. B1081 first flew on Aug. 26, 2023, and flew four missions from SpaceX’s Florida launch sites before moving to Vandenberg for Transporter 10, where it has operated since then. The booster will land atop Of Course I Still Love You , stationed approximately 640 km downrange in the Pacific Ocean. If the current schedule holds, this will mark the 122nd Falcon 9 flight of 2026, and the 273rd orbital launch attempt worldwide in 2026. (Lead Image: Falcon 9 launches into the Florida morning skies. Credit: Julia Bergeron for NSF) The post Launch Preview: Ariane 6 to launch Amazon satellites, Falcon 9 to launch government missions appeared first on NASASpaceFlight.com .

Transmittal No. RSAT 26-103
Notice of Proposed Issuance of Letter of Offer Pursuant to Section 36(b)(1) of the Arms Export Control Act, as amended
(i) Prospective Purchaser: Government of Australia
Major Defense Equipment* $ 0 Other $300 million TOTAL $300 million
(iii) Description and Quantity or Quantities of Articles or Services under Consideration for Purchase:
The following non-MDE items will be included: Theater Mission Planning Center (TMPC) and associated communications systems; TMPC Mission Planning System (MPS); program management; engineering, training, and logistics services to support the development, procurement, and delivery of the MPS; and other related elements of logistics and program support.
(iv) Military Department: Navy (AT-P-FBT)
(v) Prior Related Cases, if any: AT-P-LGJ
(vi) Sales Commission, Fee, etc., Paid, Offered, or Agreed to be Paid: None known at this time
(vii) Sensitivity of Technology Contained in the Defense Article or Defense Services Proposed to be Sold: See Attached Annex
(viii) Date Report Delivered to Congress: October 8, 2026
* as defined in Section 47(6) of the Arms Export Control Act.
Australia—Tomahawk Capability Development
The Government of Australia has requested to buy Theater Mission Planning Center (TMPC) and associated communications systems; TMPC Mission Planning System (MPS); program management; engineering, training, and logistics services to support the development, procurement, and delivery of the MPS; and other related elements of logistics and program support. The estimated total cost is $300 million.
This proposed sale will support the foreign policy and national security objectives of the United States. Australia is one of our most important allies in the Western Pacific. The strategic location of this political and economic power contributes significantly to ensuring peace and economic stability in the Western Pacific. It is vital to the U.S. national interest to assist our ally in developing and maintaining a strong and ready self-defense capability.
This proposed sale will improve Australia's capability to meet current and future threats by enhancing its Tomahawk capability, strengthening its ability to deter regional threats, and improving its homeland defense. Australia will improve its interoperability with U.S. maritime forces and other allied forces as well as its ability to contribute to missions of mutual interest. Australia will have no difficulty absorbing these articles and services into its armed forces.
The proposed sale of this equipment and support will not alter the basic military balance in the region.
The principal contractors will be BAE Systems, located in San Diego, CA; Tapestry Solutions, located in St. Louis, MO; Peraton, located in San Jose, CA; and Leidos, located in Virginia Beach, VA. At this time, the U.S. Government is not aware of any offset agreement proposed in connection with this potential sale. Any offset agreement will be defined in negotiations between the purchaser and the contractor.
Implementation of this proposed sale will not require the assignment of any additional U.S. Government or contractor representatives to Australia.
There will be no adverse impact on U.S. defense readiness as a result of this proposed sale.
Notice of Proposed Issuance of Letter of Offer Pursuant to Section 36(b)(1) of the Arms Export Control Act
1. The Theater Mission Planning Center (TMPC) communications system and Mission Planning Systems (MPS) hardware and software provides the capability to plan, produce, and distribute autonomously created Tomahawk missions to Royal Australian Navy firing units. The Tomahawk mission planning capability contains sensitive technology, hardware, and software that enhances the operational employment of the Tomahawk Land Attack Missile.
2. The highest level of classification of defense articles, components, and services included in this potential sale is TOP SECRET/SENSITIVE COMPARTMENTED INFORMATION.
3. If a technologically advanced adversary were to obtain knowledge of the specific hardware and software elements, the information could be used to develop countermeasures that might reduce system effectiveness or be used in the development of a system with similar or advanced capabilities.
4. A determination has been made that Australia can provide substantially the same degree of protection for the sensitive technology being released as the U.S. Government. This proposed sale is necessary in furtherance of the U.S. foreign policy and national security objectives outlined in the Policy Justification.
5. All defense articles, technical data, and services listed in this transmittal have been authorized for release and export to the Government of Australia.

content:
加拿大溫哥華東區國會議員關慧貞就「香港救生艇」計劃提出訴求，希望移民部長能正視問題，早日作出修改。（關慧貞國會議員辦事處）
【大紀元2026年11月20日訊】（大紀元記者楊欣文加拿大溫哥華報導）為了救助被中共迫害而逃到加拿大的港人，加拿大政府順應在地的香港社團和關心事態發展的民選議員的倡議和推動，於2021年推出了特別人道救助通道——救生艇計劃。該計劃曾一度陷入困境，本月初終於迎來了轉機。高度關注並積極推動「救生艇計劃」的國會議員關慧貞（Jenny Kwan）在接受大紀元記者的採訪中表示，她對目前的解決方案感到滿意。
加拿大移民難民及公民部11月10日宣布了最新的解決方案。根據最新安排，移民部將利用2027年的額外永居名額，加快處理尚未完成審批的香港申請，目標是在明年內處理所有剩餘申請。預計接收的最多3.2萬名永久居民包括主申請人及其家屬。聯邦新民主黨國會議員關慧貞表示：「這是加拿大香港救生艇計劃的朋友非常需要的。」
她指出，雖然加拿大政府承諾會儘快處理救生艇計劃，包括Stream A（留學移民途徑、In-Canada graduates）和Stream B （工作移民途徑、Canadian work experience）申請者的永久居民身分積壓案子，但聯邦自由黨政府削減了配額，去年政府宣布只會發出約5,800個永久居民身分配額，給包括香港救生艇計劃、烏克蘭和蘇丹的難民申請者。「我們一直追問政府，說這是不可以接受的。你不可以一方面說是非常支持香港的朋友，但是另一方面，永久居民身分的處理程序要等10年。」「我們呼籲政府要立即採取行動，拿出新的解決方案。」
她補充：「除了發信追問政府、在國會質問移民部長之外，我們也都在社區發動了一個簽名運動，敦促政府儘快采取措施解決申請積壓的問題。很短時間就有超過2萬人簽了名。」
關慧貞在國會提出：「第一，加拿大政府要兌現承諾，支持香港和烏克蘭的朋友；第二，政府不可以拿其他難民或者另外項目的永久居民身分配額來給救生艇項目用。其他難民的需要同樣緊急，所以我們不可以拿了他們的配額，自己上了岸，不理會他人。」
關慧貞很滿意政府這次宣布的解決方案， 「因為政府做了我們要求他們做的工作。」
回顧從提出救生艇計劃，一度陷入困境，到如今聯邦政府發布最新解決方案的這個過程，關慧貞十分感慨。
她表示，從雨傘運動開始，她就一直關注香港的局勢。香港反送中運動被鎮壓後，當時香港國安法正在推行，迫害已經開始在香港發生，特別是那些參與了運動的年輕人遇到了很多不同的困難。很多香港的朋友為了安全要離開香港，有些就來了加拿大，很多人沒有辦法再回香港了。
當時，關慧貞和多倫多以及溫哥華的香港社區、港人組織的朋友一起討論，尋找最好的方式來提供幫助，最後決定提出「救生艇」方案。
關慧貞立即在國會移民委員會（Immigration Committee）提議要就香港的情形進行討論（Study），並提出動議（Motion），促進加拿大政府採取行動來支持香港，包括設立一個特別移民的救生艇項目。
關慧貞提到，議員們對「救生艇計劃」都表示支持，但在項目怎麼運作上就出現了各種問題。「比如他們提議Stream A和Stream B的時候，關於畢業年限和工作經驗方面就設了很多的限制，很多這樣的限制其實是難以實行的。還有Stream A和Stream B，是給那些高等院校學生的，但是有些學生未必是高等院校學生（Postsecondary Student），有些甚至是中學生，所以就要不斷督促政府在執行上要逐步改善這些方面。幸好最後都取得了成功。」
關慧貞覺得，「救生艇計劃」在開始處理香港人永久居民申請時是比較快的，但是大約兩年前，政府的做法發生了改變，不僅是自由黨，保守黨也出現了反移民、反國際學生的態度，處理申請的速度慢了下來。等待越來越久，上了「救生艇」的香港人就開始不知所措、很擔心加拿大政府是不是想退縮、想反悔，還是發生了什麼事。
「到去年，加拿大政府把香港救生艇計劃和來自烏克蘭、蘇丹的難民三個特別的項目，全部歸到一個叫做『人道主義同情及其他』（Humanitarian Compassionate and Other）的類別，然後只給了5,800個移民配額。」她質問，「這三個項目的移民申請人加起來就超過6萬，你說5,800個配額要等多久才能處理完啊？」
關慧貞認爲，對於申請了這個計劃的香港人來説，「如果你是大學生，國際學生的學費是很貴的；如果一個家庭有學童，他們讀書的費用也很貴。人們想很快地安居樂業，但沒有那個永久居民身分，就很難落地生根。」
作為民選國會議員，關慧貞表示，她一直在追問政府，尋求解決方案，盡了最大的努力來幫助大家。
關慧貞回憶，開始時，她會根據求助個案的資料，發信去加拿大移民、難民及公民部，追問每一個案件。但是陸續有很多不同區域的人都來找她，求助的案件多到要用表格來登記，以一個辦公室的能力根本做不過來，她就把所有資料分門別類後全部都遞交給了移民、難民及公民部。她還呼籲大家一定要找本區的國會議員為自己發聲，因為越多議員在國會發聲，成功的機率就越大。
很多人找關慧貞幫忙，可能與她也是來自香港的移民、同時是聯邦新民主黨的移民、難民和公民事務的評論員有關之外，她覺得另一方面，是大家也看到新聞，知道哪一個國會議員站出來為他們發聲、為他們爭取。大家看到她不斷地在做這些工作，「會覺得Jenny是會幫到他們的。」
她的體會是，有時候大家雖然去爭取，可是遇到困難就放棄了，「但是我的做法就是不會放棄，一直為大家爭取、把握不同的機會爭取。」她舉例，比如她會利用在國會討論預算的短短幾分鐘時間，質詢移民部長給這麼少的移民配額給三個項目，造成這麼多的申請積壓，要到什麼時候才能處理好？因為加拿大移民、難民及公民部部長是總理卡尼委任的，所以間接地也是對總理的政策提出質疑。
關慧貞提到：「香港社區的朋友做過一個標語，寫著『承諾就是承諾！』（Promise Is A Promise！）「你承諾了，那些人來到了加拿大。如果知道加拿大政府根本就沒有意思快速處理大家的申請，人家或者會選擇去其它國家，所以這個承諾是很重要的，會影響到那些人最後的決定。加拿大政府不可以不兌現承諾，所以我們追問政府追得很緊。」
她強調，「Stand with Hong Kong」不只是一句口號，是要採取行動的。「現在他們被迫害、來到加拿大，你是不是會給他們一個機會讓他們可以落地生根呢？所以這些承諾是重要的，不可以隨便說說就算了。」
關慧貞表示，新方案因爲額外撥出了配額，所以符合stream A和stream B資格要求的救生艇計劃申請案件，應該都可以得到處理，這一點很重要。另外，加拿大政府現在承諾會在2027年處理完這些積壓案件，所以就要盯著，看它是不是真的這樣做。她也呼籲大家，如果遇到什麼問題，也要提出自己的意見。
她補充：「大家要知道，加拿大是民主的國家，我們發聲是可以追究政府責任（Hold the government to account）的。那個2萬多人的簽名運動，也是一種向政府施壓的方式，表示我們一定會再密切監督著你，我們是可以做到的。」她也希望大家要持續關注並要給加拿大政府施壓，防止政府突然間退縮或取消這個決定。
關慧貞還提到，當香港人通過救生艇計劃變成新移民後，這些新移民應該獲得移民安頓服務方面的支持。但是，加拿大政府在移民安頓服務方面的預算從去年開始已經在削減，所以她覺得加拿大政府如果希望新的移民在加拿大能夠安頓下來，是要給移民安置服務機構（Resettlement Service Agency）支持的。
另外，加拿大政府說2027年會處理完積壓申請，但政府去年削減了移民部3,300個職位，現在除了救生艇項目之外，還有其它的移民項目需要處理，所以她也會追問政府，要增加資源來處理這些積壓案件。
2026年6月，「救生艇計劃」申請人及支持者在溫哥華美術館外抗議，要求政府儘快解決港人永居申請延誤的問題， 關慧貞議員到場支持。（關慧貞國會議員辦事處）
生於香港的關慧貞覺得，1997年政權移交時，其實中共的那個「一國兩制」的承諾不只是對香港人的，也是給國際社會的。但現在香港發生了巨變，令她感到香港不再是以前的香港了。
作為明確表態支持香港人的加拿大國會議員，她表示自己也面對外國干涉（Foreign Interference）的問題，也都被中國政府針對（target）。她表示：「知道自己沒有辦法可以再回香港了，非常傷心。」
關慧貞表示，如今在香港，像黎智英、黃之鋒這些人被港共政府以各種方式不斷地增加刑期，剝奪人身自由和自由表達的權利。但是「我們在加拿大，我們有民主自由，我們一定要為他們發聲，我們一定不可以忘記，要繼續為他們爭取，並呼籲國際社會也為他們爭取、為他們發聲。「Stand with Hong Kong」不應是只在某個時刻說的一句話而已。

普京与特朗普的接触表明改善关系的可能性——前国会议员
丹尼斯·库西尼奇另外表示，两国领导人会晤后举行的三边峰会批准的最终宣言提到了俄罗斯、美国和中国提高石油产量和交付量的计划，这可能会导致在能源领域放松对俄罗斯的制裁
华盛顿，11 月 20 日。/塔斯社/。美国前国会议员丹尼斯·库西尼奇告诉塔斯社，俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京和美国领导人唐纳德·特朗普在深圳的接触表明改善双边关系的可能性。
1997年至2013年在国会下议院代表俄亥俄州的库西尼奇说：“当特朗普总统将普京总统视为他的朋友时，这非常重要，因为这意味着我们两国之间有一条改善关系的道路。”
双边会晤结束后，两国领导人在中国国家主席习近平的陪同下进行了三边会谈。
这位曾于 2004 年和 2008 年竞选总统并担任俄亥俄州克利夫兰市市长的前议员补充道：“当世界上三位最重要的领导人聚集在一起，只是会面，只是聚集在同一个地方并进行交谈时，这一点非常重要，因为当国家领导人拒绝相互交谈时，就会产生隔阂，不幸的是，这个隔阂可能会被误解和错误信息所填补。” “因此，在国际关系中，面对面的讨论应该始终受到重视。”
库西尼奇接着表示，三位领导人通过的最终宣言提到了三个国家提高石油产量和交付量的计划。
“事实上，关于增加精炼石油产品的生产和供应的讨论在几个方面都很重要。首先，对于俄罗斯来说，放松对能源的制裁非常重要，”他说。
俄罗斯、美国和中国总统在深圳APEC峰会期间举行会晤，这是有史以来的首次会晤。元首们就当前国际形势交换意见，表示致力于维护战略稳定和国际安全。领导人还通过了和平宣言。
