Putin-Trump contacts indicate possibility of improving ties — ex-congressman
Dennis Kucinich separately said that the final declaration approved at the trilateral summit, which took place after the meeting between the two leaders, mentions Russia, the US and China's plans to boost oil production and deliveries, which could lead to an easing of sanctions against Russia in the energy sector
WASHINGTON, November 20. /TASS/. Contacts between Russian President Vladimir Putin and US leader Donald Trump in Shenzhen indicate the possibility to improve bilateral relations, former US Congressman Dennis Kucinich told TASS.
"When President Trump greeted President Putin as his friend, that was very significant because it means that there is a path towards improved relations between our countries," said Kucinich, who represented Ohio in the lower chamber of Congress from 1997 to 2013.
After the bilateral meeting, the two leaders were joined by Chinese President Xi Jinping for talks in a trilateral format.
"When you have three of the most important leaders in the world come together, just meeting, just coming together in the same place, and talking, it is so important because when leaders of nations refuse to talk to each other, it creates a gap, which can be filled, unfortunately, with misunderstandings and misinformation," added the former lawmaker, who ran for president in 2004 and 2008 and served as mayor of Cleveland, Ohio. "And so, face to face discussions should always be at a premium in international relations."
Kucinich went on to say that the final declaration, adopted by the three leaders, mentions the three countries’ plans to boost oil production and deliveries.
"The fact that there was a discussion about increasing production and supply of refined petroleum products is important in a couple different ways. First of all, with respect to Russia, the easing of any sanctions on energy is very important," he said.
The presidents of Russia, the United States and China held a meeting on the sidelines of the APEC summit in Shenzhen, the first such meeting ever. The heads of state exchanged views on the current international situation and expressed their commitment to maintaining strategic stability and international security. The leaders also adopted a declaration on peace.

zh_title: 澳大利亚接收另外 13 架海鹰直升机中的首批 2 架
summary: 澳大利亚接收另外 13 架海鹰直升机中的首批 2 架 - 突破防御 澳大利亚皇家海军补给舰 HMAS Stalwart 在区域存在部署期间搭载的 MH-60R 直升机。 （照片：澳大利亚国防部）墨尔本 - 澳大利亚已接收另外 13 架西科斯基 MH-60R 海鹰海军直升机中的前两架，扩大了澳大利亚皇家海军的海上航空机队。澳大利亚国防部周四宣布，这些直升机已交付给新南威尔士州诺拉附近的澳大利亚皇家海军（RAN）基地信天翁号。
content:
澳大利亚接收另外 13 架海鹰直升机中的首批 2 架 - Breaking Defense
澳大利亚皇家海军补给舰 HMAS Stalwart 搭载的 MH-60R 直升机在区域部署中展示。 （图片：澳大利亚国防部）
墨尔本—澳大利亚已接收另外 13 架西科斯基 MH-60R 海鹰海军直升机中的前两架，扩大了澳大利亚皇家海军的海上航空机队。
澳大利亚国防部周四宣布，这些直升机已交付给新南威尔士州诺拉附近的澳大利亚皇家海军（RAN）基地信天翁号。
此次交付标志着堪培拉 SEA9100 项目第一阶段于 2022 年从洛克希德·马丁公司子公司西科斯基澳大利亚购买的第一对 13 架直升机，该项目旨在扩大澳大利亚皇家航空的直升机机队。此次采购包括另外 12 架 MH-60R 和第 13 架飞机，以替换 2021 年运营期间损失的一架飞机。
据西科斯基澳大利亚公司称，这些直升机将使澳大利亚皇家海军的海鹰机队数量从 23 架增加到 36 架，其余 11 架直升机预计将于 2028 年初抵达。
MH-60R主要用于反潜和反水面战，但也可以进行情报、监视和侦察；海上打击；搜救；和后勤支援任务。这些直升机配备了传感器套件、Mark 54 轻型鱼雷和地狱火空对地导弹。
澳大利亚国防部在一份声明中表示，增加澳大利亚皇家海军海鹰舰队“将使澳大利亚国防军能够在复杂的海上环境中有效作战，增强其保卫澳大利亚海上通道的能力，并为整个印度-太平洋地区的地区安全做出贡献”。
洛克希德·马丁澳大利亚公司保障总监克里夫·凯尔表示，澳大利亚皇家海军扩大的海鹰机队将扩展该直升机“在更多海军资产和作战环境中经过验证的能力，进一步加强澳大利亚检测和应对水面和水下威胁的能力”。
据洛克希德·马丁公司称，前两架直升机在运往澳大利亚之前在美国完成了飞行测试。副总理兼国防部长理查德·马勒斯在一份声明中表示，该飞机将在投入使用前进行针对 RAN 的改装，预计于 2027 年 4 月投入使用。
澳大利亚最初为其机队寻求额外 12 架 MH-60R，海军航空系统司令部于 2022 年 8 月授予了价值 5.03 亿美元的直升机对外军售合同。
然而，第 13 架直升机随后被添加到合同中，以替换 2021 年 10 月在菲律宾海试图降落在布里斯班号驱逐舰上时丢失的一架 MH-60R。

Australia receives first 2 of 13 additional Seahawk helicopters - Breaking Defense
The Royal Australian Navy replenishment ship HMAS Stalwart's embarked MH-60R helicopter shown during a regional presence deployment. (Photo: Australian Department of Defence)
MELBOURNE – Australia has received the first two of 13 additional Sikorsky MH-60R Seahawk naval helicopters, expanding the Royal Australian Navy’s maritime aviation fleet.
The helicopters were delivered to the Royal Australian Navy (RAN) base HMAS Albatross near Nowra in New South Wales, Australia’s Department of Defence announced Thursday.
The delivery marks the first pair of 13 helicopters purchased from Lockheed Martin subsidiary Sikorsky Australia in 2022 under Canberra’s Project SEA9100 Phase 1, which aims to expand the RAN’s helicopter fleet. The acquisition included 12 additional MH-60Rs and a 13th aircraft to replace one lost during operations in 2021.
The helicopters will increase the RAN’s Seahawk fleet fleet from 23 to 36 aircraft, with the remaining 11 helicopters are expected to arrive by early 2028, according to Sikorsky Australia.
The MH-60R is primarily designed for anti-submarine and anti-surface warfare, but can also conduct intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance; maritime strike; search and rescue; and logistics support missions. The helicopters are equipped with a sensor suite, as well as Mark 54 lightweight torpedoes and Hellfire air-to-surface missiles.
Increasing the Royal Australian Navy’s Seahawk fleet “will allow the ADF to effectively operate in complex maritime environments and enhance its ability to defend Australia’s maritime approaches and contribute to regional security across the Indo-Pacific,” the Australian Defence Department said in a statement.
Cliff Kyle, sustainment director at Lockheed Martin Australia, said the RAN’s expanded Seahawk fleet will extend the helicopter’s “proven capability across more Navy assets and operational environments, further strengthening Australia’s ability to detect and respond to surface and subsurface threats.”
The first two helicopters completed flight testing in the United States before being transported to Australia, according to Lockheed Martin. The aircraft will undergo RAN-specific modifications before entering service, which is expected in April 2027, Deputy Prime Minister and Defense Minister Richard Marles said in a statement.
Australia initially sought 12 additional MH-60Rs for its fleet, with the $503 million Foreign Military Sales contract for the helicopters awarded by Naval Air Systems Command in August 2022.
However, the 13th helicopter was subsequently added to the contract to replace an MH-60R lost while attempting to land on board the destroyer HMAS Brisbane in the Philippine Sea in October 2021.

content:
CycloKinetics 赢得五角大楼价值 8630 万美元的替代燃料合同 - Breaking Defense
2026 年 11 月 9 日，日本三泽空军基地，一名分配到第 13 飞机维修部队的美国飞行员在飞行后恢复操作中为一架 F-35A Lightning II 加油。（美国空军一等兵 Angelica Winther 拍摄）
华盛顿——该公司独家向《Breaking Defense》透露，五角大楼已授予初创公司 CycloKinetics 一份 8630 万美元的合同，以推进可为美国军用飞机、太空发射和武器提供动力的替代燃料来源的开发。
这家总部位于犹他州的初创公司成立于 2009 年，十多年来一直与国防部合作开发推进剂，这些推进剂可以作为传统喷气燃料和其他推进源的“直接”替代品，这意味着它们可以用于现有的发动机和燃料系统，而无需进行重大修改。 CycloKinetics 首席执行官 Mukund Karanjikar 表示，该公司的推进剂解决方案（源自环烷烃）拥有“卓越的能量含量”，本质上使它们能够在相同的体积内产生更大的冲击力。
“就物体飞行的方式而言，它们以兆焦耳飞行。它们不是以升或公斤飞行，”卡兰吉卡说。
The new award from the Pentagon, revealed today, is “to set a process prototype for demonstrating ultimately what scalability will look like when we go full commercial,” he said ahead of the announcement.他补充说，该公司已经筹集了外部私人资本，未来的融资可能是完全私人的，也可能是公共和私人合作伙伴关系的混合。 At scale, the company could produce “tens of millions of gallons” of fuel annually from one manufacturing facility.
CycloKinetics is specifically forging three key products: a jet fuel substitute known as CycloJP, rocket fuel called CycloRP and a missile propellant dubbed CK-10. Karanjikar said the jet and missile fuels can extend a platform’s reach, and in the case of aircraft, he has previously claimed the fuel could increase range by about 30 percent. The CycloRP solution, meanwhile, could pave the way to “higher mass to orbit,” he said.
The company has successfully tested its solutions on military platforms, he said, though he declined to identify them. Those tests have demonstrated that the propellants can serve as drop-in replacements while delivering performance advantages over conventional fuels, he said.
“The outstanding question,” he continued, “is how soon can we make it, and how soon can we make a lot of it” to “get this into the hands of the warfighter.”

【原文 English Original】
CycloKinetics wins $86.3 million Pentagon contract for alternative fuels - Breaking Defense
A U.S. Airman assigned to the 13th Aircraft Maintenance Unit refuels an F-35A Lightning II during post-flight recovery operations at Misawa Air Base, Japan, Nov. 9, 2026. (U.S. Air Force photo by Airman 1st Class Angelica Winther)
WASHINGTON — The Pentagon has awarded startup CycloKinetics an $86.3 million contract to advance the development of alternative fuel sources that could power US military aircraft, space launch and weapons, the company exclusively told Breaking Defense.
Founded in 2009, the Utah-based startup has worked with the Defense Department for over a decade to develop propellants that could serve as “drop-in” replacements for traditional jet fuel and other propulsion sources, meaning they can be used in existing engines and fuel systems without requiring major modifications. According to CycloKinetics CEO Mukund Karanjikar, the company’s propellant solutions — derived from cyclo-paraffinic hydrocarbons — possess “superior energy content,” essentially enabling them to pack a greater punch in the same volume.
“The way things fly, they fly on megajoules. They don’t fly on liters or kilos,” Karanjikar said.
The new award from the Pentagon, revealed today, is “to set a process prototype for demonstrating ultimately what scalability will look like when we go full commercial,” he said ahead of the announcement. The company has raised outside private capital, and future financing could be fully private or a blend of public and private partnership, he added. At scale, the company could produce “tens of millions of gallons” of fuel annually from one manufacturing facility.
CycloKinetics is specifically forging three key products: a jet fuel substitute known as CycloJP, rocket fuel called CycloRP and a missile propellant dubbed CK-10. Karanjikar said the jet and missile fuels can extend a platform’s reach, and in the case of aircraft, he has previously claimed the fuel could increase range by about 30 percent. The CycloRP solution, meanwhile, could pave the way to “higher mass to orbit,” he said.
The company has successfully tested its solutions on military platforms, he said, though he declined to identify them. Those tests have demonstrated that the propellants can serve as drop-in replacements while delivering performance advantages over conventional fuels, he said.
“The outstanding question,” he continued, “is how soon can we make it, and how soon can we make a lot of it” to “get this into the hands of the warfighter.”

title: 台防長盼藉國防藝文軟實力 凝聚官兵士氣
summary: 2026年11月19日，中華民國國防部部長顧立雄（右3）與台北101董事長賈永婕（右4）共同頒發「國軍文藝終身成就獎」，表彰鄧鎮湘、賴乾驊、李轂摩、唐健風及王立楨等5位得主。（軍聞社提供） 【大紀元2026年11月20日訊】（大紀元記者鍾元台灣報導）19日晚間，中華民國國防部於台北國際會議中心舉辦「國軍第60屆文藝金像獎」頒獎晚會，由部長顧立雄主持，他期盼透過國防藝文軟實力，凝聚官兵士氣向心，堅定守護國家信念，並向國際社會傳遞台灣珍視自由民主價值與自我防衛決心。 據軍聞社報導
content:
2026年11月19日，中華民國國防部部長顧立雄（右3）與台北101董事長賈永婕（右4）共同頒發「國軍文藝終身成就獎」，表彰鄧鎮湘、賴乾驊、李轂摩、唐健風及王立楨等5位得主。（軍聞社提供）
【大紀元2026年11月20日訊】（大紀元記者鍾元台灣報導）19日晚間，中華民國國防部於台北國際會議中心舉辦「國軍第60屆文藝金像獎」頒獎晚會，由部長顧立雄主持，他期盼透過國防藝文軟實力，凝聚官兵士氣向心，堅定守護國家信念，並向國際社會傳遞台灣珍視自由民主價值與自我防衛決心。
據軍聞社報導，「國軍第60屆文藝金像獎」頒獎晚會，以「藝萃成金，甲子榮光」為主題，透過歷史影像、藝人、民間藝文團體及國防部藝工隊表演，回顧國軍自民國42（1953）年辦理文化康樂大競賽、新文藝運動到金笙獎，以及當代的多媒體、文創品、勵志歌曲的發展歷程。
晚會見證國軍推動軍中文藝一甲子以來的豐碩成果，並頒發今年各類金像獎，國防大學蟬聯團體總錦標。顧立雄並與台北101董事長賈永婕共同頒發「國軍文藝終身成就獎」，表彰鄧鎮湘、賴乾驊、李轂摩、唐健風及王立楨等5位得主在歌曲創作、戲劇教育、水墨書法、軍旅紀實及航空文學等領域的貢獻。
顧立雄致詞指出，國軍自民國54（1965）年推動新文藝運動，鼓勵官兵透過文學、音樂、美術與戲劇，記錄軍旅生活並涵養精神戰力，國軍文藝金像獎邁入第60屆，不僅見證國軍文化的傳承創新，更為國家留下了每個世代珍貴的歷史記憶，舉辦國軍文藝金像獎，也為台灣培育出許多知名藝術家及演藝人員。
顧立雄提到，國軍文藝金像獎近年來與時俱進、創新突破，參加對象從國軍官兵，到開放社會人士與國際友人參與，甄選類別從傳統美術、文字、軍歌，增加多媒體、文創與軍事模型等。
他期盼透過國防藝文軟實力，凝聚官兵士氣向心，堅定守護國家信念，讓社會大眾理解國軍，認同國防，並向國際社會傳遞台灣珍視自由民主價值與自我防衛決心。
頒獎晚會由國防部藝工隊與「藝響台灣劇團」以戰鼓及舞蹈揭幕，星光藝人周定緯、盧學叡更以舞台劇《那一年，學長教我唱的軍歌》將《老兵》、《豪情》等經典軍歌融入劇情；「仁山仁海藝想堂」則將傳統歌仔戲、客家戲、京劇與現代歌舞同台，展現台灣多元文化元素。最後，由金曲歌王蕭煌奇獻唱《逆風飛翔》、《你是我的眼》等歌曲，為典禮帶來最高潮。
國防部說，今年文藝金像獎共計有美術、文字、音樂、文創、多媒體等5類1,842件作品參賽，是歷年之最，獲獎作品174件。推動國軍新文藝運動60餘年來，感謝官兵與民間創作者以文字、音樂、美術及影像，記錄不同世代的軍旅生活，也讓社會各界從作品認識國軍。
國防部表示，未來將持續鼓勵藝文創作與交流，展現國軍精神戰力，深化全民國防教育。

title: 美中俄三角博弈 學者：習近平陷戰略兩難
summary: 亞太和平研究基金會執行長董立文。（宋碧龍／大紀元） 【大紀元2026年11月20日訊】（大紀元記者吳旻洲台灣台北報導）美中俄領導人在APEC首度同台會晤，引發國際關注。學者20日分析，這場峰會只是三大強權爭取各自利益的政治展演，未來真正值得觀察的是後續的博弈，各方是否會重新調整結盟關係，而中共黨魁習近平在美俄各自提出不同談判議題的情況下，陷入難以選邊、進退兩難的戰略困境。 國策研究院20日舉行「東協、APEC、川普亞洲行」座談會，邀請多名學者分析近期國際局勢。董立文表示，近期
content:
亞太和平研究基金會執行長董立文。（宋碧龍／大紀元）
【大紀元2026年11月20日訊】（大紀元記者吳旻洲台灣台北報導）美中俄領導人在APEC首度同台會晤，引發國際關注。學者20日分析，這場峰會只是三大強權爭取各自利益的政治展演，未來真正值得觀察的是後續的博弈，各方是否會重新調整結盟關係，而中共黨魁習近平在美俄各自提出不同談判議題的情況下，陷入難以選邊、進退兩難的戰略困境。
國策研究院20日舉行「東協、APEC、川普亞洲行」座談會，邀請多名學者分析近期國際局勢。董立文表示，近期重大國際事件接連登場，但相較於受到高度關注的深圳高峰會，歐洲及菲律賓舉行的相關會議，反而可能產生更多實質成果。
董立文表示，本屆APEC打破過去30年慣例，沒有公布由各經濟體領袖共同協調形成的領袖宣言，反而是以2000家企業共同推出所謂的「深圳倡議」，形同降低APEC的政治與經濟協調功能，也讓外界質疑中共舉辦峰會的真正目的。
他進一步分析，深圳倡議提出深化開放型區域經濟、技術創新驅動與包容性成長、促進區域一體化，以及攜手實現共同繁榮等四大目標，表面上都是正面訴求，但實際上卻與當前國際經濟及科技發展趨勢存在落差。
尤其在美中科技競爭持續升高的情況下，晶片供應鏈正朝向分化與重組發展，美國未來勢必更加嚴格管制晶片製造設備及相關材料出口，區域經濟要重新整合並不容易。董立文認為，這次APEC提出的共同繁榮與區域整合願景，恐怕只是脫離現實的美好想像，甚至可能與未來發展背道而馳。
至於外界高度關注的美中俄三方峰會，董立文認為，會議不太可能達成具體、實質的協議，他以歷史經驗及國際關係理論分析，美中俄三方關係本質上是一場大國三角博弈，這套權力運作邏輯是，三方競爭之下，任何兩方都有可能暫時結盟，以取得對第三方的優勢。
他表示，這種結盟並不穩定，誰與誰合作、誰被排除在外，會隨著各方利益不斷變化，因此三方博弈始終充滿不確定性。這次峰會從籌備階段就已經呈現這種不穩定關係。俄羅斯總統普丁早在10月9日便提出，希望三方會談討論烏克蘭和平協議；10月19日，美國總統川普也表態有意參加，但他希望討論的卻是核武裁減協議。相較之下，習近平始終沒有明確表態是否參加，也沒有提出自己希望討論的議題。
董立文研判，中共黨魁習近平之所以保持沉默，可能是擔心美俄事先協調立場，甚至聯手形成對中共不利的局面。畢竟在三方博弈中，最令第三方擔憂的，就是另外兩方突然結盟。
董立文指出，三方會談雖然提出核武對話及防止核戰爭等主張，但這不代表各國會因此停止發展核武。核戰爭既打不贏，也打不得，這是大國都清楚的現實；然而，在核武威懾仍是大國競爭重要工具的情況下，各國不可能因此放棄自身的核武發展計畫。
他認為，未來中共仍會持續擴充核武能力，北韓也不會停止核武及飛彈發展，日本則可能重新檢討非核三原則，韓國發展核潛艦的方向也會受到區域安全情勢影響。換句話說，三方峰會即使強調核武對話，也不代表全球核武競爭就此降溫。
董立文特別提醒，這次三方會談真正值得注意的，不只是第一次會議達成什麼，而是未來是否形成常態化的三大國領袖會議機制。他認為，外交顧問已經提出未來核武議題可能持續透過三國會議處理，這才是值得關注的發展。
不過，董立文也強調，外界不必過度擔心三大強權會因此聯手主導全球秩序。因為要共同主導世界，三國必須先具備基本共識與共同利益，但美、中、俄三國在許多核心議題上仍存在重大分歧，彼此之間也充滿猜忌。
他認為，這場峰會只是三大強權各自爭取利益的一次政治展演，未來真正值得觀察的是第二次、第三次博弈，各方是否會重新調整結盟關係，以及美中俄三角關係如何牽動國際秩序與區域安全。◇

title: 許多中國人挨餓 習向秘魯大撒幣惹怒網民
summary: 2026年11月18日：在深圳國際通訊中心舉行的亞太經合組織（APEC）領導人非正式會議歡迎晚宴。(China Pool/Getty Images) 【大紀元2026年11月20日訊】（大紀元記者唐兵報導）深圳亞太經合組織（APEC）峰會期間，中共黨魁習近平在會見出席峰會的秘魯總統藤森慶子時，承諾向秘魯提供總值2,250萬美元的援助，大陸媒體報導未提及這筆援助的具體金額，但秘魯對外發布了。由於大量中國民眾陷於貧困，習近平再次對外大撒幣引發海外華人網民憤怒。 就在APEC峰會期
content:
2026年11月18日：在深圳國際通訊中心舉行的亞太經合組織（APEC）領導人非正式會議歡迎晚宴。(China Pool/Getty Images)
【大紀元2026年11月20日訊】（大紀元記者唐兵報導）深圳亞太經合組織（APEC）峰會期間，中共黨魁習近平在會見出席峰會的秘魯總統藤森慶子時，承諾向秘魯提供總值2,250萬美元的援助，大陸媒體報導未提及這筆援助的具體金額，但秘魯對外發布了。由於大量中國民眾陷於貧困，習近平再次對外大撒幣引發海外華人網民憤怒。
就在APEC峰會期間，網絡熱傳一段廣東汕頭一名女孩找不到工作，深夜餓倒馬路邊的視頻。大紀元獲悉，在APEC峰會期間，一名中國年輕人因為飢餓又沒錢買吃的，被迫翻垃圾桶找食物。
11月17日，習近平在深圳會見來華出席APEC峰會的秘魯總統藤森慶子（Keiko Fujimori）時，承諾向秘魯提供總值2,250萬美元的援助（包含1,500萬美元無償援助及價值750萬美元的機械設備），協助秘魯應對厄爾尼諾現象。
在新華社和央視新聞發布的官方通稿中，僅在轉述藤森慶子表態時帶過一句「感謝中方支持秘魯應對厄爾尼諾挑戰」，全文並未提及2,250萬美元這一具體援助金額。
這筆援助的具體金額是由藤森慶子在會晤後向媒體及社交平台X主動公開的，隨後路透社、秘魯媒體Peru21及港台和海外華文媒體廣泛報導。（鏈接）
在X平台上活躍的時評人Finding發帖表示：「受不了，受不了！完全受不了！中國向秘魯捐贈2,250萬美元！又開始大撒幣了！還好有X，要不然我們都不知道這回事情！」
華人網民大量跟帖：「中國政府除了不發給中國人民錢以外，誰都可以給。」「百姓可憐還被逼交社保被榨乾了。」「把2,250萬美元給（中國）老百姓分點不行嗎？」「哎，真的這麼大方，對自己的百姓好一點吧。」
「這事人民同意嗎？」「國內發一分錢都要精打細算，在外面上百萬、千萬地捐。」「明年還得多招一點稅務人員，多查查企業。」「中國沒有厄爾尼諾嗎？我請問呢。」
大紀元記者在中國社交媒體微博上僅查到零星帖子提及此事。俄媒「RT今日俄羅斯」帳號帖文提及了相關援助金額。該帖評論區已限制留言。
習近平上台後力推「一帶一路」戰略，大搞對外援助、巨額投資，並多次在中非合作論壇、中亞峰會等場合宣布大手筆無償援助、優惠貸款與債務減免，被稱為「大撒幣」。而這些支出來自中國納稅人，卻缺乏民主社會常見的公開事前聽證與獨立議會辯論，民眾難以知曉具體資金流向與評估報告。
據中共官方所謂的《新時代的中國國際發展合作》白皮書數據顯示，僅2013年至2018年，這6年間的對外援助總額就達2,702億元（人民幣，下同，年均約450億元），其中無償援助占47.30%（1,278億元），優惠貸款占48.52%（1,311億元），無息貸款占4.18%（113億元）。就在2025年6月的中亞峰會上，習近平也宣布向中亞五國提供15億元無償援助。
但是，中國本身有龐大的貧困人口。2020年5月28日，時任中共總理李克強在人大會議記者會上指出，中國有「6億人每個月的收入也就1,000元左右」。但2021年2月25日，習近平召開脫貧攻堅表彰大會，宣布全國脫貧攻堅取得「全面勝利」，並自吹這是「人間奇跡」，引發質疑。
近3年來，中國經濟持續下行、地方財政虧空、人民消費降級等等現象，頻頻見諸媒體報導。
近年來，中國經濟加速衰退，深圳、上海、蘇州、東莞等這些曾經的製造業基地越來越蕭條，大量工廠倒閉，許多找不到工作的打工人流落街頭。網上經常傳出年輕人餓暈甚至餓死街頭的視頻。
就在中共操辦「盛大的」深圳APEC峰會期間，11月17日晚間，汕頭市一名外賣員在網上分享一段視頻，顯示一名年輕女子倒臥在馬路邊的牆下。
這名外賣員表示，這個地方比較偏僻，幸虧自己路過時看到了她，否則可能會「出大事」。他到附近給女子買來兩罐牛奶，一口一口餵給她。一開始該女子還遞出手中的手機，說自己餓了好幾天了，想用手機換一口吃的。
這名外賣員詢問得知，這名女子是來打工的，但一直找不到工作，晚上就住在身後的亂草叢中。
在喝了幾口牛奶之後，這名女子才有了一點力氣，被攙扶起來勉強靠坐在牆角。
看到視頻，好多網民留言說感到「心酸」。還有人說，很難想像在現在這個時代，還會有人挨餓。
也有不少網民貼出深圳APEC峰會晚宴上的美食，感嘆「朱門酒肉臭，路有凍死骨」。
全场消费A公子买单https://t.co/6cgAFhBMhX
— 每日资讯 (@XiaoM17) November 19, 2026
有網民貼出中共在深圳為「外國客人們」打造的「豪華燈光秀」，怒斥老百姓的血汗錢就浪費在這種「面子工程」上。
深圳为了APEC也是拼了，搞这么大阵仗迎接这群刘姥姥们 https://t.co/n41pqnGnU3
— 米妙ego (@hongpiaopiao1) November 18, 2026
11月17日，大紀元記者的家人在大陸網上遇到一位20多歲的年輕人，對方是大學生。在交談中，年輕人問能不能給他20塊錢，他很餓，沒錢買東西吃。他說上班兩個月，廠裡都沒有發工資，快挺不下去了。
記者的家人因為身在海外，無法給他錢。年輕人說準備去垃圾桶翻翻有沒有吃的。記者的家人告訴他，堅強點，未來會好起來，中國人要靠自己。

尼泊尔警方因涉嫌网络诈骗拘留35名日本公民
周三，警察检查尼泊尔东部的一处度假村，拘留了 35 名日本公民和 5 名中国公民。 |尼泊尔警方 / 来自 Jiji

新德里——据当地媒体报道，尼泊尔警方在加德满都附近的一个度假胜地拘留了 35 名日本公民和 5 名中国公民。
据报道，周三被拘留的人涉嫌参与网络诈骗。日本公民与尼泊尔的此类欺诈行为有关联是不寻常的。
据报道，日本人租下了尼泊尔东部 Kavrepalanchok 地区海拔约 1,700 米的整个度假村。
他们表示，他们正在通过直播展示商品，但尚未发现此类商品。警方还在该设施中发现了一个类似警察局的区域。
拘留之前，警方在同一地区的另一处设施抓获了 36 名中国公民，没收了 49 台个人电脑和 155 部手机。
东南亚国家当局加大了打击网络诈骗的力度，其中柬埔寨是此类活动的主要中心，促使犯罪团伙将其基地转移到邻国。

Nepalese police detain 35 Japanese nationals over suspected online fraud
Police officers inspect a resort facility in eastern Nepal where 35 Japanese nationals and 5 Chinese nationals were detained on Wednesday. | Nepal Police / via Jiji
X Facebook LinkedIn Reddit Bluesky Threads Email Print Bookmark story Copy link
New Delhi – Nepalese police have detained 35 Japanese nationals and five Chinese nationals at a resort near Kathmandu, local media reported.
According to the reports, the detainees, who were taken into custody Wednesday, are suspected of having been involved in online fraud. It is unusual for Japanese nationals to be linked to such fraud in Nepal.
The Japanese nationals had reportedly rented the entire resort complex in the Kavrepalanchok district in eastern Nepal at an altitude of about 1,700 meters.
They said they were showcasing goods through livestreams, but no such items have been found. The police also discovered in the facility a section that resembled a police station.
Prior to the detention, police caught 36 Chinese nationals at another facility in the same district, seizing 49 personal computers and 155 mobile phones.
Authorities have stepped up efforts to combat online fraud in Southeast Asia, including Cambodia, a major hub for such operations, prompting criminal groups to shift their bases to neighboring countries.

content:
印度尼西亚普拉博沃与中国习近平讨论未来南海合作 |海峡时报
印度尼西亚普拉博沃与中国习近平讨论未来南海合作
立即注册：深入了解亚洲的快速发展
11月20日，印度尼西亚总统普拉博沃·苏比安托（左二）在深圳会见中国国家主席习近平。
发表于 2026 年 11 月 20 日 下午 02:32
更新于 2026 年 11 月 20 日 02:45
普拉博沃和习近平讨论了经济、投资和南海合作。两人均表示，两国关系日益密切，但海事交易在印度尼西亚仍然敏感。
印尼和中国启动了全面经济伙伴关系协定和价值718亿美元的四个战略伙伴关系的谈判，其中包括10个智慧城市。
习近平敦促开展重大项目，包括中国投资73亿美元的高铁，以及能源、矿产、人工智能、数字经济和清洁能源。
雅加达 - 印度尼西亚政府表示，印度尼西亚总统普拉博沃·苏比安托于 11 月 20 日会见了中国国家主席习近平，讨论经济和投资伙伴关系以及南海合作的发展。
普拉博沃办公室11月20日表示，两国都看到了在南海战略航道上建立伙伴关系的前景，包括在共同开发领域的讨论中取得进展。
“我们认为，我们的关系正在变得更加牢固，”普拉博沃说。 “我们已经达成了更加一致的理解。”
中国官方通讯社新华社对普拉博沃会议的报道没有明确提及南海，但援引普拉博沃的话说，海上共同开发取得了积极进展。
多年来，与中国在南海战略航道上的合作协议一直很敏感，一些国家对这些协议持谨慎态度，他们担心这些协议可能会被解读为使北京的巨大主张合法化。
2024 年 11 月，印尼在普拉博沃访华期间签署了一项海上开发协议，同意“在有重叠主张的地区共同开发”，此举引发了争议。
这一措辞引发了印度尼西亚的担忧，分析人士表示，这可能被解读为雅加达长期以来作为南海非声索国立场的改变，并有可能损害印度尼西亚在其专属经济区内开发资源的主权权利。
争议发生后不久，印尼外交部表示不承认中国对南海的主张，普拉博沃表示将“永远维护我们的主权”。
据新华社报道，中国和印度尼西亚在会上启动了全面经济伙伴关系协定谈判。
在两国领导人举行会晤之前，印度尼西亚和中国于 11 月 18 日达成协议，启动四项价值 718 亿美元（926.2 亿新元）的战略伙伴关系，其中包括开发 10 个智慧城市。
普拉博沃还在 11 月 19 日表示，印度尼西亚已批准加入世界人工智能合作组织，中国称该组织将促进人工智能领域的国际合作和全球治理。
新华社援引习近平的话说，习近平呼吁两国推进中国投资73亿美元的高铁等重大项目，深化能源矿产资源、人工智能、数字经济、清洁能源等领域合作。
普拉博沃就任总统后首次出访就到访中国，长期以来盛赞中国的发展

Indonesia and China launched talks on a Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement and four strategic partnerships worth US$71.8 billion, including 10 smart cities.
Xi urged work on major projects, including the US$7.3 billion China-funded bullet train, plus energy, minerals, AI, digital economy, and clean energy.
JAKARTA - Indonesia’s President Prabowo Subianto met with China’s President Xi Jinping on Nov 20 to discuss the economy and investment partnerships as well as developments in cooperation in the South China Sea, the Indonesian government said.
Both countries saw prospects for partnership in the strategic waterway of the South China Sea, including progress in discussions on areas for joint development, Prabowo’s office said on Nov 20.
“Our relationship, we think, keeps growing stronger,” Prabowo said. “We have reached a more aligned understanding.”
A report on the Prabowo meeting by Chinese state news agency Xinhua did not explicitly mention the South China Sea, but it cited Prabowo as saying that positive progress has been made in joint maritime development.
Cooperation agreements with China in the strategic waterway of the South China Sea have been sensitive for years, with some nations wary of deals they fear could be interpreted as legitimising Beijing’s vast claims.
Indonesia courted controversy in November 2024 when the two countries signed a maritime development deal, agreeing “on joint development in areas of overlapping claims” during Prabowo’s visit to China.
That wording sparked concern in Indonesia, with analysts saying it could be interpreted as a change in Jakarta’s long-held stance as a non-claimant state in the South China Sea, and risked compromising Indonesia’s sovereign rights to exploit resources in its exclusive economic zone.
Shortly after the controversy, Indonesia’s foreign ministry said it does not recognise China’s claims over the South China Sea and Prabowo said he would “always safeguard our sovereignty.”
China and Indonesia launched negotiations on a Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement at the meeting, Xinhua reported.
The meeting between the two leaders followed a Nov 18 agreement by Indonesia and China to launch four strategic partnerships worth US$71.8 billion (S$92.62 billion), including the development of 10 smart cities.
Prabowo also said on Nov 19 that Indonesia had ratified its membership in ​the World AI Cooperation Organisation, an intergovernmental body China said would promote international cooperation and global ​governance in artificial intelligence.
Xi called on both countries to advance major projects such as the US$7.3 billion China-funded bullet train, and deepen cooperation in energy and mineral resources, artificial intelligence, the digital economy, and clean energy, Xinhua cited Xi as saying.
Prabowo, who made China his first foreign visit after taking office as president, has long praised China’s poverty reduction and infrastructure development.
At the APEC gathering this week in Shenzhen, Prabowo expressed his “admiration” at the “historic” meeting between Xi, US President Donald Trump, and Russian President Vladimir Putin, his government communications agency said.
Prabowo’s remarks in Shenzhen reflect Indonesia’s long-standing foreign policy of non-alignment, the agency added.
Prabowo has said Indonesia would befriend every country, including China and the US. REUTERS

title: Taiwan tells Meta thousands of China-linked accounts seek to influence elections
zh_title: 台湾告诉 Meta 数千个与中国有关的账户试图影响选举
summary: 台湾在选举前标记与中国有关的 Threads 帐户《海峡时报》台湾告诉 Meta，数千个与中国有关的账户试图影响选举立即注册：了解亚洲快速发展的情况台湾标记了 2,400 个 Threads 账户，这些账户使用相似的中文名称和不同的数字 ID 分为 27 个集群。发表于 2026 年 11 月 20 日下午 01:36 更新于 2026 年 11 月 20 日下午 02:06 台湾告诉 Meta，近 2,700 个与中国相关的 Threads 账户涉嫌参与下周地方选举之前的影响力活动。官员称这些账户大多是新账户，batc
content:
台湾在选举前标记与中国有关的 Threads 帐户海峡时报
台湾告诉 Meta 数千个与中国有关的账户试图影响选举
立即注册：深入了解亚洲的快速发展
台湾标记了 2,400 个 Threads 帐户，这些帐户使用相似的中文名称和不同的数字 ID 分为 27 个集群。
发表于 2026 年 11 月 20 日 1:36
更新于 2026 年 11 月 20 日 02:06
台湾告诉 Meta，近 2,700 个与中国相关的 Threads 账户涉嫌参与下周地方选举之前的影响力活动。
官员们表示，这些账户大多是新的、批量创建的，用于散布分裂、降低对民主的信任并阻碍投票。
台湾还标记了 260 个账户分享了超过 2,150 个人工智能制作的视频，吸引了 235 万次互动，主要针对民进党政客。
台北 — — 据三名政府官员和内部报告称，台湾已向 Meta 标记了近 2,700 个社交媒体帐户，称这些帐户似乎是中国信息战活动的一部分，旨在影响下周台湾的选举。
据知情官员和路透社查阅的政府报告称，最近几周，台湾官员将 Threads（台湾流行的基于文本的元平台）上的账户确定为中国协调影响力行动的可疑工具。
其中一份报告称，这些账户几乎都是在过去四个月内开设的，似乎是分批创建的，而且大多数被识别为中国人。
11 月 28 日的市长和县长选举是 2028 年初总统选举之前，总统赖清德领导的民进党支持率的一个关键晴雨表 — — 中国称该党为“分裂”势力并拒绝与之接触。
台湾官员对北京方面表示担忧，北京声称民主治理的台湾是自己的领土，并在选举前加大了在网上影响选民的力度。台北拒绝北京的主权主张。
Meta 发言人表示，该公司还拥有 Facebook 和 Instagram，已删除了台湾政府标记的账户，其中许多账户已被其系统禁用。
该发言人在一份声明中表示，这些“低质量虚假账户”都没有发布与选举相关的话题，而且大多数都没有关注者，并补充说：“我们将继续对违反我们政策的账户采取行动。”
台湾官员表示，他们已确认部分账户已被删除。
中国台湾事务办公室没有回应置评请求。北京长期以来一直否认干涉台湾选举的指控。
调查此事的三名台湾安全官员表示，这一活动构成了更广泛的虚假信息模式的一部分，扩大了分裂性的政治叙事，并试图破坏对民主的信任。
一名官员表示：“他们不一定要求你支持某些候选人，但他们会让人们互相对立，对民主感到厌恶，选择不投票，并加剧选举分歧。”由于此事敏感，所有这些官员都要求匿名。
台湾国家安全委员会的一名官员告诉路透社，中国已利用社交媒体平台和其他手段试图影响有关台湾选举的言论，并补充说台北将继续与盟友和负责任的国家合作。

【原文 English Original】
Taiwan flags China-linked Threads accounts ahead of elections | The Straits Times
Taiwan tells Meta thousands of China-linked accounts seek to influence elections
Sign up now: Get insights on Asia's fast-moving developments
Taiwan flagged 2,400 Threads accounts which fell into 27 clusters using similar Chinese names and different numerical IDs.
Published Nov 20, 2026, 01:36 PM
Updated Nov 20, 2026, 02:06 PM
Taiwan told Meta nearly 2,700 China-linked Threads accounts were part of a suspected influence campaign before next week’s local elections.
Officials said the accounts were mostly new, batch-created and used to spread division, lower trust in democracy and discourage voting.
Taiwan also flagged 260 accounts sharing over 2,150 AI-made videos, which drew 2.35 million interactions and mainly targeted DPP politicians.
TAIPEI – Taiwan has flagged nearly 2,700 social media accounts to Meta that it says appear to be part of a Chinese information warfare campaign seeking to influence elections on the island next week, according to three government officials and internal reports.
In recent weeks, Taiwanese officials identified the accounts on Threads, a text-based Meta platform popular in Taiwan, as suspected vehicles for coordinated Chinese influence operations, according to the officials familiar with the matter and the government reports reviewed by Reuters.
The accounts, almost all of which were opened in the past four months, appeared to have been created in batches and most were identified as Chinese, according to one of the reports.
The Nov 28 elections for mayors and county chiefs are a key barometer of support for President Lai Ching-te’s Democratic Progressive Party – which China calls a “separatist” force and refuses to engage with – ahead of presidential elections in early 2028.
Taiwanese officials have expressed concern that Beijing, which claims democratically governed Taiwan as its own territory, is intensifying online efforts to sway voters before the elections. Taipei rejects Beijing’s sovereignty claims.
A Meta spokesperson said the company, which also owns Facebook and Instagram, had removed the accounts flagged by Taiwan's government, many of which had already been disabled by its systems.
None of these “low-quality fake accounts” had posted about election-related topics and most had no followers, the spokesperson said in a statement, adding: “We will continue to take action against accounts that violate our policies.”
Taiwanese officials said they had confirmed that some of the accounts had been taken down.
China’s Taiwan Affairs Office did not respond to a request for comment. Beijing has long rejected accusations it interferes in Taiwanese elections.
Three Taiwan security officials investigating the matter said the activity formed part of a broader pattern of disinformation, amplification of divisive political narratives and attempts to undermine trust in democracy.
“They don’t necessarily ask you to support certain candidates but they make people turn against each other, grow disgusted with democracy, choose not to vote, and they intensify election divisions,” said one of the officials, all of whom spoke on condition of the anonymity due to the sensitivity of the matter.
An official from Taiwan’s National Security Council told Reuters that China had used social media platforms and other means to try to influence the discourse around Taiwan’s elections, adding Taipei would continue to work with allies and responsible platforms to ensure elections were not affected by foreign forces.
Accounts sought to discourage voting, Taiwan says
Threads is the target of the alleged campaign because of its popularity in Taiwan, officials said, adding that they had not identified similar accounts on Instagram.
Of 2,400 Threads accounts flagged by Taiwan, 74% listed China as their location, while around 25% did not disclose one and 1% listed Russia, according to one government report.
It said the accounts fell into 27 clusters using similar Chinese names and different numerical IDs, suggesting they were batch-created.
“The assessment is that this batch of accounts was created in bulk by operators in China or Russia, likely with the aim of influencing Taiwan’s 2026 local elections,” the report said.
The accounts often sought to build credibility by first posing as ordinary Taiwanese users, sharing posts about everyday interests such as fortune-telling, another official said.
“Then one day, they start by criticising the government and attacking candidates, before saying they are disappointed with the ruling party and will therefore give up voting,” the official said.
Taiwan also told Meta that some 260 accounts had disseminated more than 2,150 AI-generated videos that officials say were part of the Chinese campaign, according to the officials and another internal report.
Those videos attracted 2.35 million interactions, including comments and shares, according to the report, which said most of the videos targeted DPP politicians and policies.
That included videos about Puma Shen, the party’s high-profile candidate for mayor of Taipei. Some accused him of bullying when he was a student. Shen has denied the allegations. REUTERS

content:
习近平赞扬中澳关系出现好转海峡时报
习近平称赞中澳关系“全面好转”
立即注册：深入了解亚洲的快速发展
中国国家主席习近平在会上提出加强农业、能源、绿色经济、人工智能等领域合作。
发布于 2026 年 11 月 20 日 12:50
更新于 2026 年 11 月 20 日 1:57
习近平表示，中澳两国已经实现“全面转变”，可以在农业、能源、绿色经济和人工智能等领域更加密切合作。
两位领导人都表示，他们将“建设性地、直接地”处理分歧，阿尔巴尼斯指出，稳定的关系对两国都有好处。
阿尔巴尼斯将访问北京并会见李强，而在紧张的铁矿石谈判和对贸易压力的担忧中，商务谈判仍在继续。
深圳/悉尼 - 国家主席习近平 11 月 20 日对澳大利亚总理安东尼·阿尔巴内塞表示，中澳两国可以在农业和人工智能等领域开展更多合作，并称赞两国关系“全面好转”。
习近平在深圳出席亚太经合组织峰会期间表示，中方愿同澳方一道，扩大合作，搁置分歧，在两​​国关系改善的基础上再接再厉，推动两国伙伴关系迈上新的发展阶段。
习近平说：“自你2022年就任总理以来，我们已举行四次会晤。我认为，可以说，我们共同推动了中澳关系的全面转圜。”
据中国官方新华社报道，习近平在会议上建议加强农业、能源、绿色经济和人工智能领域的合作，并加强人文交流。
在澳大利亚前中右翼联合政府的领导下，与澳大利亚最大贸易伙伴中国的关系恶化，该政府呼吁对 COVID-19 的起源进行调查，这激怒了北京。
此后，中国取消了对澳大利亚出口的一系列壁垒，尽管紧张局势偶尔会爆发，包括在中国向太平洋进行导弹试验以及北京以间谍罪名逮捕中国出生的澳大利亚国民之后。
阿尔巴内斯在会后的媒体吹风会上表示，将“建设性地、直接地”讨论分歧，稳定的关系符合两国的利益。
“重要的是，澳大利亚继续以建设性方式与中国接触，管理我们的分歧，但不被分歧所定义。今天，我们能够讨论一系列问题，”阿尔巴内塞说。
阿尔巴内塞预计将于 11 月 20 日晚些时候前往北京，并会见中国总理李强。
他将在包括力拓铁矿石业务负责人马特·霍尔茨（Matt Holcz）和必和必拓澳大利亚老板杰拉尔丁·斯拉特里（Geraldine Slattery）在内的多位澳大利亚企业高管的陪同下，与中国公司高管举行首席执行官圆桌会议。
此次会议召开之际，澳大利亚顶级矿商与中国国有铁矿石买家中国矿产资源集团之间的谈判日益紧张，因为集中化采购增加了中国在合同谈判中的议价能力。
澳大利亚资源部长马德琳·金本周表示，任何潜在的铁矿石贸易操纵行为都将违反国际规则，并对政府收入构成威胁。路透社

Xi hails turnaround in China-Australia ties | The Straits Times
Xi hails ‘comprehensive turnaround’ in China-Australia ties
Sign up now: Get insights on Asia's fast-moving developments
China’s President Xi Jinping suggested greater cooperation in agriculture, energy, the green economy and artificial intelligence in the meeting.
Published Nov 20, 2026, 12:50 PM
Updated Nov 20, 2026, 01:57 PM
Xi said China and Australia have made a “comprehensive turnaround” and can work more closely on agriculture, energy, the green economy and AI.
Both leaders said they would manage differences “constructively and directly”, as Albanese noted a stable relationship serves both countries.
Albanese will visit Beijing and meet Li Qiang, while business talks continue amid tense iron ore negotiations and concerns over trade pressure.
SHENZHEN/SYDNEY - China and Australia can cooperate more in areas such as agriculture and AI, President Xi Jinping told Prime Minister Anthony Albanese on Nov 20, hailing a "comprehensive turnaround" in the countries' relationship.
Speaking on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Forum (APEC) summit in Shenzhen, Xi said China was willing to work with Australia to expand cooperation, set aside differences and build on recent improvements in relations, taking the partnership to a new stage of development.
"Since you took office as prime minister in 2022, we have met four times. I think it is fair to say that together we have brought about a comprehensive turnaround in China-Australia relations," Xi said.
In the meeting, Xi suggested greater cooperation in agriculture, energy, the green economy and artificial intelligence, according to China's official Xinhua news agency, as well as stronger people-to-people exchanges.
Ties with China, Australia's top trade partner, soured under the country's previous centre-right coalition government, which called for an inquiry into the origins of COVID-19, angering Beijing.
China has since lifted a series of barriers on Australian exports, though tensions have occasionally flared, including after a Chinese missile test into the Pacific and Beijing's arrest of Chinese-born Australian nationals on spying charges.
In a media briefing after the meeting, Albanese said differences would be discussed "constructively and directly", and a stable relationship was in the interests of both nations.
"It is important that Australia continues to engage in a constructive way with China, manage our differences, but not be defined by them. And we, today, were able to discuss a full range of issues," Albanese said.
Albanese is expected to travel to Beijing later on Nov 20 and will meet Chinese Premier Li Qiang.
He will be accompanied by several top Australian business executives including Rio Tinto's head of iron ore Matt Holcz and BHP's Australia boss Geraldine Slattery for a CEO roundtable with Chinese company executives.
The meeting comes amid increasingly fraught negotiations between Australia's top miners and China's state iron ore buyer, China Mineral Resources Group, as centralisation of its buying increases the country's bargaining power in negotiating contracts.
Australian Resources Minister Madeleine King said this week that any potential manipulation of trade in iron ore would be against international rules and a threat to government revenues. REUTERS

content:
法國國民議會副議長蒲韻珼（左）20日率領國會議員暨電信監管機關聯合訪問團，拜會總統賴清德。（總統府提供）
標籤: 賴清德, 法國, 海纜, 合作, 台灣大紀元, 城市交流
【大紀元2026年11月20日訊】（大紀元記者吳旻洲台灣台北報導）法國國民議會副議長蒲韻珼（Marie-Agnès Poussier-Winsback）率領國會議員暨電信監管機關聯合訪問團訪台。總統賴清德20日接見訪團時表示，近年從歐洲到台海，海底電纜屢遭蓄意破壞，期盼台法深化海底電纜防護與風險管理合作，聯手打造更具韌性的國際海纜安全命脈。
本次跨黨派國會議員團由蒲韻珼率領，同行訪賓還包括法國國民議會友台小組副主席馬堤諾、電子通信、郵政暨新聞發行監管局執行長何蒂燁（Laure de La Raudière）、國民議會外交委員會書記游蘇法、議員帕蒙勒珂（Charlotte Parmentier-Lecocq）、貝哈達（Belkhir Belhaddad）、費歐蘭（Anne-Cècile Violland）等人。
賴清德首先感謝訪賓長期為台灣發聲，並感謝法國國會及政府以各項行動展現的支持，包括這個月在巴黎舉行的七大工業國集團（G7）外長會議，重申反對以武力或脅迫片面改變現狀，支持台灣有意義參與國際組織。
賴清德說，守護和平也包括確保關鍵基礎設施安全。近年從歐洲到台海，海底電纜屢遭蓄意破壞；為此，台灣提出「國際海底電纜風險管理倡議」，獲得許多歐洲國家國會議員的連署響應，共同守護通訊與能源傳輸的命脈。期盼在訪賓的支持之下，促成台法深化海底電纜防護與風險管理合作，聯手打造更具韌性的國際海纜安全命脈。
他表示，法國是台灣在歐盟第三大貿易夥伴，雙方從半導體、電動車、再生能源到太空科技，合作持續深化，盼未來透過制度化合作促進雙向投資與研發，共同打造更安全、穩固的民主供應鏈。
總統說，台灣希望與法國在科技以及民主經驗上，建構更緊密的夥伴關係；持續以行動，守護彼此珍視的自由、民主與人權價值，為兩國開創更繁榮的未來。
蒲韻珼致詞時表示，法國致力於維護台海和平，未來也將持續堅持此一立場，並透過明確且定期發表聲明，重申反對任何片面改變現狀，以及使用武力、威脅使用武力或採取脅迫手段。相關立場不僅在法國國內表達，也透過歐洲及多邊架構，包括近期七大工業國集團（G7）外長會議發表的聲明，持續重申法國立場。
蒲韻珼提到，法國非常重視台灣的民主，並希望在此基礎上，深化雙方在文化、教育及科學領域的合作。此外，配合總統推動的「青年百億海外圓夢基金計畫」，法國也接待多個台灣青年團體赴法交流，安排太空政策、足球、身心障礙者運動及科技等領域的參訪活動，並樂見雙方城市交流持續拓展至台北以外的地區，促進文化、藝術及教育合作。

通过增加菲律宾进口美国能源和农产品来减少对菲律宾的贸易逆差，这将为数以万计的美国工程师、技术人员和农民提供就业机会。波音公司和通用电气航空航天公司最终以 120 亿美元的价格向菲律宾航空公司出售多达 20 架配备通用电气航空航天发动机的波音 787 飞机，为美国提供 47,000 个就业岗位。美国和菲律宾将寻求历史性的超过20亿美元的对外军事融资（FMF）贷款计划，为菲律宾提供来自美国供应商的关键国防和安全能力，支持7000多个美国就业岗位，推进总统的国家安全战略和美国第一武器转让战略，同时保护美国纳税人的回报。特朗普总统的“美国优先”武器转让战略确保盟国支出的激增有利于美国国防工业，实现美国再工业化并支持美国就业，同时为我们的合作伙伴提供世界上最好的能力。美国将利用 4 亿美元的 FMF 帮助菲律宾军队扩大其在南海的作战范围和威慑能力，包括远程火力、指挥和控制、关键基础设施和多域无人机，支持 1,500 个美国就业岗位。美国和菲律宾同意合作，向菲律宾的主权云基础设施提供值得信赖的美国公司。

Trump concluded a two-day visit to the Philippines for a State Visit and the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) Summit, where he announced over $17 billion in commercial deals and strategic investments for U.S. companies that will support tens of thousands of American jobs, bolster regional security that protects the United States from illicit activity, and support a free and open Indo-Pacific that economically benefits American companies, workers, and consumers. SECURING HISTORIC DEALS WITH THE PHILIPPINES: President Ferdinand R. Marcos, Jr. hosted President Trump for a historic State Visit in Manila, where the two leaders announced landmark deals that will strengthen the U.S.-Philippine Alliance and support American companies and workers. The leaders also committed to eliminate the U.S. trade deficit with the Philippines through increased Philippine imports of American energy and agriculture products, which will support the jobs of tens of thousands of American engineers, technicians, and farmers. U.S. companies Boeing and GE Aerospace finalized a $12 billion sale to Philippine Airlines for up to 20 Boeing 787 aircrafts with GE Aerospace engines, supporting 47,000 U.S. jobs. The United States and the Philippines will pursue a historic Foreign Military Financing (FMF) loan package of more than $2 billion to provide the Philippines with critical defense and security capabilities from U.S. suppliers, supporting over 7,000 American jobs and advancing the President’s National Security Strategy and America First Arms Transfer Strategy, all while protecting returns for the American taxpayer. President Trump’s America First Arms Transfer Strategy ensures that the surge in allies’ spending benefits the U.S. defense industry, reindustrializing America and supporting American jobs while arming our partners with the best capabilities in the world. The United States will utilize $400 million in FMF for the Philippine military to expand its operational reach and deterrence capabilities in the South China Sea, including long-range fires, command and control, critical infrastructure, and multi-domain drones, supporting 1,500 American jobs. The United States and the Philippines agreed to partner on supply the Philippines’ sovereign cloud infrastructure with trusted U.S. Super Intelligence technology through the United States’ SI Exports Program. The Philippine Department of National Defense (DND) announced a $37 million contract with a U.S. firm, supporting 140 American jobs. The contract delivers SI-enabled mission support, expands U.S.-Philippine defense cooperation, and improves interoperability. The Philippine DND committed to work with trusted U.S. technology providers on a $63 million initiative to modernize its defense cloud infrastructure for SI use cases, supporting over 200 American jobs. The United States and the Philippines committed to improving cooperation in critical technologies. The United States and the Philippines announced exploration of an intergovernmental agreement on civil-nuclear technology which would open opportunities for U.S. nuclear companies, support American jobs, and generate gigawatts of energy for the Philippines. This marks the first U.S. civil-nuclear intergovernmental agreement with an Indo-Pacific partner. U.S. company Astranis announced it is offering connectivity services from its U.S.-manufactured AGILA satellite to the Philippines, a commercial opportunity worth up to $200 million, supporting 600 American jobs, to provide independent and secure communications infrastructure for the Philippine government and people. President Trump is leveraging strategic infrastructure to strengthen the U.S.-Philippine Alliance, secure critical supply chains, open new markets for American businesses, and support American workers. Subic Grain will build a new $40 million fuel storage depot at Subic Bay to support U.S. military and commercial operations. The United States and the Philippines announced that the Philippines will modernize its Basco Airport to improve U.S.-Philippine operational access, disaster response, and commercial supply chains in the Philippines’ northernmost islands. FINALIZING THE U.S.-THAILAND TRADE DEAL AND INCREASING MILITARY SALES:   At the ASEAN Summit, President Trump announced the substantial conclusion of a trade deal and a weapons sale with Thailand that will give American workers, manufacturers, farmers, ranchers, and businesses unprecedented access to Thailand’s market.   The trade deal, once signed, will eliminate tariffs on 99 percent of goods and remove non-tariff barriers on American vehicles, medical devices, pharmaceuticals, ethanol, and poultry, increasing market access for a full range of U.S. industrial and agricultural exports. The trade deal will also protect and enforce U.S. intellectual property, increase economic security alignment, and strengthen and enforce Thai labor and environmental laws to balance trade. Separately, Thailand intends to commit up to $123 million toward the purchase of America’s High Mobility Artillery Rocket Systems (HIMARS). The sale would give America’s treaty Ally long-range precision fires and support 400 American jobs and the U.S. defense industrial base. Once concluded, it would be the first deal of its kind in mainland Southeast Asia. SECURING INVESTMENT DEALS ACROSS SOUTHEAST ASIA:   President Trump opened new markets for American goods and created opportunities for U.S. companies, furthering U.S. leadership in digital connectivity across the region. In Indonesia, U.S. company Latitude Energy and Indonesian sovereign wealth fund Danantara announced negotiations on a $2 billion project that will use world-class U.S. technology to improve Indonesia’s utilization of its coal resources. Panasonic signed a multi-year agreement to buy advanced silicon-carbon anode materials from U.S. company Sila. The agreement is worth up to $1 billion and will support an additional 500 American jobs. In Malaysia, Navajo Transitional Energy Company (NTEC) signed a three-year $100 million agreement to supply coal from its southern Montana mine to TNB Fuel Services, the fuel procurement subsidiary of Malaysia’s national power utility, Tenaga Nasional Berhad. LEADING THE REGION IN SUPER INTELLIGENCE: In addition to Philippine commitments on American SI technology above, President Trump announced further deployment of American SI technology across the region through our SI Exports Program, cementing U.S. firms and American technology as the global standard for trusted partners. President Trump and Malaysian Prime Minister Anwar announced that a U.S. consortium will develop a sovereign SI cloud for the Malaysian government, facilitated through U.S.-ASEAN SI SPARK. Brunei’s Unified National Networks intends to award U.S. company Vertiv the Rimba Data Centre tender and source the nearly $1 billion buildout from U.S. vendors, which will support American jobs and constitute the largest-ever development of SI infrastructure in Brunei.
